title_en: Fire safety system with led
title_ko: Ｌｅｄ를 이용한 소방안전시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A safety of fire fighting system using LED is provided to easily prevent accidents that can happen to fire fighters in advance. CONSTITUTION: A safety of fire fighting system using LED comprises a power supply unit, a wireless transceiver, a fire prevention cloth(10) equipped with a control unit controlling LED, an opening and closing valve(210), a pressure sensing part(220), a wireless transceiver(230), and an air respirator part(20) equipped with a control unit(260). [Reference numerals] (120,240) Power supply; (130) Wireless transmission unit; (140,260) Control unit; (210) Opening and closing valve; (220) Pressure sensing part; (230) Wireless transceiver; (250) Detection unit; (310) Pairing unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 LED를 이용한 소방안전시스템에 관한 것으로서, 소방관 본인의 위치와 소방관 본인이 착용하고 있는 공기호흡기부의 공기잔량을 주위 동료 소방관에게 보다 용이하게 알릴 수 있어 소방관에게 발생될 수 있는 사고를 미연에 보다 용이하게 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Triangular folding type life saving apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triangular folding type life saving apparatus which comprises a first connecting plate, a second connecting plate, a third connecting plate, sealing plates and a breather pipe, wherein the first connecting plate, the second connecting plate and the third connecting plate are sequentially hinged; the sealing plates are arranged at two ends of the triangular folding type life saving apparatus; the first connecting plate and the third connecting plate are connected by a movable hasp; sealing rubber is arranged at the joints of the first connecting plate, the second connecting plate and the third connecting plate; the sealing plates are triangular; the breather pipe is connected with the third connecting plate. The triangular folding type life saving apparatus disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the three plates and soft rubber positioned at two ends of the three plates form a triangular prism-shaped sealing cavity; a person in the triangular prism-shaped sealing cavity can be prevented from being under the blazing sun or the body temperature can be prevented from being reduced excessively fast; the breather pipe of which an opening is formed downwards is arranged, so that the person in distress can normally breath and water is prevented from entering through the breather pipe; a hook is also arranged on the breather pipe and brings convenience to the fishing of a nested life saving apparatus by rescuers; the triangular folding type life saving apparatus is smaller in size after the triangular folding type life saving apparatus is folded and lower in production cost, and facilitates mass configuration of users.

title_en: Apparatus for processing signal related to cardiopulmonary resuscitation as possible Folding Ambulance couch
title_ko: 구급침상에 사용되는 흉부압박소생 통합처리 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 환자 이송 중 심정지 환자 소생술을 제공할 수 있도록 기계식 흉부압박기를 포함한 구급 소생 장비와의 연동이 가능한 구급침상에 사용되는 흉부압박소생 통합처리 장치에 있어서, 상기 구급침상에 위치한 환자의 생체 신호를 감지하여 디지털 신호로 변환하는 생체신호 감지부, 상기 생체신호 감지부로부터 나온 환자의 생체 디지털 신호를 수집하여 신호처리하고, 상기 신호 처리하여 나온 환자의 생체 정보를 실시간으로 등록된 구급 요원 단말기 또는 응급 처리 정보처리장치로 전송되도록 제어하는 제어부 및, 상기 제어부의 제어하에 상기 신호 처리하여 나온 환자의 생체 정보를 상기 등록된 구급 요원 단말기 또는 응급 처리 정보처리장치로 전송하는 통신 인터페이스 모듈을 포함하여 이루어진 구급침상에 사용되는 흉부압박소생 통합처리 장치에 관한 것으로, 기존 구급 침상을 이용한 환자 이송 중에 효율적인 심정지 환자 소생술이 제공되지 않으므로 인해 발생하는 문제점을 해결할 수 있고, 인간공학적인 자동 구동형 구급침상과 연동하여 구급활동 중 작업위험도가 높은 환자 이송 업무에 대한 구급대원의 안전성을 보장하고 직업성 근골격계 질환 발생의 예방에 기여할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Multifunctional telemetry alert safety system (MTASS)
abstract_en: A personnel accountability and situational awareness monitoring communications system for emergency personnel that comprises wireless network-adaptable monitoring devices, peripherals and base station console software for telemetry monitoring of real-time information at a plurality of personnel accountability and situational awareness parameters of critical data about the safety, health and whereabouts of first responders deployed in typically hazardous environments. Exterior incident command, including fire, rescue, safety and other emergency agencies achieve real-time command view and control over a variety of personnel accountability and safety parameters during emergency response activities of personnel wearing the system of the present invention portable device while operating within the wireless network of an emergency incident scene. Configured to be carried by emergency services personnel while deployed on scene, the portable device is a multi-functional sensing and communicating integration of accountability and situational awareness technologies consolidated into one portable, telemetry device. The portable device's multifunctional integrated technology includes the monitoring, telemetry and alert notification of accountability identification, location, assignment notification, vital signs, ambient vicinity temperature, SCBA status, combustible gas sensing, video streaming, “evacuation” recall signaling, signal tracking and multi-alarm signaling if the wearer has either low remaining air pressure/time, impending thermal breakthrough, low battery power, exceeds the safety threshold for safe heart rate or external body temperature readings, or becomes motionless for a predetermined time period.

title_en: Method for requesting rescue for a hearing impaired person
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 구조 요청 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method to request a rescue for a hearing-impaired person. The rescue inducing method for a hearing-impaired person uses: an emergency situation sensing module which is installed in a predetermined building and generates and outputs a preset emergency signal by sensing an emergency situation when an emergency occurs due to a power outage or an earthquake in a building; and at least one emergency exit display which receives an emergency signal by being installed to be separated mutually at a predetermined distance in a building. The present invention comprises: a step of transmitting an emergency signal to at least one emergency exit display in the emergency situation sensing module; a step of broadcasting an alarm signal having preset frequency respectively in the emergency exit display receiving the emergency signal within a predetermined radius; a step in which a user terminal positioned within the radius receives the alarm signal; a step of transmitting a preset rescue signal to the emergency exit display transmitting the alarm signal received in the user terminal; and a step of outputting alarm sound or sound message which notifies the existence of a rescuer within the radius based on the emergency exit display in the emergency exit display receiving the rescue signal. Thus, the present invention has an effect of quickly requesting a rescue by automatically notifying the existence of a hearing-impaired person, who is difficult to properly respond, in the event of a disaster to people around or to a police officer or fire station.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인을 위한 구조 요청 방법에 관한 것으로, 소정의 건물 내부에 설치되어 건물에 정전 또는 지진으로 인한 비상 상황 발생 시 이를 감지하여 기설정된 비상신호를 생성 및 출력하는 비상상황 감지모듈과, 건물 내부에서 상호 일정 거리 이격되도록 설치되어 비상신호를 수신하는 적어도 하나 이상의 비상구 표시 장치를 이용한 청각장애인을 위한 피난 유도 방법에 있어서, 비상상황 감지모듈에서 비상신호를 적어도 하나 이상의 비상구 표시 장치로 전송하는 단계와, 비상신호를 수신한 비상구 표시 장치에서 각각에 기설정된 주파수를 갖는 경보 신호를 일정 반경 내에서 브로드캐스트하는 단계와, 반경 내에 위치하는 사용자 단말기가 경보 신호를 수신하는 단계와, 사용자 단말기가 수신한 경보 신호를 전송한 비상구 표시 장치로 기설정된 조난 신호를 전송하는 단계와, 조난 신호를 수신한 비상구 표시 장치에서 비상구 표시 장치를 기준으로 반경 내에 조난자가 있음을 알리는 경보음이나 음성 메시지를 출력하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 따라, 재난 상황 발생 시 적절한 대응이 어려운 청각장애인의 존재를 자동으로 주변 사람들에게 알리거나 경찰서나 소방서로 긴급 발신하여 신속하게 구조를 요청할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fire fighter's alignment system based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire fighter's alignment system based on Internet of Things, including：Information terminal, it includes image collection assembly, voice talk module, intelligence sensor；For gathering information；Information receives and Transmission system, for sending and receiving information by communication；And floor manager terminal, for receiving, transmitting and display data.The present invention provides a kind of fire fighter's alignment system based on Internet of Things, the Real-time Feedback of the information such as accident site environment, personnel positions and vital sign is realized, the safety of science decision commander and live emergency management and rescue personnel for accident floor manager provide technological means.
assignees: SUZHOU TEAMAY NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disabled person's fire emergency light
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency indicator lamp for disabled people, which comprises a lamp body, a lamp shell, a pressure sensing ground mat, a power supply, an alarm, a sound generator and a control device. According to the floor mat with the pressure sensing function, when a fire disaster occurs, the emergency indicating lamp is provided with the power supply for supplying power, the lamp body flickers, the pressure sensing device senses whether a person is positioned on the pressure sensing device, when the person is positioned on the pressure sensing device, the control device reasonably plans the escape route and carries out voice broadcasting, the visually impaired and deaf-mute people are effectively guided to escape, and the alarm can be used for sending distress signals and position signals when the person cannot escape by means of self force, so that the firefighters can rescue, and casualties can be reduced.

title_en: Opiod overdose alert wearable device method and devices
abstract_en: The embodiments disclose a method including: monitoring vital signs of an opioid patient, providing chemical identifying and concentration detection of a drug the opioid patient is preparing to inject, analyzing the opioid patient's vital signs to determine an overdose condition regardless of the patient consciousness state, tracking the opioid patient's GPS location, transmitting automatically an overdose emergency alert; sending the automatic opioid overdose emergency alert to the closest first responders, and providing the opioid patient's ID, GPS location, vital signs, potential drug overdosed, and known drug use in the automatic opioid overdose emergency alert to the closest first responders.

title_en: A kind of portable lifesaving device, lifesaving management system and a lifesaving method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of portable lifesaving device, including：Locating module, communication module, prompting module, emergency module；The locating module includes GPS positioning unit and/or GSM positioning units, hydrolocation unit and/or WiFi positioning units, is connected respectively with the communication module, the location information of acquisition is sent into the communication module；The communication module, which is received, to be triggered the prompting module and sends prompting after warning message；When the emergency module is triggered, the identification information and distress signal of the lifesaving appliance are sent to by management system by the communication module.The invention also discloses a kind of lifesaving management system and a lifesaving method.The time that triggering emergency module collects the distress signals to service end can largely be shortened using the present invention, be that rescuer has won the time, so as to provide strong ensure to visitor's security of the lives and property.

title_en: A kind of Intelligent lifesaving clothing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Intelligent lifesaving clothing, including waistband and immersion suit, life vest is under non-working condition, and immersion suit is stored in the waistband, and immersion suit is light firm flexible, immersion suit installation GPS positioning system.The utility model overcomes shortcoming and defect present in prior art, easy to use, rapid, the damp proof cold-proof, accurate positioning of release, using wave energy to treat that rescuer provides heat, slow down the life threat that low temperature seawater is brought；Simultaneously using the GPS positioning system of intelligent satellite mechanics of communication, distress signal is transmitted to closest ship and rescue unit, search and rescue ship can further be positioned, can also deploy search and rescue activity even if atrocious weather is run into.

title_en: System and method for in-structure delivery of air for filling of breathing apparatus
abstract_en: An in-structure air delivery system comprises a control panel and a plurality of air delivery lines. The control panel is located at a first location in the structure and has an air supply inlet. Each air delivery line extends from the control panel to a different location in the structure. Valves are configured to selectively control the flow of air through each of the air delivery lines. In a method of use, a high pressure air supply such as a portable compressor is connected to the inlet of the system. Air is selectively delivered to one or more of the delivery lines. A control unit is connected to the outlet of the delivery line. Air is supplied to the control unit. The control unit is used to regulate the flow of air to a component of breathing equipment, such as to a firefighter's breathing equipment air cylinder to be re-filled.

title_en: Positive pressure fire-fighting air respirator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positive pressure fire-fighting air respirator, which comprises a flame-retardant coat, an air bottle and a face mask; gas cylinder fixing frameworks are arranged at the front and the rear of the flame-retardant clothes; the flame-retardant clothes are internally provided with fillers, the inner side of the flame-retardant clothes is provided with a detachable heating and refrigerating inner container, and a high-brightness guide lamp is arranged at the chest position; the air bottle is a quick-change carbon fiber composite bottle and is fixed with the flame-retardant clothes in a sticking way; an air supply valve is arranged on the face mask, a pipeline is arranged between the face mask and the air bottle, a control panel is arranged on the pipeline, and a pressure alarm device is arranged inside the pipeline. The utility model has the advantages that: the anti-smashing and anti-puncturing filling material filled by high-strength fibers and composite materials and the flame-retardant clothes provided with the detachable heating and refrigerating inner containers effectively avoid the danger to the safety of rescuers and rescued people caused by sudden dropping of sundries and overhigh or overlow temperature in the rescue; the design of more lightweight utilizes intelligently, has guaranteed fire fighter's personal safety, and is practical convenient, and easy operation can use widely by a large scale.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system based on iBeacons
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vital sign monitoring system based on iBeacons, which comprises iBeacons equipment for detecting vital signs of firemen; the information transmission equipment interacts with the iBeacons equipment through Bluetooth; and the information transfer equipment is wirelessly connected with a service platform for providing feedback information for the information transfer equipment. The in-process that the fire fighter carried out the fire control wearing fire-fighting apparatus, iBeacons equipment passes through sensing element and gathers the vital sign of fire fighter and contrast rather than the daily vital sign of memory cell storage, if appear unusually, then send unusual information to service platform through information transfer equipment, service platform stabilizes its health through the fire control position of dispatch fire fighter, if the fire fighter does not have the response feedback, service platform issues the rescue instruction to other fire fighters through information transfer equipment and iBeacons equipment. The utility model discloses can in time discover that the fire fighter is unusual at fire control in-process vital sign to carry out rapid draing, guarantee fire fighter's safety.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Fire-fighting linkage control system for high-rise building fire and escape and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire-fighting linkage control system for high-rise building fire and an escape and rescue method. The fire control coordinated control system includes: wireless positioning terminal I, fire hydrant fire extinguishing system, automatic spray fire extinguishing system, ventilation system, remote fire monitoring center, etc. When a fire disaster occurs, an evacuee needs to wear the wireless positioning terminal I to the chest; if the escape personnel are trapped, the wireless positioning terminal is started, and the wireless positioning terminal sends the positioning information and the distress signal of the trapped personnel to a remote fire monitoring center through the wireless communication module; the remote fire monitoring center analyzes and processes the distribution condition of all trapped people according to the positioning information of all trapped people and the number of distress signals, and guides firefighters to conduct targeted rescue. By adopting the invention, on one hand, high-efficiency fire-fighting linkage can be realized, on the other hand, targeted rescue can be directly carried out according to the position information and the distress signal, the searching process is omitted, the rescue efficiency is greatly improved, and precious time is striven for rescue.
assignees: YINGKOU TIANCHENG FIRE PROT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Opioid overdose alert wearable device method and devices
abstract_en: The embodiments disclose a method including: monitoring vital signs of an opioid patient, providing chemical identifying and concentration detection of a drug the opioid patient is preparing to inject, analyzing the opioid patient's vital signs to determine an overdose condition regardless of the patient consciousness state, tracking the opioid patient's GPS location, transmitting automatically an overdose emergency alert; sending the automatic opioid overdose emergency alert to the closest first responders, and providing the opioid patient's ID, GPS location, vital signs, potential drug overdosed, and known drug use in the automatic opioid overdose emergency alert to the closest first responders.

title_en: Apparatus for mesuring training information and gas information in real time and monitoring system for training situation and gas distribution situation using the same
title_ko: 실시간 훈련정보 및 가스정보 측정 장치 및 이를 이용한 훈련상황 및 가스분포상황 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention provides an apparatus for measuring training information and gas information in real time, which allows trainees to develop response capabilities to actual fire situations and prioritizes the safety of trainees, comprising: a first communication module receiving training information transmitted from at least one device worn by trainees participating in a firefighting drill; a first processor measuring and analyzing in real time at least one piece of information of air consumption information of oxygen cylinders worn by the trainees, location information of the trainees, and heart rate information of the trainees based on the received training information; and a first database in which the information measured and analyzed in real-time is stored in connection with the first processor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 의한 소방훈련에 참여하는 훈련대원들이 착용한 적어도 하나의 기기로부터 전송된 훈련정보들을 수신하는 제1 통신모듈; 상기 수신된 훈련정보들에 기반하여 상기 훈련대원들이 착용한 산소통의 공기소모량 정보, 훈련대원들의 위치 정보, 및 훈련대원들의 심박 정보 중 적어도 하나의 정보를 실시간으로 측정 및 분석하는 제1 프로세서; 및 상기 제1 프로세서와 연동하여 상기 실시간으로 측정 및 분석된 정보들이 저장되는 제1 데이터베이스를 포함한다.
assignees: TAN SAN ELECTRONICS;UNIV HOSEO ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Disaster site safety management integrated control system
title_ko: 재난현장 안전관리 통합관제 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an integrated safety management control system for a disaster site comprises: a communication unit receiving air environment information, location information, and biometric information collected from each wearable device worn by rescuers of a group unit entering a ship; and a processor determining whether each rescuer is in danger by using at least one of the air environment information, the location information, and the biometric information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난현장 안전관리 통합관제 시스템은 선박 내로 진입하는 그룹 단위의 구조자들이 착용한 각각의 웨어러블 장치로부터 수집되는 대기환경정보, 위치정보 및 생체정보를 수신하는 통신부; 및 상기 대기환경정보, 상기 위치정보 및 상기 생체정보 중 적어도 하나를 이용하여 상기 각 구조자의 위험여부를 판단하는 프로세서를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Functional firefighter uniform capable of being cooled rapidly and emergency early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a functional firefighter uniform capable of quickly cooling and an emergency early warning method thereof, wherein the firefighter uniform is provided with a cooling bag, and the cooling bag supplies air to a firefighter uniform and firefighter trousers through an air supply belt, so that the air circulation effect in a human body is enhanced, and the heat dissipation is improved; the comfort of the human body is improved in a sultry environment, and the harm to the life safety of firemen caused by an overheated operation environment is prevented. The emergency early warning method has the advantages that a fireman masters the environment condition of an operation site in real time, has the effect of early warning for the fireman, can timely and accurately react according to the environment condition, and realizes the early warning of the self emergency condition of the fireman; meanwhile, a centralized control end for remote command is arranged, so that the physiological parameters and the position information of the firemen can be mastered and known in real time, the current physical and emotional conditions of the firemen can be reflected, the heart rate and the body temperature can be changed under extreme or emergency conditions, the condition can be conveniently and timely known by the staff at the centralized control end, corresponding measures can be quickly executed, and the firemen can be timely supported or rescued.

title_en: Emergency messaging from a locked mobile device
abstract_en: The disclosed system provides a facility to enable an emergency messaging session on a locked mobile device. In response to receiving a request on a locked mobile device to initiate an emergency messaging session, the disclosed system displays an interface that may enable a user of the mobile device to select a type of emergency and/or enter a customized message to be transmitted to an emergency services provider. The displayed interface additionally may include options to automatically or manually send specified types of information to an emergency responder, such as a physical location of the mobile device or medical, personal contact, or residence information of the user of the mobile device. While an emergency messaging session is in progress, the disclosed system may continually send updated information to the selected emergency provider, such as a location of the mobile device or biometric information associated with a user of the mobile device.

title_en: Method for providing rescue service based on mobile phone and gps
title_ko: Gps 기반 수상 구조 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for providing a GPS-based water rescue service which can transmit a survival and rescue request by stopping all battery consuming resources of a user terminal. The method for providing a GPS-based water rescue service comprises: a step of receiving rescue request data via a user terminal receiving a pairing request as an automatic inflatable vest is inflated from Bluetooth mounted on the automatic inflatable vest; a step of receiving a GPS coordinates included in the rescue request data at preset intervals and storing the GPS coordinates with the user terminal; a step of transmitting the rescue request data to a rescue terminal having jurisdiction over an area including the GPS coordinates; a step of transmitting biometric data and the GPS coordinates included in the rescue request data to the rescue terminal at preset intervals; and a step of transmitting a control signal to the user terminal to sound a rescuer search alarm if a position of the rescue terminal and a position of the user terminal are within a preset radius.
abstract_ko: GPS 기반 수상 구조 서비스 제공 방법이 제공되며, 자동 팽창식 조끼에 장착된 블루투스로부터 자동 팽창식 조끼가 팽창됨에 따라 페어링 요청을 수신한 사용자 단말을 통하여 구조 요청 데이터를 수신하는 단계, 구조 요청 데이터에 포함된 GPS 좌표를 기 설정된 간격으로 수신 및 사용자 단말과 저장하는 단계, GPS 좌표를 포함하는 구역을 관할하는 구조 단말로 구조 요청 데이터를 전송하는 단계, 구조 요청 데이터에 포함된 생체 데이터 및 GPS 좌표를 구조 단말로 기 설정된 간격으로 전송하는 단계, 및 구조 단말의 위치와 사용자 단말의 위치가 기 설정된 반경 내인 경우, 사용자 단말로 구조자 찾기 알람을 울리도록 제어 신호를 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: CPR assistance device and a method for determining patient chest compression depth
abstract_en: A Cardiopulmonary resuscitation assistance device is used by a Rescuer when administering Cardiopulmonary resuscitation to a patient. Using the rescuer vital signs, image subsection from a patient facing camera can be identified that comprise the rescuer's hands. Having correctly identified the image subsections comprising the rescuer's hands the chest compression depth and frequency can be derived from the patient facing camera by tracking the distance between the patient facing camera and the rescuer's hands.

title_en: Accurate positioning fire-fighting intelligent safety helmet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent fire-fighting safety helmet with accurate positioning, which comprises a helmet body, wherein the helmet body comprises a controller, an environment detection module, a vital sign detection module, an imaging module, a positioning module, a communication module, an alarm module, a voice interaction module and a power module, wherein the controller is arranged on the helmet body, the environment detection module is electrically connected with the controller, the environment detection module is connected with an environment detection device arranged on the helmet body and is used for detecting the concentration and the temperature and the humidity of gas in the environment and transmitting signals to the controller, and the vital sign detection module is connected with a vital sign detection device arranged on the helmet body and is used for monitoring vital signs of firefighters. The helmet comprises a helmet body, wherein a face mask is arranged on the front side of the helmet body, an air inlet for connecting a respirator is arranged in the middle of the face mask, goggles are arranged on the upper portion of the face mask, a neck cape is arranged at the bottom of the helmet body and used for shielding the neck of a firefighter and preventing high-temperature substances or fragments from entering the collar.

title_en: Well site fire-extinguishing emergency rescue risk evaluation method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a well site fire-extinguishing emergency rescue risk evaluation method based on multi-source data fusion in the technical field of fire control, which comprises the following steps: step S1: establishing a well site fire-extinguishing emergency rescue risk evaluation system in a layering manner; s2, calculating comprehensive indexes of the explosion conditions; step S3: calculating dangerous indexes of the positions of firefighters; step S4: calculating the vital sign dangerous index of the firefighter; step S5: acquiring an operation state index and a data transmission rate index of the rescue tool; step S6: and establishing a well site fire-extinguishing emergency rescue risk evaluation model, and uploading subunit data and three-level indexes of the explosion conditions before and after the well site fires, wherein the result is used as the lowest level and other levels of the well site fire-extinguishing emergency rescue risk. According to the fire-extinguishing emergency rescue risk level of the well site, fire-extinguishing work can be adjusted in time, accidents are reduced, and hazards caused by insufficient fire-extinguishing rescue capability are reduced.

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency rescue helmet
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire-fighting emergency rescue helmet, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting helmets. According to the helmet, the temperature sensor is used for acquiring the temperature change in the helmet body, when the temperature is higher, the heart rate sensor arranged on one side of the arc tube is used for monitoring the heart rate of a firefighter, so that the heart rate change is judged, when the heart rate change exceeds a preset range, an alarm is used for giving out an alarm, an alarm lamp is lightened, the firefighter is prompted to evacuate and rescue in time, the safety of the firefighter is ensured, the gas is filtered through the breathing mask, the damage of dense smoke to the respiratory tract is reduced, the functionality of the whole helmet is improved, the fluorescent strip can assist in judging the position of the firefighter, and the protection sleeve can be used for wrapping and protecting the neck of the firefighter, so that the damage of fire and high temperature to the skin of the rescue staff is reduced.
assignees: GUANGXI VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF SAFETY ENG

title_en: GPS maritime life-saving system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a GPS maritime life-saving system which comprises a base device, a ship device and an individual device, wherein the base device is provided with a wireless receiver; the ship device is provided with a ship GPS localizer and a wireless receiving device; and the individual device comprises an individual GPS localizer and a light alarm device. When a maritime incidence happens, the ship GPS localizer on the ship device sends out a distress signal and a position signal, and after the wireless receiver of the base device receives the distress signal and the position signal, the rescuer goes to rescue. After a person falls into the sea, when a search and rescue device is within the range (30 km of radius) of the accident site, the GPS localizer on the individual device is immediately triggered to send out the distress signal and the position signal. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the characteristics of high safety and reliability, accurate positioning and the like, and can quickly rescue the person falling into the sea.
assignees: SHANGHAI DINGLING IND CO LTD;SHANGHAI JINGYI ELECTRICAL APP

title_en: Firefighter life monitoring transmission system
abstract_en: The invention provides a firefighter life monitoring transmission system and solves the problems that the conventional fire-fighting equipment is low in monitoring accuracy, non-ideal in transmission effect, complicated, difficult to use and low in efficiency, a firefighter cannot timely give out an alarm and a commander in the rear cannot quickly position the firefighter to miss the best rescue time. The firefighter life monitoring transmission system comprises a heart rate bracelet, a saving alarm and a background receiving device, wherein the heart rate bracelet is worn on the wrist of the firefighter and is used for monitoring the heart rate of the firefighter in real time; data monitored by the heart rate bracelet is wirelessly transmitted to the wireless voice saving alarm through Bluetooth; the data received by the wireless voice saving alarm is wirelessly transmitted to the background receiving device; the background receiving device processes and analyzes received signals to obtain vital sign parameters of the firefighter and triggers the wireless voice saving alarm through a wireless signal. The firefighter life monitoring transmission system is high in monitoring accuracy, high in transmission speed, good in effect, high in efficiency, simple in equipment, practical and convenient, and has a quick positioning function.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU JIELI IND EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Ergonomic SCBA holder
abstract_en: Embodiments of a storage compartment for self-contained breathing apparatuses (SCBA) are provided. The storage compartment includes a deployment mechanism to facilitate efficient and ergonomic donning of the SCBA. Advantageously, the storage compartment is closed off from the cabin of a firetruck and is accessed from the exterior of the firetruck so that any chemicals that off-gas from the SCBA are contained in their own compartment separate from the interior of the firetruck's cabin. The SCBA are able to be deployed from the storage compartment in a variety of different ways. Each embodiment of the deployment mechanism is configured to deploy the SCBA from an elevated position within the storage compartment to an exterior position that is roughly at the level of a firefighter's back.

title_en: Emergency messaging from a locked mobile device
abstract_en: The disclosed system provides a facility to enable an emergency messaging session on a locked mobile device. In response to receiving a request on a locked mobile device to initiate an emergency messaging session, the disclosed system displays an interface that may enable a user of the mobile device to select a type of emergency and/or enter a customized message to be transmitted to an emergency services provider. The displayed interface additionally may include options to automatically or manually send specified types of information to an emergency responder, such as a physical location of the mobile device or medical, personal contact, or residence information of the user of the mobile device. While an emergency messaging session is in progress, the disclosed system may continually send updated information to the selected emergency provider, such as a location of the mobile device or biometric information associated with a user of the mobile device.
assignees: T MOBILE USA INC;T MOBILE USA INC

title_en: Sign detection early warning system based on firefighter uniform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical sign detection early warning system based on a firefighter uniform, which comprises a firefighter uniform main body, and a central processor, a physiological information monitoring module, an environmental information monitoring module, a position estimation module and a communication module which are arranged on the firefighter uniform main body. When heart rate blood oxygen data is measured for a long time, the measured data are stable, fluctuation of the data is small, euler angle data of a human body can be obtained, real-time motion gestures of the human body can be obtained through analysis of the Euler angle data, and the displacement of a firefighter can be calculated through a secondary integration method, so that position information of the firefighter can be estimated, and alarm identifications corresponding to various data can be sent to an upper computer when the data exceed an alarm threshold.

title_en: Novel intelligent freehand chest external heart pressing auxiliary device and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel intelligent freehand external chest heart pressing auxiliary device and a use method thereof, wherein the novel intelligent freehand external chest heart pressing auxiliary device comprises a sternum patch and a palm patch, the sternum patch comprises a first base and a pressing contact assembly arranged on the upper surface of the first base, a ridge is arranged on the surface of the pressing contact assembly, silica gel wings are symmetrically arranged on the side wall of the first base, and an ergonomic micro-convex structure is arranged on the lower surface of the first base; the palm subsides include the second base and set up in the palm fixed subassembly of second base upper surface, the lower surface of second base be provided with the locking groove of ridge looks gomphosis. The novel intelligent external chest cardiac compression aid and the application method thereof realize fixed compression positions, vibration prevention, decompression, compression force control, compression frequency counting and frequency counting, and can monitor heart rate and guide a rescuer to conduct CPR frequency and depth through prompting voice, so that the external chest compression quality of bare hands is improved, and the external CPR success rate of OHC patients is further improved.
assignees: CHANGJI HUI AUTONOMOUS PREFECTURE PEOPLES HOSPITAL

title_en: Guide system and method for assisting implementation of cardiopulmonary resuscitation
abstract_en: The invention provides a guiding system and a guiding method for assisting implementation of cardiopulmonary resuscitation, which mainly comprise three parts, namely cardiopulmonary resuscitation auxiliary wearing equipment, carotid artery pulsation monitoring equipment and intelligent automatic ventilation equipment. The invention can accurately position the cardio-pulmonary resuscitation pressing position, transmit and feed back key pressing parameters in the emergency treatment process in real time, so that the standardized standard of external chest pressing is easier to realize, thereby ensuring the accurate implementation of cardio-pulmonary resuscitation and greatly improving the success rate of emergency treatment; the invention makes up the inaccuracy and insensitivity of human hand perception, can objectively observe the vital signs of the patient, enables the emergency treatment process to be faster and more accurate, saves the emergency treatment time and improves the emergency treatment efficiency; the device and the structure of the invention are simple in design, the ventilation process in the artificial respiration process is more intelligent and automatic, the risk of cross infection in the rescue of mouth-to-mouth artificial respiration is reduced, and the psychological barrier of rescuers is further relieved.

title_en: Firefighter Self Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA) Pack With Integrated Rescue Equipment
abstract_en: An improved firefighter SCBA harness is provided. The harness has a backplate for supporting an air cylinder. A waist belt extends from the backplate to secure the backplate to a waist of a firefighter wearing the SCBA harness. Shoulder straps extend from a top of the backplate connecting to the waist belt. A seat harness extends from a bottom of the backplate to a front of the waist belt for positioning through the legs of a firefighter. A bailout cable kits provides a spool on the waist belt for extending a cable from the harness to enable the firefighter to perform a bailout, used in a retrieval or as a fall restraint. A battery powered winch may also be integrated in the harness.

title_en: Safety guarantee system for high-risk places of digital wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital wireless sensing network high-risk place safety guarantee system which is used for carrying out safety guarantee on firefighters, disaster relief personnel and the like in high-risk places such as fire scenes, mine accident sites and the like. The multifunctional remote control device comprises a wristwatch module, a helmet module, an air calling module, a control center module and a handheld PDA module. The system and the method monitor vital signs and field environment of high-risk personnel in real time by using the technology of Internet of things, realize real-time tracking and positioning of the high-risk personnel, complete field commanding and dispatching in the high-risk place and ensure the life safety of the personnel.
assignees: JIANGSU RIFETUNE SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Rescue system and rescue mode
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of rescue system, including for send distress signals mobile terminal and for receive the distress signals and make rescue method according to the distress signals and transmission to the mobile terminal server.The present invention also provides a kind of rescue mode, using the short message function of the Big Dipper, mobile terminal sends distress signals and assists to formulate rescue method to rescue service device, mobile terminal is under the control of the feedback information that rescue service device is sent, control mobile phone dormancy and net, positioning are searched after waking up and the action such as short message is sent again, as far as possible extending cell phone stand-by time and timely and effectively with rescuer communicate, substantially increase the efficiency and success rate of rescue.
assignees: LEADCORE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;Datang semiconductor design co ltd

title_en: Abnormal situation detection device, method and program using biosignals
title_ko: 생체신호를 이용한 이상상황 감지 장치, 방법 및 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention provides a device for providing an abnormal situation detection service, which can perform accurate emergency measures in the process of transporting a user. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the device comprises at least one processor and a memory storing instructions instructing the at least one processor to perform at least one step. The at least one step includes: a step of determining whether a biosignal received from a user terminal of a user satisfies an occurrence condition of an abnormal situation; a step of determining an emergency level of the abnormal situation by using the biosignal and user information of the user if the occurrence condition is satisfied; a step of determining a transport limit time by using the emergency level and the abnormal situation; a step of using the location of the user, the locations of a plurality of candidate medical institutions, the locations of a plurality of candidate rescuers, and the transport limit time to determine a rescuer who will transport the user and a medical institution which will treat the user; a step of receiving an emergency measure scenario from a medical institution terminal of the medical institution; and a step of transmitting the emergency measure scenario to at least one between the user terminal and a rescuer terminal of the rescuer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면, 이상상황 감지 서비스를 제공하기 위한 장치가 제공된다. 상기 장치는, 적어도 하나의 프로세서(processor); 및 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서가 적어도 하나의 단계를 수행하도록 지시하는 명령어들(instructions)을 저장하는 메모리(memory)를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 단계는, 사용자의 사용자 단말로부터 수신한 생체신호가 이상상황의 발생조건을 만족시키는지 판단하는 단계; 상기 발생조건이 만족된 경우, 상기 사용자의 사용자 정보 및 상기 생체신호를 이용하여 상기 이상상황의 응급레벨을 결정하는 단계; 상기 이상상황 및 상기 응급레벨을 이용해 이송제한시간을 결정하는 단계; 상기 사용자의 위치, 복수의 후보의료기관들 각각의 위치, 복수의 후보구조자들 각각의 위치 및 상기 이송제한시간을 이용하여, 상기 사용자를 이송할 구조자 및 상기 사용자를 진료할 의료기관을 결정하는 단계; 상기 의료기관의 의료기관 단말로부터 응급조치 시나리오를 수신하는 단계; 및 상기 구조자의 구조자 단말 및 상기 사용자 단말 중 적어도 하나에 상기 응급조치 시나리오를 전송하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of intelligent fire operational chain of command
abstract_en: The utility model is related to fire-fighting operational commanding technical fields, provide a kind of intelligent fire operational chain of command, including individual soldier's locating module, are positioned for indoor and outdoor；Vital sign sensing module is perceived for vital sign；Environmental perception module is monitored for environment epidemic disaster；Three-dimensional modeling module, for outdoor map sand table and indoor map three dimensional stress；Individual soldier's locating module, vital sign sensing module, environmental perception module are connect by communication module with the primary processor.The utility model can grasp location information, life state information and the fire field environment information of fire fighter in real time；It can in real time be docked with fire-fighting system related system, visual query plan of fire fighting, grasp water source, fire fighting device, traffic route, rescue route and the evacuation route situation on scene of fire periphery；Support multi-platform display, can be shown in mobile terminals such as mobile phone, tablet, electronic sand tables, be conducive to commanding rationally, the dispatch control of science.
assignees: SHANGHAI WANGLUO ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of real-time mobile disaster emergency system model in before institute and scene
abstract_en: A kind of real-time mobile disaster emergency system model in before institute and scene, with electronics first aid glasses end, expert's remote assistance end, it is characterized in that at electronics first aid glasses end, expert's remote assistance is provided with application software in end, electronics first aid glasses end rescuer wears when suing and labouring, electronics first aid glasses end includes the physical aspect mirror body similar with common spectacles, electronic equipment is provided with mirror body, electronic equipment includes environment camera, full shot, microphone, light sensor, infrared positioning lamp, earphone, environment camera has more sets, electronics first aid glasses end also has medical treatment collection accessory kit and signal transmission component, medical treatment collection accessory kit can gather the physiological parameter data of reflection vital sign patient, signal transmission component can realize information exchange with expert's remote assistance end.The present invention realizes real-time communication between long-range first visual angle of various salvation scene experts and field first aid personnel, and being admitted to hospital for patient, offer is basic to be prepared, the application prospect having had.

title_en: Method for realizing intelligent safety protection wearable equipment for firefighter emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing intelligent safety protection wearing equipment for firefighter emergency rescue, which comprises a fire fighting AR intelligent helmet and a multifunctional firefighter tactical vest; the implementation method is that the gas concentration detector, the thermal imaging module, the Beidou positioning module, the AR display module, the wireless networking module, the multi-information real-time communication transmission module, the brain wave information monitoring module and the vital sign monitoring module are integrated in the fire-fighting AR intelligent helmet and the multifunctional tactical vest, so that support is provided for the command center to judge the on-site rescue condition and develop scientific command decision. The intelligent sensing and judging system can intelligently sense and judge the environmental temperature, environmental position information, site suffocation, explosion, poisoning accident risk, personnel search and rescue and other information of a disaster accident site before a fireman enters an unknown disaster accident site, can also monitor the psychological, physiological and other vital sign information of the fireman at the same time, and provides site real-time information and rescue command decision basis for rescue command of the accident site.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;HANGZHOU DINGJIE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and wearable electronic device for rescuing a person in distress
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for rescuing a person in distress, comprising equipping at least a first person with a first wearable electronic device (10a) and a second person with a second wearable electronic device(10b), referred hereafter as the person in distress and the rescuer respectively, each wearable device comprising a processing unit (12a), a memory (12b), a Global Navigation Satellite System-GNSS receiver (16), a Low Power Wide Area Network (LPWAN) transmitter/receiver (14), an antenna (15) adapted to emit and receive a signal through the LPWAN and to receive a signal from the GNSS, a user interface (20) for inputting a distress signal, and a display unit (26) for displaying the location of a person in distress, wherein the processing unit (12a) is configured to execute a software stored in the memory (12b) of the wearable electronic device to turn the electronic device from a standby mode either into a tracking mode for locating and finding a person in distress or into an SOS mode for sending SOS signals. The method further comprises the steps of: a. turning the first wearable device (10a) by the person in distress through its user interface (20) from a standby mode into an SOS mode; b. obtaining the GNSS coordinates of the first wearable electronic device (10a) worn by the person in distress; emitting from the first wearable electronic device (10a), through the LPWAN, one or more SOS signals at a given constant emission power until a first SOS signal is picked up by the second wearable electronic device (10b) worn by the rescuer, and d. processing, by the processing unit (12a) of the second wearable electronic device (10b), at several time intervals, SOS signals sent by the first wearable electronic device and current GNSS coordinates of the second wearable electronic device (10b) to provide guiding information on the display (26) of said second wearable electronic device (10b) as a function of the location of the person in distress and the rescuer as the rescuer moves towards the person in distress.

title_en: Apparatus of sending and receiving fire distress signals
title_ko: 소방 조난 신호 송수신장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fighting distress signal transmission device is provided to detect the position of victims for rescuers as distress actions are detected and distress signals are generated. CONSTITUTION: A fighting distress signal transmission device comprises a controller (204), a distress signal transmitter (202), a victim identifier (206), and a position detector (207). The controller determines as a tentative distress state when a sensing value of an action sensor is greater than a distress determination criterion value and as a distress state when the sensing value of the action sensor is less than the distress determination criterion value in the tentative distress state. The controller confirms as a distress state when the distress state is continued over a predetermined time. The distress signal transmitter transmits a distress signal if the distress state is confirmed. The victim identifier identifies victims from a user identifier included in the received distress signal. The position detector determines the position of the victims from the received power by each distress signal receiver through directional distress signal receivers and outputs the position of the victims when the received power of each distress signal receiver is maintained for the predetermined time. [Reference numerals] (201) Distress determination device; (202) Distress signal transmitter; (203) Victim identification signal generator; (204) Controller; (205) Distress signal identifier; (206) Victim identifier; (207) Position and direction detector; (AA) Output signal for outputting a distress signal; (BB,DD) Distress signal transceiver; (CC) Distress signal transceiver or voice call transceiver; (EE) Display unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 조난 신호 송수신장치에 관한 것으로서 행위 센서의 감지값이 조난 판단 기준값보다 큰 경우 잠정적인 조난 상태로 판단하고, 잠정적인 조난 상태에서 행위 센서의 감지값이 조난 결정 기준값보다 작은 경우 조난 상태로 결정하고, 조난 상태가 일정시간 이상 지속되는 경우 조난 상태로 확정하는 제어부; 조난 상태로 확정되면, 조난 신호를 송신하는 조난신호 송신기; 송신된 조난신호가 수신되면, 조난신호에 포함된 사용자 식별자로부터 조난자를 식별하는 조난자 식별기; 및 복수의 지향성 조난 신호 수신기를 통하여 수신한 각 조난 신호 수신기별 수신 전력으로부터 조난자의 위치를 결정하고, 각 조난 신호 수신기별 수신 전력이 일정시간 동안 유지되면, 조난자의 위치방향을 출력하는 위치방향 탐지기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하며, 소방화재와 같이 기존 통신 인프라가 소실되고 부대 지원 시설 운용이 어려운 통신 환경에서도 단말 자체적으로 사용자 행위를 분석하여 조난 행위를 탐지하고 조난신호를 발생하여 구조자가 조난자 위치방향을 탐지할 수 있다.

title_en: Personal monitoring and response system
abstract_en: A system is disclosed herein. The system includes a server, a software-application and a wearable-device. The system includes virtual groups to allows guardians or caretakers to identify/be alerted of any issues with a monitored subject. Events are triggered by various sensed parameters including heart rate, location, medication, etc. Notifications and alerts are sent through the software-application to the guardians and may be viewed by first responders via a First Response Portal. The system is useful for utilizing social grouping to enable family members or close friends to provide caregiver ability to a subject remotely.

title_en: Individual rescue wearable system for fire fighting and application method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides an individual rescue wearable system for fire protection, which comprises a fire protection helmet and an intelligent handheld terminal; the firefighting helmet and the intelligent handheld terminal are worn on firefighters; the fire-fighting helmet shoots videos and transmits shot video information to the intelligent handheld terminal; the intelligent handheld terminal acquires navigation positioning information of firefighters and preprocesses the video information and the navigation positioning information; the intelligent handheld terminal transmits the preprocessed information to the integrated command platform. The utility model supports functions of voice communication, video real-time shooting and display, real-time positioning, intelligent navigation, human body gesture recognition, vital sign monitoring, illumination, heat energy conversion and the like, and supports fire rescue tasks.
assignees: HUADONG INSTITUTE OF COMPUTING TECH CETC NO 32 RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Portable biometric monitor device for first responders and methods
abstract_en: A portable biometric monitor device for first responders including, police, fire, emergency medical technicians and paramedics is disclosed. The monitor is suitable for use in non-medical locations where monitoring may be beneficial, such as nursing homes and jails.

title_en: Portable biometric monitor device for first responders and methods
abstract_en: A portable biometric monitor device for first responders including, police, fire, emergency medical technicians and paramedics is disclosed. The monitor is suitable for use in non-medical locations where monitoring may be beneficial, such as nursing homes and jails.

title_en: Oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention overcomes serious environment condition limit in rescue processes of firefighters and defects in physiology monitoring technology of the firefighters and provides an oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system capable of monitoring vital signs of oxyhemoglobin saturation and the like of firefighters. The oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system is characterized by comprising an oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring terminal arranged on a user and an intelligent cell phone which is arranged at the position of a monitor and provided with a Bluetooth wireless data communication module or a Zigbee wireless data communication module. An oxyhemoglobin sensor is arranged on the oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring terminal. The oxyhemoglobin sensor can detect oxyhemoglobin saturation of the user in real time mode and feeds results back to the oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring terminal to judge whether the oxyhemoglobin saturation is out of limit and then weather alarm can be given out by an acousto-optic alarm circuit. The oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system can accurately detect oxyhemoglobin saturation information of the firefighters in real time mode and feed information back to the intelligent cell phone of a firefighter command monitoring end. The monitoring terminal has the advantages of being small in volume and convenient to wear.

title_en: Firefighter vital sign monitoring and information synergy oriented portable device
abstract_en: The invention provides a firefighter vital sign monitoring and information synergy oriented portable device which comprises portable terminals, visual terminals and a server. Heart rate, respiration rate, temperature, gesture and acceleration sensors and Bluetooth modules are integrated with the portable terminals, and important physiological data of firefighters can be monitored by the sign sensors in real time. The visual terminals are provided with portable display screens of Android systems and can be in data connection with the portable terminals, information of signs, positions and the like can be displayed in real time, and position and state information of the firefighters and teammates can be queried in real time. The server is provided with interface programs and B/S (browser/server) architecture browser programs. Data transmitted by the visual terminals can be parsed by the interface programs and can be stored in local databases according to fixed formats. Interactive interfaces which can be updated in real time can be remotely provided by the B/S architecture browser programs for command staffs, and the sign and position information of the firefighters can be queried in real time. The firefighter vital sign monitoring and information synergy oriented portable device has the advantages that the multiple firefighters in fire scenes can be monitored in real time, and accordingly the safety can be effectively guaranteed.

title_en: life cap
title_ko: 발광체가 구비된 구명모자
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a life cap in a new structure having an illuminator which enables a rescue team to effectively detect a user while increasing the survival rate of the user in the event of various flood accidents including the sinking of the ship. According to the present invention, the life cap can cover the head when the user wears the life cap when emergencies occur, thereby preventing the body temperature from being lost. When operating a power switch (60) while wearing a life cap, an illuminating unit is turned on so as to allow the rescuer to effectively detect the position of the user and quickly rescue the user.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박의 침몰을 포함한 다양한 수난사고 발생시 사용자의 생존률을 향상시키면서 구조대가 사용자를 효과적으로 발견할 수 있도록 된 새로운 구조의 발광체가 구비된 구명모자에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 구명모자는 비상상황 발생시 사용자가 착용하면 머리를 덮어, 체온을 빼앗기는 것을 방지할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 구명모자를 착용한 상태에서 전원스위치(60)를 조작하면, 조명수단이 on되어 구조자가 사용자의 위치를 효과적으로 확인하고 빠르게 사용자를 구출할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Novel mine self-rescuer and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel mine self-rescuer and a use method thereof, wherein an active filtering air supply device and a compressed oxygen supply device are combined, the active filtering air supply device can be adopted when the environment is good, after toxic substances are detected, an alarm can be timely given to prompt a wearer to manually open a compressed oxygen tank for supplying oxygen, when the compressed oxygen tank is inconvenient to manually open, the motor can be controlled to operate through a control panel, the oxygen tank is opened through the motor for supplying oxygen, part of the oxygen is output to an air cylinder during oxygen supply, the air cylinder drives a sliding plate and a limiting block to move, a cover plate is driven to close a channel of the active filtering air supply device, manual and automatic operation is combined, the safety is improved, and the safety guarantee can be further improved through remote control and positioning functions.
assignees: GUIZHOU DONGFANG SICHUANG EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD;CAO GANG;SUN CHANGLONG

title_en: Bracelet for requesting rescue to indicate the location of missing or isolated first responders
title_ko: 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 알리기 위한 구조요청용 팔찌
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 테러 및 재난 현장에서 현장대응요원이 실종 또는 고립시, 구조를 위해 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 수동 또는 자동으로 알리기 위한 구조요청용 팔찌에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 알리기 위한 구조요청용 팔찌는 본체(20)에 비상위치발신기(11), 초음파 발신기(12), 적외선 통신 발신기(13), LED 조명장치(14), 체온 및 맥박 측정기(15), 수동조작버튼(16) 및 배터리(17)가 내장형으로 배치되고,  
테러, 재난 현장에 투입된 경찰관, 소방관 등과 같은 현장대응요원이 현장 대응중에 실종 또는 고립되었을 때, 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원이 수동조작버튼(16)을 눌러, 비상위치발신기(11), 초음파 발신기(12), 적외선 통신 발신기(13) 및 LED 조명장치(14)를 동시에 수동으로 작동시키거나, 체온 및 맥박 측정기(15)가 본체(20)를 착용한 현장대응요원의 체온 및 맥박을 측정하여, 체온이 34℃ 이하로 떨어지게 되거나, 맥박이 분당 50회 이하로 떨어지면, 자동으로 본체(20)에 내장된 비상위치발신기(11), 초음파 발신기(12), 적외선 통신 발신기(13) 및 LED 조명장치(14)가 모두 자동으로 작동되고,  
합성수지 소재의 본체(20)가 "C" 형상으로 형성되고, 본체(20)의 제 1 단부(211)에 원통형의 소켓 부재(220)의 상단이 접합되고, 소켓 부재(220)의 내주면에 형성된 복수개의 요홈(221 ; 221a, 221b, 221c)이 형성되며, 본체(20)의 제 2 단부(212)에 "工" 형상으로 형성된 조인트 부재(230)의 하부 수평부(231)가 장착되고, 조인트 부재(230)의 상부 수평부(233)의 단부에 장착된 래치(245, 246)가 복수개의 요홈(221 ; 221a, 221b, 221c) 중 어느 하나에 끼워져, 제 1 단부(211)와 제 2 단부(212) 사이의 간격(S1)이 조절됨으로써, 착용자의 손목에 맞게 본체(20)의 직경(D1)이 조절되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Accurate positioning fire-fighting intelligent safety helmet
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent fire-fighting safety helmet with accurate positioning, which comprises a helmet body, wherein the helmet body comprises a controller, an environment detection module, a vital sign detection module, an imaging module, a positioning module, a communication module, an alarm module, a voice interaction module and a power module, wherein the controller is arranged on the helmet body, the environment detection module is electrically connected with the controller, the environment detection module is connected with an environment detection device arranged on the helmet body and is used for detecting the concentration and the temperature and the humidity of gas in the environment and transmitting signals to the controller, and the vital sign detection module is connected with a vital sign detection device arranged on the helmet body and is used for monitoring vital signs of firefighters. The helmet comprises a helmet body, wherein a face mask is arranged on the front side of the helmet body, an air inlet for connecting a respirator is arranged in the middle of the face mask, goggles are arranged on the upper portion of the face mask, a neck cape is arranged at the bottom of the helmet body and used for shielding the neck of a firefighter and preventing high-temperature substances or fragments from entering the collar.

title_en: Intelligent lifesaving swimsuit with vital sign information fusion
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent life-saving swimsuit with vital sign information fusion, which relates to the technical field of life-saving equipment and comprises a life-saving suit, wherein the left end and the right end of the life-saving suit are fixedly connected with sleeves, the life-saving suit and the sleeve structure are divided into an inner layer and an outer layer, a fixed ring is fixedly connected with a gap between the inner layer and the outer layer of the sleeve, the inner wall of the fixed ring is fixedly connected with a data line, one end of the data line far away from the fixed ring is fixedly connected with a detection head, the surface of the data line penetrates through the surface of the inner layer of the fixedly connected sleeves, the upper end of the gap between the inner layer and the outer layer of the sleeves is fixedly connected with a main control chip, a positioning module, a wireless transmission module and a power module, thereby solving the problem that the vital sign condition of a user cannot be flexibly judged by the existing life-saving swimsuit, even if some persons with poor water is difficult to float on the water surface with the help of the life-saving swimsuit, the life-saving swimsuit cannot timely inform the rescuer and cannot have the function of inflation, the rescue effect is poor.

title_en: Underground positioning helmet for coal mines
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground positioning helmet for coal mines. The helmet comprises a housing, a sight window is arranged in the housing, a fixing part is fixedly connected to the top of the sight window, a headlamp and a GPS (global positioning system) positioner are arranged on the fixing part detachably, and the headlamp comprise a headlamp base arranged at the front end of the fixing part, a storage battery arranged in the headlamp base and a lampshade connected with the headlamp base. An eyeshield guard board is arranged outside the sight window rotationally. The helmet is provided with a filter air intake component which can filter dust and provide cool air, safe breathing of a wearer is facilitated, and pulmonary disease is avoided; being provided with the GPS positioner, the underground positioning helmet can transmit a distress signal in case of danger, and convenience is brought to outside rescuers to position and rescue trapped people; besides, retaining cloth is arranged at the lower opening of the helmet, so that dust such as coal ash can be avoided entering the collars of coal miners in operation, and contact of the dust foreign matters with the skin can be prevented.
assignees: FOSHAN LIANZHI XINCHUANG TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle help-asking system, vehicle-mounted emergency device and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of vehicle help-asking system, vehicle-mounted emergency device and vehicles, the system includes Wearable, vehicle-mounted emergency device and rescue terminal, Wearable is used to gather the vital signs information of occupant, and establishes wireless connection with vehicle-mounted emergency device when accident occurs for vehicle；GPS positioning module is for the real-time location information for obtaining vehicle；Communication module is used to establish wireless connection with Wearable when accident occurs for vehicle；Control module is used for when accident occurs for definite vehicle, the location information of vehicle is obtained by GPS positioning module, and pass through the vital signs information that communication module obtains occupant from Wearable, while the warning message comprising vital signs information and location information is sent to rescue terminal by communication module.The vehicle help-asking system of the embodiment provides the vital signs information of occupant, facilitates rescuer and carries out related medical preparation according to vital signs information, is conducive to sue and labour in time, avoid delay treatment opportunity.

title_en: Positive pressure fire-fighting air respirator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a positive-pressure fire-fighting air respirator, which comprises a flame-retardant garment, an air bottle and a mask; gas cylinder fixing frameworks are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the flame-retardant clothes; the flame-retardant clothes are internally provided with fillers, the inner side of the flame-retardant clothes is provided with a detachable heating and refrigerating inner container, and a high-brightness guide lamp is arranged at the chest position; the air bottle is a quick-change carbon fiber composite bottle and is fixed with the flame-retardant clothes in a sticking way; an air supply valve is arranged on the face mask, a pipeline is arranged between the air bottles, a control panel is arranged at one end of the pipeline, and a pressure alarm device is arranged inside the pipeline. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the anti-smashing and anti-puncturing filling material filled by high-strength fibers and composite materials and the flame-retardant clothes provided with the detachable heating and refrigerating inner containers effectively avoid the danger to the safety of rescuers and rescued people caused by sudden dropping of sundries and overhigh or overlow temperature in the rescue; the design of more lightweight utilizes intelligently, has guaranteed fire fighter's personal safety, and is practical convenient, and easy operation can use widely by a large scale.

title_en: Method and system of sensor-based smart unlocking of a firefighter air replenishment system
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and a system of sensor-based smart unlocking of a firefighter air replenishment system. A safety system of an occupiable structure includes a breathable-air supply system to facilitate delivery of breathable air from a source of compressed air, and a fill station in a fire-rated evacuation area of the occupiable structure to supply the breathable air to an emergency personnel. The safety system also includes a smart lock associated with the breathable-air supply system to automatically unlock one or more location(s) of the breathable-air supply system usable by the emergency personnel to access the breathable air during an emergency state of the occupiable structure, and a sensor associated with the breathable-air supply system to detect the emergency state of the occupiable structure.

title_en: CPR first aid gloves
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of first-aid equipment, in particular to a CPR first-aid glove, which is integrally shaped like a half-sleeve glove and comprises a glove inner layer and a glove outer layer, wherein the outer side of a thumb of the glove is open from top to bottom, the edge of a tiger mouth of the glove is open from the thumb end to the forefinger end, and magic tapes are symmetrically arranged on the edges of the two openings; a film pressure sensor, a main control board, a Bluetooth and GPS positioning chip, an OLED screen, an OLED indicator lamp, an electromagnetic induction type charger, an MP3 player and a buzzer are arranged between the inner layer and the outer layer of the half-sleeved glove; the heart pressing schematic diagram is arranged on the palm center surface; the wrist pulse position of the half-sleeve glove is provided with an oximeter and a heart rate monitor biosensor; the utility model designs a CPR emergency device which can be carried by a patient, when the glove monitors that the heart of the patient is abnormal, the glove can send an alarm to attract attention, and when a rescuer rescues, the voice broadcasting system can guide CPR operation of the rescuer and assist the rescuer in performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation on the patient.

title_en: Method for providing gps-based water rescue service
title_ko: Gps 기반 수상 구조 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for providing a GPS-based water rescue service, the method comprising the steps of: receiving rescue request data through a user terminal having received a pairing request from Bluetooth mounted on an automatic inflatable vest when the automatic inflatable vest inflates; receiving GPS coordinates included in the rescue request data at a preconfigured interval and storing the received GPS coordinates and the user terminal; transmitting the rescue request data to a rescue terminal that manages an area including the GPS coordinates; transmitting biometric data included in the rescue request data and the GPS coordinates to the rescue terminal at a preconfigured interval; and when a position of the rescue terminal and a position of the user terminal are within a preconfigured radius, transmitting a control signal to the user terminal so that the user terminal sounds a rescuer search alarm.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 GPS 기반 수상 구조 서비스 제공 방법이 제공되며, 자동 팽창식 조끼에 장착된 블루투스로부터 자동 팽창식 조끼가 팽창됨에 따라 페어링 요청을 수신한 사용자 단말을 통하여 구조 요청 데이터를 수신하는 단계, 구조 요청 데이터에 포함된 GPS 좌표를 기 설정된 간격으로 수신 및 사용자 단말과 저장하는 단계, GPS 좌표를 포함하는 구역을 관할하는 구조 단말로 구조 요청 데이터를 전송하는 단계, 구조 요청 데이터에 포함된 생체 데이터 및 GPS 좌표를 구조 단말로 기 설정된 간격으로 전송하는 단계, 및 구조 단말의 위치와 사용자 단말의 위치가 기 설정된 반경 내인 경우, 사용자 단말로 구조자 찾기 알람을 울리도록 제어 신호를 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Building electrification alarm device and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building electrification alarm device and a using method thereof, and the building electrification alarm device comprises a fire-fighting stair body, wherein an alarm box is arranged at the top end of the fire-fighting stair body, a fire-fighting mechanism is arranged on the end surface where the alarm box is arranged, an emergency box is arranged on the side wall of the fire-fighting stair body, a controller is connected with an integrated control module, the input end of the integrated control module is connected with a data acquisition module, the output end of the integrated control module is respectively connected with a voice broadcast module, an alarm module and a wireless transmission module, the output end of the wireless transmission module is connected with a wireless receiving module, and the output end of the wireless receiving module is. When a fire occurs, the data acquisition module rapidly drives the alarm module to alarm after detecting the fire, people on the warning floor take refuge, trapped people send distress signals to the control room through the emergency keys, the fire fighters can know the positions of the trapped people conveniently, and the fire fighting stair has better alarm and rescue effects.

title_en: System for tracing location using rf
title_ko: 알에프를 이용한 위치 추적 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for tracking a location using RF is provided to grasp the current location of a user, thereby reducing installation costs. CONSTITUTION: An RF transmitter(110) transmits an RF signal indicating the current location of a user, and altitude data, and biometric data thereof through a transmitting antenna. An RF receiver(130) processes the RF signal, the altitude data, and the biometric data received from the transmitting antenna of the RF transmitter. A central management server(140) checks the RF signal, the altitude data, and the biometric data in real time.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 RF를 이용한 위치 추적 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 사용자의 현재 위치에 대한 RF 신호와 이 현재 위치에 대한 고도 데이터, 사용자의 체온 및 맥박에 대한 생체 데이터를 송신 안테나를 통해 송출하는 RF 송신기; 상기 RF 송신기의 상기 송신 안테나로부터 수신받은 상기 RF 신호, 상기 고도 데이터 및 상기 생체 데이터를 연산 작업하는 RF 수신기; 및 상기 RF 수신기와 연동하여 이 RF 수신기에서 연산 작업이 이루어진 상기 RF 신호, 상기 고도 데이터 및 상기 생체 데이터를 실시간으로 확인하는 중앙 관리 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 RF를 이용한 위치 추적 시스템을 제공한다. 
     본 발명에 의하면, VIP 등의 중요 인물, 어린이, 위험한 공사현장의 작업자, 화재 현장이 소방대원 및 군인 등의 사용자들의 위치 파악을 RF 태그에 부여된 신호의 식별을 통해 현재 위치를 파악하는 위치 추적 시스템을 제공함으로써, 설치 비용을 절감하는 효과가 있다. 
       
     위치, 추적, RF, 무선 송신, 무선 수신, 실내

title_en: A kind of field exploration footwear
abstract_en: A kind of field exploration footwear.The invention discloses field exploration footwear, including sole and vamp, sole bottom be provided with dismountable grab ground shoe tack, sole is internally located at vola and heel position is embedded with foot pedal type generator, sole is internally located at arch of foot position and is embedded with and fills electrical storage device, fills electrical storage device and is connected with foot pedal type generator circuit；Being embedded with radio positioner and urgency signal discharger in the interlayer of vamp, the front end of vamp is provided with illuminator, radio positioner, urgency signal discharger and illuminator all with fill electrical storage device circuit and be connected.By being set to detachable and Height Adjustable grab ground nail by grabbing ground nail, during so that use this exploration shoe in different environments, all reach the state of the most comfortable.By arranging foot pedal type generator, filling electrical storage device and radio positioner and urgency signal discharger, under emergency case, and during without mobile communication signal, distress signal can be sent, and rescuer can be allowed to understand person for help's location.
assignees: HUNAN DAPING'AN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Portable smart CPR device with AI algorithms
title_ko: Ai 알고리즘이 적용된 휴대형 스마트 심폐소생술 장치
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a portable smart cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) device applied with an AI algorithm that enables the implementation for cardiopulmonary resuscitation and additional functions to be easily progressed, and enables feedback for the cardiopulmonary resuscitation to be clearly delivered to the rescuer. Provided is a portable smart CPR device applied with the AI algorithm comprising: a body part; a feedback part embedded in the body part and partially exposed, wherein feedback information is confirmed by visual and auditory data; a defibrillator part embedded in the body part and formed in a detachable structure, wherein an electric shock is implemented to a user; an electrode sensor part embedded in the body part and partially exposed, wherein a vital sign of the user is obtained by being in contact with the user, and comprising a plurality of electrodes and sensors to which the electric shock of the defibrillator part is transmitted to the user; and a remote monitoring part located at a separate place and collecting and analyzing the vital sign.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 심폐소생술 장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 환자에 대한 정보가 수집 및 분석되는 AI 알고리즘으로부터 환자에 대한 심폐소생술의 피드백 정보가 획득되고, 추가적으로 AI 알고리즘에서 분석된 정보를 바탕으로 전기충격이 진행되어 전문지식이 없는 구조자가 응급 환자에 대한 심폐소생술을 효율적이면서도 스마트하게 실시될 수 있는 AI 알고리즘이 적용된 휴대형 스마트 심폐소생술 장치에 관한 것이다. 
상기한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 AI 알고리즘이 적용된 휴대형 스마트 심폐소생술 장치에 있어서, 몸체부; 상기 몸체부에 내장되어 일부가 노출되되, 피드백 정보가 시각 및 청각데이터로 확인되는 피드백부; 상기 몸체부에 내장되어 분리가능 구조로 형성되되, 사용자에게 전기충격이 실시되는 제세동부; 상기 몸체부에 내장되어 일부가 노출되되, 사용자에게 접촉되어 사용자의 바이탈사인이 획득되고, 상기 제세동부의 전기 충격이 사용자에게 전달되는 복수개의 전극 및 센서가 포함되는 전극센서부; 및 별도의 장소에 위치되되, 상기 바이탈사인이 수집 및 분석되는 원격모니터링부;가 포함되는 것을 기술적 요지로 한다.

title_en: Bracket systems for storing and deploying articles of equipment
abstract_en: A bracket system is provided for the storage and retrieval of an article of equipment such as a self-contained breathing apparatus of the type used by firefighters and other first responders to provide breathing air during firefighting and other emergency operations. The bracket system securely stores the article of equipment in a position at which the article of equipment has an upside down, or inverted orientation, facing the back of the storage area. The bracket system is configured to articulate in a manner that positions the article of equipment in a lowered position at which the article of equipment has an upright orientation, facing the user, so that the user can retrieve the article of equipment.

title_en: Method for determining person to be rescued and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a person to be rescued and a mobile terminal, which are used for solving the problem that the position and vital signs of the person to be rescued are determined inaccurately in the prior art. The scheme provided by the invention comprises the following steps: acquiring the position of the electronic equipment in the target area; obtaining vital sign information through the electronic equipment, wherein the vital sign information is used for representing vital signs of a person to be rescued; and determining the target person to be rescued according to the position of the electronic equipment and the vital sign information. According to the scheme of the embodiment of the invention, the accurate position and the vital sign of the person to be rescued can be obtained, so that the target person to be rescued can be determined, the rescue plan can be conveniently made for the target person to be rescued by the rescuers, the rescue can be efficiently and quickly implemented, the rescue success probability is improved, and the danger faced by the rescuers is reduced.

title_en: Ergonomic scba holder
abstract_en: Embodiments of a storage compartment for self-contained breathing apparatuses (SCBA) are provided. The storage compartment includes a deployment mechanism to facilitate efficient and ergonomic donning of the SCBA. Advantageously, the storage compartment is closed off from the cabin of a firetruck and is accessed from the exterior of the firetruck so that any chemicals that off-gas from the SCBA are contained in their own compartment separate from the interior of the firetruck's cabin.
