The SCBA are able to be deployed from the storage compartment in a variety of different ways. Each embodiment of the deployment mechanism is configured to deploy the SCBA from an elevated position within the storage compartment to an exterior position that is roughly at the level of a firefighter's back.
assignees: LACKORE JR JAMES ROGER;SPARTAN MOTORS INC

title_en: Smoke environment personnel identification apparatus
abstract_en: The apparatus consists of a self contained lighting and identification device ( 10 ) having a strap ( 104 ) for attachment to a SCBA tank. A back plate ( 58 ) and a front shield ( 62 ) are spaced apart forming a cavity for LED back-lighting, with the front shield incorporates identification indicia ( 68 ) which provides recognition of a specific firefighter. Battery containing tubes ( 72 ) act as structural pillars and are located between an upper end cap assembly ( 20 ) and a lower end cap assembly ( 86 ), utilizing tie rods ( 96 ) for attachment therebetween. Diffused light distribution tubes ( 78 ) energized by LED's are positioned adjacent to the battery tubes evenly dispersing light on each side of the apparatus, effectively penetrating a smoke environment. The upper end cap assembly incorporates a printed circuit board ( 46 ) which includes the necessary control and lighting devices, and the lower end cap has a removable bottom cover ( 90 ) allowing batteries to be replaced.

title_en: Firefighter safety management system
title_ko: 소방대원 안전관리 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방대원 안전관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난현장에 투입된 각 소방대원의 신체 일부에 착용되어 생체신호를 측정하고 상기 생체신호를 주기적으로 송신하는 생체신호측정기; 상기 소방대원에 의해 소지되어, 상기 생체신호측정기로부터 송신되는 상기 생체신호를 수신하여 현장중앙통제기로 중계하고, 그룹핑된 타 통신단말과의 상대적인 거리 데이터를 주기적으로 측정하여 상기 현장중앙통제기로 전송하는 통신단말; 상기 생체신호 및 상기 거리 데이터를 수신하고 안전관리서버로 전송하는 상기 현장중앙통제기; 및 상기 현장중앙통제기로부터 수신한 상기 소방대원의 상기 생체신호 및 상기 거리 데이터에 기초하여 상기 재난현장의 상황과 상기 소방대원의 신체활동을 모니터링하고 신체위험도를 판단하여 상기 현장중앙통제기에 제공하는 안전관리서버를 포함한다. 
이와 같이, 소방대원의 상태 및 위치를 지속적으로 모니터링하여 신체위험도를 판단함으로써 위급 상황 발생에 선제적으로 대비하고 필요한 조치를 신속하게 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system of sensor-based smart unlocking of a firefighter air replenishment system
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and a system of sensor-based smart unlocking of a firefighter air replenishment system. A safety system of an occupiable structure includes a breathable- air supply system to facilitate delivery of breathable air from a source of compressed air, and a fill station in a fire-rated evacuation area of the occupiable structure to supply the breathable air to an emergency personnel. The safety system also includes a smart lock associated with the breathable-air supply system to automatically unlock one or more location(s) of the breathable-air supply system usable by the emergency personnel to access the breathable air during an emergency state of the occupiable structure, and a sensor associated with the breathable-air supply system to detect the emergency state of the occupiable structure.

title_en: A kind of method and escape nameplate for changing display direction by controlled in wireless
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of method and escape nameplate for changing display direction by controlled in wireless, belong to public safety facilities technical field.Technical scheme is：Radio communication unit（1）, address information recording unit（3）, drive control unit（4）With emergency button（7）Respectively with information process unit（2）Connection, drive control unit（4）With display unit（5）Connection, power supply unit（6）Power supply is provided.The of the invention escape nameplate in addition to the function with conventional escape nameplate, the direction of display（Arrow direction）The wireless control signal that can be sent by safety monitoring control system is changed；By pressing emergency button distress signals and current location information are sent to safety monitoring control system.The escape nameplate is particularly suitable for public place, the blindness of personnel can be avoided to escape when disaster is run into and succoured with the search of rescuer, realizes helping fast-escape and realization precisely rescue.
assignees: HEBEI KAIENDE SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD

title_en: A system and a method of ensuring acute first aid
abstract_en: A method and a system for calling in one or more trained lay rescuers to a patient who needs basic life support, at symptoms which may be related to a cardiac arrest or other acute states, where the patient has A (airway), B (breathing), C (circulation) troubles which require acute medical intervention. The system comprises a server unit (5) which calls in voluntary trained lay rescuers (35) via their mobile telephones (7), who are recorded in the system, and who are present in the local area. These assistants are guided to the alarm position and to the nearest AED (9, 41), respectively. The health staff at the AMC is able to contact one of the trained lay rescuers telephonically via the system, until ambulance/medical aid arrives. The system and the method may moreover comprise a user module comprising a sensor unit, which e.g. detects heart rate and passes these on to a user unit which can transmit alarm signals automatically, if an abnormal heart rate is detected. Further, a server unit, a user module, an assistant unit, an AMC unit and a cabinet for storing AEDs (9) are described, which cabinets may be unlocked by a code, which is sent directly to an electronic locking circuit in the cabinet (20), or by a code which is entered by means of a keyboard on the cabinet (20), and is sent via the server (5) to an assistant unit in a message, e.g., an SMS, an MMS or a push message, or available via touching a touch screen.
assignees: FIRSTAED APS;SCHORLING PER;SCHAKOW HENRIK HANSEN;HENRIKSEN FINN LUND;HANSEN BRUNO

title_en: Alarm notification system
abstract_en: A system and method providing for ascertaining the status of a user and escalating an alarm in the event the user is ascertained to be disposed in a dangerous condition. The of the invention attempts to contact the user at a predetermined check-in time, and notifies a pre-designated third-party which may be an emergency responder such as law enforcement or other emergency contact in the event that the user fails to respond to the check in request or signals that they are in danger using an escalate feature of the invention. The system operates autonomously to notify pre-designated emergency contacts or emergency responders in the case in which a user has been rendered unable to respond. The user may identify specific individuals with whom they plan to meet and the invention may also track the user's geo-location. The invention may also monitor biometric data of the user.

title_en: mountain survivor rescue system
title_ko: 산악용 조난자 구조 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mountain survivor rescue system, and more specifically, to a mountain survivor rescue system which, when people are lost or in distress by bad weather conditions during hiking or camping, rapidly informs a rescue center of a location of people in distress from an adjacent rescue enclosure and has rescuers easily find people in distress to rescue them. In particular, the present invention relates to a mountain survivor rescue system with which a person in distress can use his/her cellphone to search a location of an adjacent rescue enclosure, charge the cellphone in the rescue enclosure to have a conversation with the rescue center, and utilize an emergency daily necessity accommodated in a supply box and maintenance partition while waiting for a rescue team such that the survival safety of the person can be ensured through taking food and maintaining a body temperature. Accordingly, the system has an advantage in that the system rapidly informs a rescue center of a location of people in distress from an adjacent rescue enclosure and has rescuers easily find people in distress to rescue them when the people were lost or in distress by bad weather conditions during hiking or camping. In particular, the system allows a person in distress to use his/her cellphone to search a location of an adjacent rescue enclosure, to charge the cellphone in the rescue enclosure to have a conversation with the rescue center, and to maintain psychological relaxation while utilizing an emergency daily necessity accommodated in a supply box and maintenance partition waiting for a rescue team, thereby ensuring the survival safety of the person through taking food and maintaining a body temperature.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 산악용 조난자 구조 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 등산 또는 캠핑 등을 하는 도중에 길을 잃거나 기상악화 등으로 조난되었을 경우에 인접한 구조함체에서 조난자의 위치를 구조센터에 신속하게 알리고 구조자들이 쉽게 조난자를 발견하여 구조할 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
특히, 조난자의 휴대전화를 이용해 인접한 구조함체의 위치를 검색할 수 있도록 하고, 구조함체에서 휴대전화를 충전해 구조센터와 대화를 주고받을 수 있도록 하면서, 구조대기 중에 보급함 및 유지보수칸에 수납된 비상생필품을 활용해 식품 섭취 및 체온유지를 통한 조난자의 생존 안전성을 확보할 수 있는 산악용 조난자 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
따라서, 등산 또는 캠핑 등을 하는 도중에 길을 잃거나 기상악화 등으로 조난되었을 경우에 인접한 구조함체에서 조난자의 위치를 구조센터에 신속하게 알리고 구조자들이 쉽게 발견하여 구조할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 
특히, 조난자의 휴대전화를 이용해 인접한 구조함체의 위치를 검색할 수 있도록 하고, 구조함체에서 휴대전화를 충전해 구조센터와 대화를 주고받을 수 있도록 하여 조난자의 심리적인 안정을 유지하면서, 구조대기 중에 보급함 및 유지보수칸에 수납된 비상생필품을 활용해 식품 섭취 및 체온유지를 통한 조난자의 생존 안전성을 확보할 수 있는 장점도 있다.

title_en: Convenient and reliable fire-fighting self-rescuer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting products, in particular to a convenient and reliable fire-fighting self-rescuer; comprises a gas cylinder assembly, a mask assembly, an air bag and a filtering system; the mask assembly is provided with a mask valve; the mask assembly is communicated with the outside through a mask valve, and the mask valve is connected with the air supply rapid switching device through an air duct; the air supply rapid switching device comprises a three-way valve body, a piston positioned in the valve body, an air bag air guide channel valve, a reset spring assembly and an air bag interface; the air bag interface is connected with the air bag; the cavity of the air supply rapid switching device is connected with the filtering system through a first one-way valve; the cavity is connected with the gas cylinder assembly through a quick connector; the invention realizes the rapid switching of three respiratory states, improves the rapid switching efficiency of the fire-fighting self-rescuer, prolongs the service time, and improves the practicability and the effectiveness of the fire-fighting self-rescuer.

title_en: A kind of pregnant woman health mechanical device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of pregnant woman health mechanical devices, its structure includes cardiotachometer main body, heat emission hole, machine socket, power switch, handwheel, differential adjusting rod, knob, presser feet elevating lever, display screen, information receiving port, transverse slat, calling set, arm placing groove, transverse slat seat inner core, and the cardiotachometer main body is equipped with heat emission hole.The beneficial effects of the utility model are equipped with calling set, can pregnant woman's heartbeat be measured by cardiotachometer in daily life, detect the physical condition of pregnant woman, once accident and side occur for pregnant woman, nobody can sue and labour, can signal be sent out by signal emission module, distress signal can be sent to the related personnel of all bound devices by signal group sending module, GPS positioning module help rescuer can be accurately positioned the position of pregnant woman and sue and labour in order to reach scene at the first time, confirm the health status of pregnant woman extremely foetus.

title_en: Fireman positioning tracking and vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of fire control, and provides a fireman positioning tracking and vital sign monitoring system. The intelligent monitoring system comprises a command terminal, a handheld terminal and a monitoring device, wherein the monitoring device comprises a positioning device for acquiring the position information of a firefighter, a vital sign monitoring device for acquiring the vital sign information of the firefighter, an audio-video device for acquiring the audio-video of a scene, a falling detection device for acquiring the falling information of the firefighter, a breathing machine air pressure monitoring device for acquiring the pressure information of a breathing machine worn by the firefighter, the handheld terminal for acquiring the information and sending the information to the command terminal, and the command terminal for receiving the information and sending the command information to the handheld terminal. The utility model can confirm the physical condition, position, fire scene dangerous grade and the like of the firefighter in real time and send corresponding command information, so that the firefighter can act according to the command information, the personal safety of the firefighter is improved, and the casualties in fire disaster extinguishing work are reduced.
assignees: RUENTEX RESCUE EQUIPMENT TECH HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: Water accident emergency response system and mehtod thereof
title_ko: 수상사고에 대한 2차 사고의 예방 및 안전 대응 시스템, 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A secondary accident prevention and safety response system for water accidents and an emergency response method thereof are disclosed. The secondary accident prevention and safety response system for water accidents according to the present invention comprises: a folding buoy mechanism; a trigger-type gas injector for injecting gas into the folding buoy mechanism in a triggering way; a GPS receiver for receiving a global positioning system (GPS) signal and calculating a current position when the folding buoy mechanism floats on the surface of the water; and a distress signal transmitter for transmitting a distress signal including the current position calculated by the GPS receiver at set intervals, thereby capable of quickly identifying the accident position and situation so as to promptly act thereon, and preventing secondary accidents of rescuers.
abstract_ko: 수상사고에 대한 2차 사고의 예방 및 안전대응 시스템 및 그 긴급 대응방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 수상사고에 대한 2차 사고의 예방 및 안전대응 시스템은, 접이식 부이기구; 격발식으로 접이식 부이기구에 가스를 주입하는 격발식 가스주입기; 접이식 부이기구가 수면 위에 부상한 경우에 GPS(Global Positioning System) 신호를 수신하여 현재위치를 계산하는 GPS 수신기; 및 설정된 주기로 GPS 수신기에 의해 계산되는 현재위치가 포함된 조난신호를 송출하는 조난신호 송출기;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SEMYUNG UNIV DIVISION OF INDUSTRY ACADEMY COOPERATION GROUP

title_en: Portable biometric monitor device for first responders and methods
abstract_en: A portable biometric monitor device for first responders including, police, fire, emergency medical technicians and paramedics is disclosed. The monitor is suitable for use in non-medical locations where monitoring may be beneficial, such as nursing homes and jails.

title_en: Send/receive apparatus for firefighter
title_ko: 소방 작업자용 송수신 장치
abstract_en: A transmission/reception device for firefighter according to an embodiment of the present invention is characterized by allowing to transmit the voice of a worker via a head voice microphone in the environment using an air breathing apparatus and a mask, and enhancing the stability against the external condition and the convenience of use by operation of a magnetic PTT switch using a magnetic field.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 소방 작업자용 송수신 장치는, 공기 호흡기와 마스크를 사용하는 환경에서 작업자의 음성을 두성진동 마이크를 통해 작업자의 음성을 전달할 수 있도록 하며, 동시에 자장을 이용한 자기 PTT 스위치의 조작을 통해 외부 환경의 영향에도 안정적이고 보다 사용편의성이 향상되도록 하는 것을 특징으로 함.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional Intelligent lifesaving clothing
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of multi-functional Intelligent lifesaving clothing, it includes clothes body, neckpillow is equipped at the rear neck of clothes body, on rear side of neckpillow and top surface is equipped with solar energy photovoltaic panel, embedded with the battery being connected with solar energy photovoltaic panel in the filler of neckpillow, clothes body forward upper is equipped with velcro, auxiliary buckling band is bonded in velcro, middle part is equipped with middle part cingulum on front side of clothes body, it is connected by a snap between two middle part cingulums, the alarm switch being connected with alarm device is equipped in buckle, clothes body two sides of the bottom are equipped with water induction device, controller is equipped in neckpillow, two side lower part of clothes body is equipped with waterproof bag.Distress signal can be sent for a long time on the water surface using the life jacket after this programme, position and sue and labour convenient for rescuer, can be used for dock operation clothes, in order to prevent the generation of fortuitous event.

title_en: Autonomous life monitor system
abstract_en: A life alert system which continually monitors a subject's heart rate via a wearable device such as a smart watch and automatically alerts call center personnel to engage emergency responders in the event of a cardiac incident, and provide the location of the subject. In response to measured physiological parameters, besides alerting the call center the watch attempts to communicate with the subject. After an emergency responder has been dispatched, the watch also displays medical information about the subject, providing an electronic “medic alert” bracelet function.

title_en: Device for position tracking and monitoring of endangered rescue personnel in indoor diseaster environment using wireless communication and method thereof
title_ko: 무선통신을 이용한 실내 재난환경에서의 위험에 처한 구조대원의 위치파악 및 모니터링 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a device for acquiring and monitoring a position of a rescue worker in danger in an indoor disaster environment using wireless communication comprises: a monitoring terminal including a bioactivity monitoring sensor unit to collect bioactivities via Bluetooth low energy (BLE) communication between a temperature sensor and a heart rate sensor, an indoor environment position tracking unit to use an acceleration sensor to track a position in an indoor environment, and a remote server communication unit to perform communication with a remote server via wireless communication to be carried on the body of a rescue worker; a server including a bioactivity monitoring unit to collect, store, and monitor the bioactivities and recognize a dangerous state, and an indoor position tracking unit to store position tracking data; and a search terminal including a sensing unit to determine whether the rescue worker is present or absent, a position tracking unit to track a position of a rescue worker and track a direction of a rescue worker in danger, and a direction display lamp to notify a direction to find a rescue worker in danger.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선통신을 이용한 실내 재난환경에서의 위험에 처한 구조대원의 위치파악 및 모니터링 장치에 관한 것으로, 온도센서와 심박센서간 BLE(Bluetooth Low Energy)통신을 통해 생체활동을 수집하는 생체활동 모니터링 센서부, 가속도 센서를 이용하여 실내 환경에서의 위치추적을 담당하는 실내환경 위치추적부, 및 무선통신을 통해 원격 서버와 통신을 수행하는 원격 서버통신부로 구성되어 구조대원 몸에 휴대하는 모니터링 단말; 상기 생체활동을 수집 및 저장, 모니터링, 위험상태 인지를 담당하는 생체활동 모니터링부, 및 위치추적 데이터를 저장하는 실내 위치 추적부로 구성된 서버; 및 상기 구조대원이 있는지 없는지를 판별하는 감지부, 구조대원의 위치를 추적하고 위험에 처한 구조대원의 방향을 추적해 내는 위치 추적부, 및 위험에 처한 구조대원을 찾기 위한 방향을 알리는 방향 표시등으로 구성된 탐색 단말;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: CPR assistance device and method for determining the depth of a chest compression of a patient
abstract_en: A cardiopulmonary resuscitation assistance device for use by a rescuer in performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation on a patient. By using rescuer vital signs, an image subsection from the patient facing camera including the rescuer's hands can be identified. After correctly identifying the image subsection including the rescuer's hand, the chest compression depth and frequency can be derived from the patient facing camera by tracking the distance between the patient facing camera and the rescuer's hand.

title_en: Autonomous life monitor system
abstract_en: A life alert system which continually monitors a subject's heart rate via a wearable device such as a smart watch and automatically alerts call center personnel to engage emergency responders in the event of a cardiac incident, and provide the location of the subject. In response to measured physiological parameters, besides alerting the call center the watch attempts to communicate with the subject. After an emergency responder has been dispatched, the watch also displays medical information about the subject, providing an electronic "medic alert" bracelet function.

title_en: Rescue scene intelligent detection system
abstract_en: The application provides a rescue scene intelligent detection system, which comprises a wireless communication module and an intelligent detection module, wherein the wireless communication module is used for receiving and sending voice, data and video information, and the intelligent detection module comprises an environment sensor, a vital sign detector, a data processing unit and a camera device; the base station equipment is used for receiving and processing voice, data and video signals from the firefighter terminal and comprises fixed base station equipment and mobile base station equipment, wherein the fixed base station equipment is positioned in a command part, and the mobile base station equipment is integrated with the unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the mobile base station equipment, the mobile base station equipment is integrated with the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the appointed area can be rapidly deployed in a short time through the mobility and the flexibility of the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the communication requirements of different scenes are met, and the high-efficiency communication quality of the fire disaster and the command part is ensured.

title_en: Internet-of-things-based rescuer safety protection and monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internet-of-things-based rescuer safety protection and monitoring system and an internet-of-things-based rescuer safety protection and monitoring method. The system comprises a central monitoring system and rescuer terminal equipment. The central monitoring system comprises a computer and a short message communication module; the short message communication module is connected with a serial port of a computer; the rescuer terminal equipment comprises embedded gateway equipment, a body posture state detection sensor module, an impact detection sensor module, a heart rate detection sensor module, a protection module, a safety airbag protective clothing and an energy supply module; if a rescuer is crushed by a heavy object or rolls over or drops, the safety airbag protective clothing worn by the rescuer can be timely opened so as to effectively protect the rescuer and reduce the extent of injury; the body state of the rescuer can be collected in real time by using the internet-of-things in a rescue process of the rescuer, the basic information, the positioning information and the safety state information on the rescuer can be uninterruptedly and periodically transmitted to the central monitoring system through network, and the pieces of information are display by the central monitoring system in real time.

title_en: Personal monitoring and response system
abstract_en: A system is disclosed herein. The system includes a server, a software-application and a wearable-device. The system includes virtual groups to allows guardians or caretakers to identify/be alerted of any issues with a monitored subject. Events are triggered by various sensed parameters including heart rate, location, medication, etc. Notifications and alerts are sent through the software-application to the guardians and may be viewed by first responders via a First Response Portal. The system is useful for utilizing social grouping to enable family members or close friends to provide caregiver ability to a subject remotely.

title_en: Be applied to cervical ring of deep water fleing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neck ring applied to deep water escape, which comprises a ring body. The inner rod and the loop bar are movably sleeved on the loop body, the sodium azide stored in the loop tube is extruded by collision by utilizing the pressing plate connected to the inner rod, so that the sodium azide can quickly form a large amount of nitrogen to fill the air bag when stressed, and the quickly expanded air bag provides buoyancy for a drowning person, so that the drowning person can be separated from a deep water environment; the elastic reinforcing ribs are arranged in the ring body, so that the phenomenon that the neck of a drowning person is blocked by the ring body under stress is avoided, and the structural stability of the neck ring is ensured; through installing flash light, locator, pulse inductor and megaphone on the circle body respectively to implement the control to the physical conditions and the positional information of neck collar person of wearing, outwards send distress signal in drowned accident's very first time, help the rescuer to fix a position it fast, thereby carry out rescue and rescue measures in the shortest time.

title_en: Method and system of sensor-based smart unlocking of a firefighter air replenishment system
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and a system of sensor-based smart unlocking of a firefighter air replenishment system. A safety system of an occupiable structure includes a breathable- air supply system to facilitate delivery of breathable air from a source of compressed air, and a fill station in a fire-rated evacuation area of the occupiable structure to supply the breathable air to an emergency personnel. The safety system also includes a smart lock associated with the breathable-air supply system to automatically unlock one or more location(s) of the breathable-air supply system usable by the emergency personnel to access the breathable air during an emergency state of the occupiable structure, and a sensor associated with the breathable-air supply system to detect the emergency state of the occupiable structure.

title_en: Smart firefighting safety equipment
title_ko: 스마트 소방 안전장비
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart firefighting safety device, which comprises: a biometric sensing signal device for sensing a sensed biosignal to transmit the same to the outside; a biometric sensing unit for sensing and transmitting the biosignal to the biometric sensing signal device; and a control unit for controlling the biometric sensing signal device and the biometric sensing unit. The biometric sensing signal device includes: a danger signal output unit for enabling a user to recognize a sensed biosignal; and a communication unit for transmitting the biosignal sensed by the biometric sensing signal device to a situation headquarter. The smart firefighting safety device is mounted on a device of a firefighter input for fire suppression to sense a current location, breathing and movement of the firefighter, and can transmit a safety situation of the firefighter to a command and control center to check a safety status of the firefighter.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 소장 안전장비에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 감지된 생체신호를 감지하여 외부로 전달하는 생체감지신호기와, 상기 생체감지신호기에 생체신호를 감지하여 생체신호를 전달하는 생체감지부와,상기 생체감지신호기와 생체감지부를 제어하는 제어부로 구성되며, 상기 생체감지신호기에는 감지된 생체신호를 사용자가 인지할 수 있도록 하는 위험신호출력부와, 상기 생체감지신호기에 감지된 생체신호를 상황본부에 전송하는 통신부로 구성되어, 화재진압에 투입되는 소방관의 장비에 장착되어 소방관의 현재 위치 및 소방관의 호흡과 움직임을 감지하여 소방관의 안전상황을 지휘통제소로 송출할 수 있도록 하여 소방관의 안전 상태를 확인할 수 있다.

title_en: Portable lifesaving device and lifesaving management system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable lifesaving device. The portable lifesaving device comprises a positioning module, a communication module, a warning module and a distress call module. The positioning module includes a GPS positioning unit and/or a GSM positioning unit, a water sound positioning unit and/or a WiFi positioning unit which are connected with the communication module and transmit acquired positioning information to the communication module. The communication module receives alarm information and triggers the warning module to give a warning. When the distress call module is triggered, the communication module transmits the identification information of the lifesaving device and a distress signal to a management system. The utility model further discloses a lifesaving management system. By adopting the device and system provided by the utility model, the time from when the distress call module is triggered to when a server terminal gets the distress information is greatly shortened, thereby saving time for rescuers, and providing strong guarantee for the safety of tourists' lives and properties.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting thermostatic suit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent firefighter uniform in the technical field of firefighter products, which comprises a firefighter uniform main body, wherein the firefighter uniform main body comprises an inner liner, a heat insulation fireproof layer and an anti-puncturing outer layer which are arranged from inside to outside, a cavity is arranged between the inner liner and the heat insulation fireproof layer, a first circulating pipe is installed in the cavity, a water conveying pipe is communicated with the first circulating pipe and is positioned at the upper left end of the firefighter uniform main body, a temperature sensor connected with the inner liner is arranged at the bottom end of the left side outside the first circulating pipe, a shell is installed on the front end surface of the firefighter uniform main body, a baffle is connected in the shell, a cooling component is installed in the cavity, a circulating component is installed on the shell, and by arranging the first circulating pipe, the water conveying pipe, the temperature sensor, a remote communication module, a controller, the cooling component and the circulating component, the body temperature of the fire fighter can be kept at a constant temperature.
assignees: FIRE HUNTING AND FIRE FIGHTING SCIENCE AND TECH JIANGSU LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: High-risk place safety guarantee system of digital wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-risk safety guaranteeing system of a digital wireless sensor network, and the high-risk place safety guarantee system is used for guaranteeing safety of firefighters, relief workers and the like in the high-risk places such as fire scenes and mine accident sites. The system comprises a wristwatch module, a helmet module, an air breathing module, a control centre module and a handheld PDA (personal digital assistant) module. According to the invention, the vital signs of people in the high-risk place and the field environment are monitored in real time with the IOT (Internet of things) technology, the real-time tracking and positioning of people in the high-risk place are realized, the field command and scheduling in the high-risk place are accomplished, and the life safety of the people is guaranteed.
assignees: JIANGSU RIFETUNE SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Life body feature detection and identification method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a life body feature detection and identification method for a rescue robot, which is used for solving the technical problem that rescue fails due to complex environment of the existing rescue robot. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing an O-shaped detection area by taking the position of a rescue robot as a starting point, and starting an obstacle avoidance system of the rescue robot; secondly, performing rescue scanning on the O-shaped detection area by using a carbon dioxide detector to obtain a target point set; then, performing target detection on the target point set by using an infrared detector, and determining a target point to be rescued; and finally, identifying a target point to be rescued by using the radar life detector in a third stage, determining the specific position of the rescuers, sending a distress signal by using a controller of the rescue robot, and timely informing rescue workers of rescuing. According to the invention, multiple detectors are combined, so that the identification precision is improved, the rescue time is shortened, and the rescue robot has the capability of efficiently and accurately detecting the vital signs of a human body.

title_en: Air breathing device integrating head-up display function and communication function
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air breathing device integrating a head-up display function and a communication function. The air breathing device comprises a backing tool, an air cylinder tightening belt is arranged on the upper middle portion of the backing tool, and a strap assembly is arranged on the lower portion of the backing tool. A sending end box of a head-up display device is arranged at the position, located in the middle of the strap assembly, of the lower portion of the backing tool, the sending end box comprises a left box body and a right box body, the backing tool is connected with a pressure reducer which is connected with a pressure reducer end medium pressure pipe, a duplex female rapid insert is connected between the pressure reducer end medium pressure pipe and the other end of an output line above the right box body, the duplex female rapid insert is in butt joint with a duplex male rapid insert which is connected with an air supply valve, the receiving display end of the head-up display device is arranged on the air supply valve, and the air supply valve is connected with a full face mask; a communication sound amplification device is arranged on the full face mask; the left box body is connected with the display device through a cable. The air breathing device reduces the weight of the communication full face mask, lines on the chest of a firefighter are simplified, the phenomenon that a hook and a line pipe intersect when the air breathing device is used is greatly avoided, the safety is improved, and the air breathing device is attractive and convenient to use.
assignees: FENAN INDUSTRY AND TRADE SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Water area alarm method and device based on companion lines, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an  companion-peer-based water area alarm method which comprises a command terminal and a plurality of peer rescuer terminals, wherein the command terminal is connected with the terminals through an ad hoc network, the command terminal acquires positioning data of the terminals, the terminals acquire vital sign parameters of corresponding rescuers, the terminals send the positioning data and the vital sign parameters to the command terminal through the ad hoc network, the command terminal receives an alarm signal sent by the terminals and/or the command terminal generates an alarm signal for the corresponding terminals through analyzing the positioning data or the vital sign parameters, and the command terminal sends a withdrawal instruction to the alarm terminal and/or the command terminal analyzes the vital sign parameters and the positioning data of each terminal and sends rescue instructions to other peer terminals.
assignees: SHENZHEN RONGSHENG INTELLIGENCE EQUIPMENT CO LTD;GLOBEEZ GUANGDONG EMERGENCY SAFETY TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Emergency messaging from a locked mobile device
abstract_en: The disclosed system provides a facility to enable an emergency messaging session on a locked mobile device. In response to receiving a request on a locked mobile device to initiate an emergency messaging session, the system displays an interface that may enable a user of the mobile device to select a type of emergency and/or enter a customized message to be transmitted to an emergency services provider. The displayed interface additionally may include options to automatically or manually send specified types of information to an emergency responder, such as a physical location of the mobile device or medical, personal contact, or residence information of the user of the mobile device. While an emergency messaging session is in progress, the disclosed system may continually send updated information to the selected emergency provider, such as a location of the mobile device or biometric information associated with a user of the mobile device.

title_en: Rescue site intelligent detection system and application
abstract_en: The application provides a rescue scene intelligent detection system and application, wherein a firefighter terminal device comprises a wireless communication module and an intelligent detection module, wherein the wireless communication module is used for receiving and sending voice, data and video information, and the intelligent detection module comprises an environment sensor, a vital sign detector, a data processing unit and a camera device; the base station equipment is used for receiving and processing voice, data and video signals from the firefighter terminal and comprises fixed base station equipment and mobile base station equipment, wherein the fixed base station equipment is positioned in a command part, and the mobile base station equipment is integrated with the unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the mobile base station equipment, the mobile base station equipment is integrated with the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the appointed area can be rapidly deployed in a short time through the mobility and the flexibility of the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the communication requirements of different scenes are met, and the high-efficiency communication quality of the fire disaster and the command part is ensured.
assignees: SHENZHEN HONGJIALI FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Air breathing apparatus with safety alarm function
title_ko: 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air breathing apparatus provided with a safety alarm function, implemented in the air breathing apparatus to enable a user to easily check whether firefighting (life rescue) members or scuba divers survive and are in an abnormal state, and where they are. The apparatus comprises: a GPS module acquiring location information via a GPS satellite; an air breathing detection sensor detecting breath of a user; a residue sensing unit measuring an amount of air or oxygen stored in a high pressure tank of the air breathing apparatus; a control unit determining a state of the user according to breath detection signals detected by the breath detection sensor, controlling display of residue according to the remaining amount of air or oxygen sensed by the residue sensing unit, and controlling state signals of the user to be transmitted; a first and a second regulator regulating pressure of compressed air or oxygen according to control of the control unit; and a wireless transmitter wirelessly transmitting the state signals of the user according to control of the control unit.
abstract_ko: 호흡장치에 장착되어 화재진압(인명구조) 대원 또는 스킨스쿠버 다이버들의 생존 여부, 이상 여부 및 위치를 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 한 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치에 관한 것으로서, GPS 위성을 통해 위치 정보를 획득하는 GPS모듈; 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 호흡 감지 센서; 상기 호흡장치의 고압용기에 저장된 공기량 또는 산소량을 측정하는 잔량 감지부; 상기 호흡 감지 센서에서 감지한 호흡 감지 신호에 따라 사용자의 상태를 판별하고, 상기 잔량 감지부에서 감지한 공기 잔량 또는 산소 잔량에 따라 잔량 표시를 제어하며, 사용자의 상태 신호를 전송토록 제어하는 제어부; 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 압축 공기 또는 압축 산소의 압력을 조정하는 제1 및 제2 레귤레이터; 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 사용자의 상태 신호를 무선신호로 전송하는 무선 송신기를 포함하여, 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치를 구현한다.

title_en: Opening and closing mechanism based on display unit in fire mask
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an opening and closing mechanism based on a display unit in a fire mask, which belongs to the technical field of fire masks. The opening and closing mechanism can control the display device to be far away from or close to the front of the eyes of the firefighter, and when the display device is not needed in front of the eyes of the firefighter, the normal sight of the firefighter is prevented from being disturbed; when the display device is needed in front of the fire fighter, the infrared image, vital signs of the fire fighter, position information, temperature information and the like can be displayed on the fire scene.
assignees: ANHUI ZHONGHANG DISPLAY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency gps signal system
abstract_en: An emergency GPS signal system includes a user transmitting an emergency distress signal from an internet-connected device. The emergency distress signal has information concerning the emergency, as inputted or selected by the user, along with location information. The location information may be obtained via GPS, wireless signals, or may be preprogrammed. Utilizing the emergency GPS signal system allows a user a discreet (e.g., inaudible) approach to notifying emergency responders of an emergency situation and its specific location.

title_en: System and method for in-structure delivery of air for filling of breathing apparatus
abstract_en: An in-structure air delivery system comprises a control panel and a plurality of air delivery lines. The control panel is located at a first location in the structure and has an air supply inlet. Each air delivery line extends from the control panel to a different location in the structure. Valves are configured to selectively control the flow of air through each of the air delivery lines. In a method of use, a high pressure air supply such as a portable compressor is connected to the inlet of the system. Air is selectively delivered to one or more of the delivery lines. A control unit is connected to the outlet of the delivery line. Air is supplied to the control unit. The control unit is used to regulate the flow of air to a component of breathing equipment, such as to a firefighter's breathing equipment air cylinder to be re-filled.

title_en: Firefighter positioning searching system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a firefighter positioning searching system and method and belongs to the technical field of fire control and rescue. The firefighter positioning searching system and method can monitor firefighters in a burning building, and automatically determine the positions of the firefighters after the firefighters keep motionless for a certain time. According to the technical scheme, the firefighter positioning searching system comprises a transmitting device used for transmitting signals, a fixed searching and a portable searching device, the fixed searching and the portable searching device receives the signals, the transmitting device comprises a first power source, a rest switch and an electromagnetic signal transmitter, the first power source, the rest switch and the electromagnetic signal transmitter are connected in sequence to form a main loop, the fixed searching device comprises a second power source, a first beam concentration flashlight, a plane electromagnetic searching detector and a vertical electromagnetic searching detector, the second power source, the first beam concentration flashlight, the plane electromagnetic searching detector and the vertical electromagnetic searching detector are all connected with a first processor, the portable searching device comprises a third power source, a second plane electromagnetic searching detector and a second beam concentration flashlight, and the third power source, the second plane electromagnetic searching detector and the second beam concentration flashlight are connected with a second processor. The firefighter positioning searching system and method are used for monitoring and rescuing firefighters on a fire fighting site.

title_en: Portable self-supporting fire fighting equipment station
abstract_en: A portable fire fighter equipment station for use at a fire fighting scene is provided. The self-supporting frame comprising three support members pivotally connected to each other at one end, the self-supporting frame configurable into an in-use configuration with non-pivotally connected ends of the support members spaced apart to form a tripod and the self-supporting frame configurable into a transportation configuration with the three support members moved into close proximity. Each firefighter station is attached to one of the support members of the self-supporting frame and has a seating surface configurable into an in-use configuration to support a firefighter in a seated position, and a transportation configuration with the seating surface in close proximity to the self-supporting frame. A breathing apparatus holder is provided for securing an air bottle to the support member of the respective firefighter station.

title_en: A kind of vital emergent event calls for help intelligent leather belt
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of vital emergent event to call for help intelligent leather belt, including belt body, call device is installed on the belt body, the call device includes processing unit, heart rate sensor, GPS locator, alarm unit, the heart rate sensor, GPS locator, alarm unit electrically connect with the processing unit, and the heart rate sensor is used for the heart rate for monitoring user.The utility model on belt by installing call device, when user plane is to great burst accident, the Psychological phobia according to caused by user, user's heart rate data is collected using heart rate sensor, when the heart rate data collected exceedes preset value, sent an SOS by processing unit automatic control alarm unit and dial rescuing telephone, while sent customer position information to rescuer by GPS locator；The apparatus structure is simple, practical, it is not necessary to increases the technology difficulty of conventional belt, is easy to mass produce and promotes.

title_en: A kind of fire helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire helmets, including helmet shell, helmet inner casing and wind shield, wind shield is connect by buckle structure with helmet shell, helmet shell is equipped with thermal insulation layer, noise control layer, anticollision layer and buffer layer successively from outside to inside, helmet inner casing is equipped with mounting box, and controller, positioning device, wireless communication module, power module, heartbeat detection device and apparatus for testing body temperature are equipped in mounting box.The utility model is provided simultaneously with heat-insulated, noise control, anticollision and the function of damping, feature-rich various, and thermal insulation layer is set to the outermost layer of helmet shell, and the helmet integrally will not easily be deformed because of high temperature, and service life is long；In addition, the utility model can monitor the physiology sign of fire fighter in real time and be accurately positioned, to make quick response to emergency episode, practicability is high, can be widely applied to fire-fighting equipment technical field.

title_en: Fire fight safety device suitable for firefighter
abstract_en: A fire fighter safety device adapted for firefighters, comprising a control center PC, and at least one fire tactical watch in wireless communication with the control center PC, the fire tactical watch comprising: a main control chip; the storage chip is connected with the main control chip to provide running memory and data storage; the communication chip is connected with the main control chip; the positioning chip is connected with the main control chip; the power supply audio frequency collection chip is connected with the main control chip to provide a power supply management function and an audio frequency encoding and decoding function, and is connected with a battery, a loudspeaker and a microphone; the sensor hub is connected with the main control chip and is connected with at least one sensor for collecting heart rate, blood oxygen, blood pressure and temperature data and acquiring movement posture analysis data. The intelligent fire fighter positioning system is internally provided with the positioning chip module, realizes accurate positioning by combining a wireless communication function, monitors the health signs of fire fighters in real time by an intelligent means, and provides safety guarantee for fire fighters in a fire scene.

title_en: A kind of unmanned fire boat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of unmanned fire boats, including hull, fire-fighting system, camera system, master control system；Dynamic positioning system, communication system and UAV system.It sues and labours scheme are as follows: unmanned fire boat passes through the position that communication system receives ship in distress or waterfront.Signal, which is sent, in remote terminal by rescuer carries out extinguishing operation.Operation remote terminal equipment connection UAV system flies small drone to fire source top to safe distance and opens camera and high-power megaphone, is monitored and lifesaving guides work.Program advantage is: the unmanned fire boat real-time reception distress signal and can reach scene of fire；The ship is also equipped with automatic fire extinguisher, the uncertainty for greatly reducing the risk artificially put out a fire and avoiding manual operation；Have the grasp scene the condition of a disaster of the closer distance of UAV system, effectively raises the success rate and efficiency of the disaster relief.Whole system is intuitive, operating efficiency is high, degree of safety is high, has biggish application prospect.

title_en: Cooling water pockets for fire fighting
title_ko: 소방용 냉각수포켓
abstract_en: A fire-fighting cooling water pocket is disclosed. The fire-fighting cooling water pocket is used by being attached to or detached from a fire-fighting air respirator which is composed of: a cylinder for storing high-pressure air; and a face mask for receiving the air from the cylinder through a hose. The fire-fighting cooling water pocket comprises: a storage unit which stores drinking water in an internal space thereof and is placed at a position for the head part of a user; a heat exchange tube which is included in the internal space in order to be in contact with the drinking water, and induces pressure reduction of air provided through one end unit thereof, communicating with a hose, in order to cool down the drinking water and the head part; a drinking tube which connects the internal space and the face mask in order to provide the cooled drinking water to the user; and a breathing tube which connects the other end unit of the heat exchange tube and the face mask in order to provide the air to the user. Therefore, the fire-fighting cooling water pocket can provide a user with fresh air and cooled drinking water since a storage unit for storing drinking water in an internal space thereof and being placed at the position for the head part of a user, a heat exchange tube for inducing pressure reduction of air discharged from a cylinder in a state of being included in the internal space, and a drinking tube and a discharging tube for being connected with the storage unit and the other end unit of the heat exchange tube are organically attached to or detached from the existing fire-fighting air respirator and, at the same time, can improve safety of a user such as a firefighter who does fire extinguishing work in flames for a long time, by continuously cooling down the head part of the user.
abstract_ko: 소방용 냉각수포켓이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 소방용 냉각수포켓은, 고압의 공기를 수용한 실린더와, 호스를 통해 상기 실린더로부터 공기를 제공받는 안면마스크로 구성되는 소방용 공기호흡기에 탈부착되어 사용되고, 내부공간에 식수를 수용하고, 사용자의 두부에 구비되는 저장부; 식수와 접촉하도록 상기 내부공간에 배설되고, 상기 호스와 연통된 일단부를 통해 제공된 공기의 압력강하를 유도하여 식수와 두부를 냉각시키는 열교환튜브; 사용자에게 냉각된 식수를 제공하기 위해, 상기 내부공간과 상기 안면마스크 간을 연결하는 음용관; 및 사용자에게 공기를 제공하기 위해, 상기 열교환튜브의 타단부와 상기 안면마스크 간을 연결하는 호흡관을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 내부공간에 식수를 수용하면서 사용자의 두부에 구비되는 저장부와, 내부공간에 배설된 상태에서 실린더로부터 송출된 공기의 압력강하를 유도하는 열교환튜브와, 저장부 및 열교환튜브의 타단부와 연결되는 음용관 및 송출관이 기존의 소방용 공기호흡기와 각각 유기적으로 탈착결합됨으로 인해 사용자는 신선한 공기 및 냉각된 식수를 제공받을 수 있고, 동시에 두부에 대한 냉각이 지속적으로 이루어짐에 따라 화염 속에서 장시간 진화작업을 하는 소방관 등과 같은 사용자의 안전이 더욱 증진될 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Intelligent firefighter clothes and vital sign monitoring system for firefighters
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire fighter's intelligence clothes and fire fighter vital sign monitoring system, this fire fighter's intelligence clothes include the clothing body, still including set up in one of rhythm of the heart collector, temperature acquisition unit, orientation module, the detecting element that tumbles, microphone, speaker, at least one display screen or their arbitrary combination and MCU on the clothing body, rhythm of the heart collector, temperature acquisition unit, the detecting element that tumbles's output is connected to respectively MCU corresponds the input, orientation module and MCU connect, the microphone is connected to through the sound card MCU, the MCU output is connected with display screen, speaker respectively. The utility model discloses a can know the environmental aspect, the fire fighter's positional information, the fire fighter vital sign at fire control scene in real time, command center just can in time make the rescue reaction to the fire fighter who takes place danger through intelligent terminal, misses the best rescue opportunity when avoiding the fire fighter to be absorbed in danger.
assignees: HUBEI UNIV FOR NATIONALITIES;XIANFENG WULING BIOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: CPR assist device and method for determining depth of chest compressions in a patient
abstract_en: A cardiopulmonary resuscitation assistance device for use by a rescuer in performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation on a patient. By using the rescuer vital signs, image subsections from the patient-facing camera including the rescuer's hands can be identified. After correctly identifying the image subsection including the rescuer's hand, chest compression depth and frequency can be derived from the patient-facing camera by tracking the distance between the patient-facing camera and the rescuer's hand.

title_en: An earthquake rescue positioning watch
abstract_en: Provided is an earthquake rescue positioning watch which comprises a watchband, a watchcase, and a watch surface which are connected successively. A time display and a liquid crystal screen are disposed on the watch surface. A cell and an integrated circuit board are installed inside the watch surface. A GPS positioner is installed on the top of the watchcase. A loudspeaker and a switch are installed on the bottom of the watchcase. A remote control receiving switch and a time adjusting button are installed on the right side of the watchcase. A microphone is installed on the upper right side of the watchcase. An LED calling glittering lamp is installed on the upper left side of the watchcase. An infrared probe is installed on the left side of the watchcase. A microwave emitter is installed on the lower left side of the watchcase. An LED floodlight and a light switch are installed on the lower right side of the watchcase. Usually, the earthquake rescue positioning watch is worn on a hand and does not leave a body. After an earthquake, if a user is  buried or forgets to turn on the switch while being sacred, a rescuer may use a unified specially-produced remote controller to remotely switch on the remote control receiving switch of the earthquake rescue positioning watch. At this time, the GPS positioner, the microwave emitter, the LED calling glittering lamp, and the loudspeaker give a distress signal such that the rescuer is easy to find out the user needing for help in order to perform rescue in time.
assignees: KUNSHAN YUSHAN TOWN SHILONG DESIGN WORK STUDIO

title_en: Firefighter positioning tracking rescue device
abstract_en: A firefighter positioning tracking rescue device comprises an electronic tag, an RFID reader, an information collection device, a server and an alarm device, wherein the electronic tag is arranged inside a firefighter helmet; the RFID reader is fixedly arranged at the periphery of a fire ground and used for reading the information of the electronic tag; the information collection device is worn on a firefighter to collect fire temperature information and firefighter vital sign information; the server is used for receiving the information collected by the information collection device and the card reading information from the RFID reader, realizing firefighter localization based on an RFID location algorithm, and outputting an alarm signal after the collected information value reaches an alarm threshold; and the alarm device is used for receiving an alarm signal of the server to realize alarm. The firefighter positioning tracking rescue device provided by the invention combines ZigBee wireless network transmission technology and RFID localization technology, has a positive effect for fire-fighting commanding and dispatching while ensuring that firefighters can be timely rescued, so as to effectively reduce the number of casualties of firefighters in fire-fighting and rescue.

title_en: Alarm position-indicating or individual distress position-indicating terminal equipment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm position-indicating or individual distress position-indicating terminal equipment system.A detection module comprises a heartbeat body temperature sensor, a detection microcontroller, a pressure sensor and a temperature and humidity sensor; the positioning module comprises a positioning microcontroller and a Beidou satellite positioning navigation module, and provides position information; the communication module is used for communication between the trapped person and the rescuer; the reminding module is used for being closely connected with the emergency networking alarm and rescue subsystem server; the Beidou satellite navigation communication subsystem comprises Beidou satellite navigation and Beidou communication services; when the emergency networking alarm and rescue subsystem detects that the user is in an abnormal external environment, the detection information can transmit real-time data to the emergency networking alarm and rescue subsystem, and rescue actions are carried out. The invention provides the search and rescue personnel with personal information of more disaster-stricken personnel, the surrounding environment and other specific conditions, thereby improving the rescue efficiency and reducing casualties to the maximum extent.

title_en: Firefighter Breathing Apparatus Pack With Integrated Rescue Equipment
abstract_en: An improved firefighter SCBA harness is provided. The harness has a backplate for supporting an air cylinder. A waist belt extends from the backplate to secure the backplate to a waist of a firefighter wearing the SCBA harness. Shoulder straps extend from a top of the backplate connecting to the waist belt. A seat harness extends from a bottom of the backplate to a front of the waist belt for positioning through the legs of a firefighter. A bailout cable spool is provided on the waist belt for extending a cable from the harness to enable the firefighter to perform a bailout, used in a retrieval or as a fall restraint. A battery powered winch may also be integrated in the harness.

title_en: Smart fire fighting suit set for fire fighting
title_ko: 화재 진압용 스마트 방화복 세트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire fighting suit set for firefighting. More specifically, the present invention relates to a fire fighting suit set for firefighting which enables smooth communication with a control room in the process that a firefighter enter a field and performs firefighting, thereby improving workability. Also, a location, movement, heart rate measurement, pulse measurement, and shock measurement of the firefighter are detected to be transmitted to the control room, such that the control room rapidly grasps a situation when the firefighter is in a dangerous situation. Accordingly, safety ensuring and smooth firefighting instructions of the firefighter are possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 진압용 방화복 세트에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 소방관이 현장에 진입하여 작업을 수행하는 과정에서 통제실과의 원활한 소통이 가능하게 함으로써, 작업성의 향상이 가능하게 하며, 또한 소방관의 위치나 움직임, 심박측정, 맥박측정, 충격 측정 등을 감지하여 이를 통제실로 송신함으로써, 소방관이 위험 상황에 발생시 이를 통제실에서 신속하게 파악 및 조치가 가능하게 하는 등 소방관의 안전 확보 및 원활한 작업 지시가 가능하게 하는 화재 진압용 스마트 방화복 세트에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Smoke environment personnel identification apparatus
abstract_en: The apparatus consists of a self contained lighting and identification device ( 10 ) having a strap ( 104 ) for attachment to a SCBA tank. A back plate ( 58 ) and a front shield ( 62 ) are spaced apart forming a cavity for LED back-lighting, with the front shield incorporates identification indicia ( 68 ) which provides recognition of a specific firefighter. Battery containing tubes ( 72 ) act as structural pillars and are located between an upper end cap assembly ( 20 ) and a lower end cap assembly ( 86 ), utilizing tie rods ( 96 ) for attachment therebetween. Diffused light distribution tubes ( 78 ) energized by LED's are positioned adjacent to the battery tubes evenly dispersing light on each side of the apparatus, effectively penetrating a smoke environment. The upper end cap assembly incorporates a printed circuit board ( 46 ) which includes the necessary control and lighting devices, and the lower end cap has a removable bottom cover ( 90 ) allowing batteries to be replaced.

title_en: Opioid overdose alert wearable device method and devices
abstract_en: The embodiments disclose a method including: monitoring vital signs of an opioid patient, providing chemical identifying and concentration detection of a drug the opioid patient is preparing to inject, analyzing the opioid patient's vital signs to determine an overdose condition regardless of the patient consciousness state, tracking the opioid patient's GPS location, transmitting automatically an overdose emergency alert; sending the automatic opioid overdose emergency alert to the closest first responders, and providing the opioid patient's ID, GPS location, vital signs, potential drug overdosed, and known drug use in the automatic opioid overdose emergency alert to the closest first responders.

title_en: Emergency system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency system. The emergency system comprises a signal transmitting terminal and a signal receiving terminal. The signal transmitting terminal comprises an identity information recording module, a geographic position locking module and a signal transmitting module, wherein the identity information recording module is used for recording the identity information of a signal transmitting terminal holder, the geographic position locking module is used for acquiring the information of a geographic position where the signal transmitting terminal holder stays at present, and the signal transmitting module is used for sending the identity information, the geographic position information and a distress signal to the signal receiving terminal. The emergency system has the advantages that when encountering emergency outdoors, a help seeker transmits the distress signal to the signal receiving terminal which stores the identity information of the holder and can position the present position of the holder, the signal transmitting terminal transmits the distress signal, the identity information and the geographic position information of the holder at the same time, so that after the signal receiving terminal receives the information, rescuers carry related rescue instruments conveniently according to the information of different holders and accurately find help seekers according to the acquired geographic position information, and the help seekers can be treated in time.

title_en: Simple lifeboat
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a simple lifeboat. The lifeboat is provided with an arc-shaped hull, wherein a safety cover which is in close fit with an opening of the hull is arranged at the upper part of the hull, a transparent window is arranged on the safety cover for enabling people in the hull to conveniently observe an external environment, a distress signal transmitting device is arranged in the hull, and a signal lamp for playing an indicating role is arranged outside the hull for enabling rescuers to conveniently locate the position of the hull; and in addition, a steering wheel which can control the movement direction of the lifeboat is arranged in the hull. The lifeboat has the advantages of simple structure and convenience in operation, and can timely emit a distress signal to the outside so as to bring great convenience to the flood disaster life-saving work.

title_en: Fire rescue helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting rescue helmet, which comprises a helmet body, a control mechanism, a battery, a lighting lamp, a camera, a hot boot, an infrared night vision device, a micro projector, a protective mask, a microphone and an earphone, wherein the control mechanism comprises a PCB (printed circuit board), a central processing unit, a vital sign monitoring device, a GPS (global positioning system) positioning chip, a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor, an infrared gas sensor and a 5G chip, and the fire-fighting rescue helmet can determine the position and the vital sign condition of trapped personnel, discover toxic and harmful gas in a disaster site in time and provide fire-fighting rescue information for individual fire-fighting rescue personnel through communication with a fire-fighting rescue command center, thereby avoiding individual rescue of each fire-fighting rescue personnel, better protecting the safety of the personnel, improving the fire-fighting and rescue efficiency, and projecting the received rescue auxiliary information onto the protective mask, the surrounding environment can be fully known, the rescue success rate is improved, and meanwhile the safety of rescuers can be better guaranteed.

title_en: System for rescuing emergency employing biometric techniques of solid space and hololens
title_ko: 3차원공간에서의 생체객체와 현실객체의 정합기술을 이용한 응급환자 구조 시스템
abstract_en: The embodiment relates to an emergency patient rescue system using a technology for aligning a bio-object and a real object in a three-dimensional space. Specifically, the rescue system provides a three-dimensional bio-object recognition and alignment method that maximizes intelligent realism and immersion by applying MR technology to an emergency situation where on-site support is impossible. The emergency patient rescue system using a technology for aligning a bio-object and a real object in a three-dimensional space includes: an MR device that is individually equipped for a plurality of different users and acquires an MR (Mixed Reality) image by synchronously processing bio-object recognition and real object recognition in a three-dimensional space for a surrounding patient; a portable integrated controller that is installed around the MR device and processes the MR image of the MR device and additional information including the body temperature and location of a registration sensor and surrounding environment information, registration structure content, and interaction between the user and the patient according to the registration structure scenario, and collectively provides the information to a remote registration management server; and a management server that checks the patient's condition at a remote location and provides guidance and rescue according to the information provided by the portable integrated controller. According to embodiments, the on-site situation is transmitted to a medical control center using an MR device and high-speed wireless communication, and emergency responders can receive medical guidance from the medical control center and provide treatment.
abstract_ko:
실시예는 3차원공간에서의 생체객체와 현실객체의 정합기술을 이용한 응급환자 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로는, 이러한 구조 시스템은 현장지원이 불가능한 응급 상황에 MR 기술을 적용하여 지능화된 현실감 및 몰입감을 극대화하는 3차원 생체객체 인식 및 정합 방식을 제공한다. 그리고, 이러한 방식은 MR 디바이스를 활용한 MR기반으로 제작된 콘텐츠(현장 초동조치, 구급차 탑승 후 조치, 현장 의료조치 도구)를 통하여 만들어진다. 
그래서, 이러한 방식으로 초기 의료대응을 위하여 현장의 상황을 의료상황실로 전송하고 응급처치 요원이 의료상황실의 의료지도를 받아 처치하는 원격 의료지원을 제공한다. 이러한 경우, 현장 상황 전송은 MR 디바이스를 이용하여 고속 통신을 활용한 영상, 음성 등 원활한 정보 송수신으로 응급상황에 신속하게 대응한다. 예를 들어, 현장에서 필요한 MR 디바이스를 이용한 처리 부문(3차원공간 생체객체 인식 및 정합, 영상전송, 스냅샷 전송, 음성인식 및 음성합성(TTS), MR 콘텐츠 디스플레이 등)과 원격 의료상황실용(상황 모니터링, 처치 지도 등)으로 구분해서 만든다. 
이러한 경우, MR기반 현장 초동조치와, 구급차 탑승 후 조치, 의료조치 등으로 구분하여, 구조 콘텐츠와 구조 시나리오를 만든다. 그리고, 이러한 구조 콘텐츠와 구조 시나리오에 사용자 또는 환자와의 상호작용을 처리하여, 현장상황에 적절한 구조 정보를 제공한다. 
따라서, 이를 통해 실시예에서는 MR 디바이스와 고속 무선통신 등을 이용하여 현장의 상황을 의료상황실로 전송하고 응급처치요원이 의료상황실의 의료지도를 받아 처치를 제공할 수 있도록 한다. 
그리고, 현장지원이 불가능한 응급 상황에서 3차원 공간의 생체객체 인식 및 정합 기술 이용한 MR 기반의 의료 대응을 제공한다.

title_en: Closed-circuit breathing oxygen supply type forest fire-avoiding cover
abstract_en: A closed-circuit breathing oxygen supply type forest fire-avoiding cover relates to a forest fire-avoiding cover. The utility model aims to solve the problem that the existing fire-avoiding cover cannot block external smoke and dust from entering the fire-avoiding cover when the ground is uneven. The utility model has simple operation, can prevent fire fighters from sucking high-temperature and harmful smoke and dust when being used under the condition of uneven ground, and provides guarantee for the life safety of the fire fighters, when the fire fighters are in a critical fire disaster environment, the fire fighters unfold the fire avoidance cover, the heads of the fire fighters face the storage pocket, lie in the cover in a prone position, and then take out the closed-circuit breathing unit in the storage pocket. The breathing mask is worn on the face, the air supply quantity is adjusted in real time by rotating a valve on the air supply tank, the exhaled air enters the carbon dioxide adsorption tank through the exhalation valve, the carbon dioxide is absorbed by an adsorbent in the breathing mask, and the rest of the exhaled air continuously participates in the breathing cycle. The utility model belongs to the technical field of forest fire control.

title_en: Bracket systems for storing and deploying articles of equipment
abstract_en: A bracket system is provided for the storage and retrieval of an article of equipment such as a self-contained breathing apparatus of the type used by firefighters and other first responders to provide breathing air during firefighting and other emergency operations. The bracket system securely stores the article of equipment in a position at which the article of equipment has an upside down, or inverted orientation, facing the back of the storage area. The bracket system is configured to articulate in a manner that positions the article of equipment in a lowered position at which the article of equipment has an upright orientation, facing the user, so that the user can retrieve the article of equipment.

title_en: Life buoy provided with distress signal lamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a life buoy provided with a distress signal lamp. The body of the life buoy is connected with the distress signal lamp provided with a button switch. During usage, the distress signal lamp can be switched on through the button switch to emit light, thereby providing accurate rescue positions to rescuers. In addition, the life buoy is particularly suitable to be used on ships.

title_en: Apparatus for preventing freezing of the valve for air respirator mask and the method for controlling thereof
title_ko: 공기호흡기 면체의 밸브 동결 방지장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a valve freezing preventing device of a surface body for an air respirator and a control method thereof, wherein a heating device is installed on an intake port or an exhaust port of a surface body for an air respirator so as to prevent an intake valve or an exhaust valve from being cooled or frozen by outdoor air in winter. To this end, the present invention comprises: a power supply unit which supplies operating power to a heating unit; a plurality of heating units installed on an intake port or an exhaust port formed on a nose cup of a surface body for an air respirator, respectively, and operated by a driving current supplied from the power supply unit to generate heat; a power switch which is turned on/off by the operation of a user, and regulates the power supplied to each heating unit from the power supply unit; a temperature sensing unit installed on or around one side of the intake or exhaust port of the nose cup and configured to measure the temperature of the intake or exhaust port or the surroundings thereof; and a control unit which controls the power supplied from the power supply unit to each heating unit according to a temperature detection signal of the temperature sensing unit or the on/off operation state of the power switch. Accordingly, the intake valve or the exhaust valve of the surface body for an air respirator is prevented from being cooled or frozen even when a fire fighter needs to temporarily remove the surface body to shift work after long hours of work at the scene of the fire or to perform other tasks such that if needed, the fire fighter can immediately wear the surface body and perform operation efficiently.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공기호흡기 면체의 밸브 동결 방지장치 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 공기호흡기용 면체의 흡기구나 배기구에 히팅장치를 설치하여 흡기밸브나 배기밸브가 겨울철 외기에 의해 냉각 또는 동결되는 것을 방지하기 위한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 히팅부에 동작 전원을 공급하는 전원 공급부, 공기호흡기 면체의 노즈컵에 형성된 흡기구 및 배기구에 각각 설치되며 전원 공급부에서 제공되는 구동전류에 의해 동작하여 열을 발생시키는 다수 개의 히팅부, 사용자 조작에 의해 온/오프되어 전원 공급부에서 각 히팅부에 공급하는 전원을 단속하는 전원스위치, 노즈컵의 흡기구나 배기구의 일측 또는 그 주변에 설치되어 흡기구나 배기구 또는 그 주변온도를 측정하는 온도 감지부, 온도 감지부의 온도 감지신호 또는 전원스위치의 온/오프 조작 상태에 따라 전원 공급부에서 각 히팅부로 공급되는 전원을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여, 화재 현장에서 장시간 작업에 따른 소방대원의 교대 또는 기타 다른 업무를 수행하기 위해 공기호흡기 면체를 잠시 벗어 두어야 하는 경우에도 공기호흡기용 면체의 흡기밸브나 배기밸브가 냉각 또는 동결되지 않도록 하여 필요시 즉시 재착용하여 효율적인 작업을 수행할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: System and method for in-structure delivery of air for filling of breathing apparatus
abstract_en: An in-structure air delivery system comprises a control panel and a plurality of air delivery lines. The control panel is located at a first location in the structure and has an air supply inlet. Each air delivery line extends from the control panel to a different location in the structure. Valves are configured to selectively control the flow of air through each of the air delivery lines. In a method of use, a high pressure air supply such as a portable compressor is connected to the inlet of the system. Air is selectively delivered to one or more of the delivery lines. A control unit is connected to the outlet of the delivery line. Air is supplied to the control unit. The control unit is used to regulate the flow of air to a component of breathing equipment, such as to a firefighter's breathing equipment air cylinder to be re-filled.

title_en: System for checking viability and location using wearable information providing apparatus and method performing thereof
title_ko: 웨어러블형 정보 제공 장치를 이용한 생존 여부 및 위치 확인 시스템 및 이의 실행 방법
abstract_en: A system for checking viability and location using a wearable information providing device, which includes a wearable information providing device, a rescuer terminal and a central server, according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a wearable information providing device distributed and worn on part of a body of a user belonging to a group or a personal user, and measuring and providing the locational information and biometric information of the user; a central server for checking the viability and location of the user using the three-dimensional locational information of a rescuer received from the rescuer terminal, and the three-dimensional locational information and the biometric information of a person to be rescued, which is received from the wearable information providing device, and providing the locational information of the corresponding user to the rescuer terminal; and the rescuer terminal for receiving and displaying the locational information of the user received from the central server. Therefore, provided are a system for checking viability and location using a wearable information providing device, and a performing method thereof, wherein a person to be rescued can be rescued swiftly.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 웨어러블형 정보 제공 장치, 구조자 단말 및 중앙 서버를 포함하는 웨어러블형 정보 제공 장치를 이용한 생존 여부 및 위치 확인 시스템은 그룹에 소속되는 사용자 또는 개인 사용자 각각의 신체 일부에게 배부되어 착용되며 사용자의 3차원 위치 정보 및 생체 정보를 측정하여 제공하는 웨어러블형 정보 제공 장치, 상기 구조자 단말로부터 수신된 구조자 3차원 위치 정보 그리고 상기 웨어러블형 정보 제공 장치로부터 수신된 구조 대상자의 3차원 위치 정보 및 생체 정보를 이용하여 상기 사용자의 생존 여부 및 위치를 확인하여 해당 사용자의 위치 정보를 구조자 단말에 제공하는 중앙 서버 및 상기 중앙 서버로부터 수신된 사용자의 위치 정보를 수신하여 표시하는 구조자 단말을 포함한다.

title_en: Fire control positioning monitoring system
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire control positioning monitoring system, comprising: the fire fighter carries a positioning individual terminal and a vital sign monitoring device, an intelligent air-breathing pressure gauge arranged on the air respirator, a positioning beacon device for transmitting positioning signals, and a portable gateway device and an information processing terminal which are arranged on a fire scene; the vital sign monitoring device and the intelligent air-breathing pressure gauge are respectively connected with a positioning individual terminal; the positioning individual terminal is connected to the portable gateway equipment through a data network; the portable gateway device is connected to the information processing terminal; the positioning beacon device is respectively in communication connection with the positioning individual terminal and the portable gateway equipment through the wireless local area network. According to the technical scheme, the positioning position, the pressure condition of the respirator and vital sign information of the firefighter can be automatically monitored in real time, accurate positioning is provided for rescue between teammates, the life safety of the firefighter entering a fire scene is ensured, and accurate real-time information reference is provided for solving the internal condition of the fire scene.

title_en: Thermal insulation clothes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat preservation garment, which comprises a main body mechanism, a bundling mechanism, a protection mechanism, a light-emitting mechanism and a zipper, wherein the bundling mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the main body mechanism, the protection mechanism is arranged at the middle end of the main body mechanism, the light-emitting mechanism is arranged on two sides of the upper end of the main body mechanism, and the zipper is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the main body mechanism; the light emitting mechanism includes: and the waterproof lamp belts are arranged on two sides of the upper end of the main body mechanism. This heat preservation clothes, the protection machanism of setting is fixed through hasp end to end, when receiving the rescue, rescuer accessible protection machanism draws the user to drag and rescues, can hold up the head through the head buoyancy board that sets up, can prevent to get into the inside floating ability that loses of heat preservation clothes from the face at rivers, leads to the problem of human body temperature dip suddenly, comes the refraction to luminous mechanism through reflection of light cloth, makes the user position focus attention more, the expansion of the rescue work of being convenient for.
