title_en: A kind of fire-fighting disaster field individual soldier's indoor locating system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of fire-fighting disaster field individual soldier's indoor locating system, including outdoor vehicle-mounted command system, indoor Single-soldier system and 4G transmission channels；Outdoor vehicle-mounted command system includes hardware server and software scheduling system, and software scheduling system includes indoor three-dimensional map；Indoor Single-soldier system includes locating module, handheld terminal and larynx the shake earphone being built in fire fighter's insole, and handheld terminal carries camera, and locating module and larynx shake earphone are connected by bluetooth module with handheld terminal；Handheld terminal is built-in with APP softwares, and pass through 4G transmission channels and transmitted with outdoor vehicle-mounted command system into row information, the location information of fire fighter is presented in three-dimensional map indoors, there is emergent live HD video passback, the monitoring of scene of a fire fire fighter's indoor accurate position, fire fighter's vital sign, scene of a fire architecture indoor rapid modeling etc..

title_en: Alarm notification system
abstract_en: A system and method providing for ascertaining the status of a user and escalating an alarm in the event the user is ascertained to be disposed in a dangerous condition. The of the invention attempts to contact the user at a predetermined check-in time, and notifies a pre-designated third-party which may be an emergency responder such as law enforcement or other emergency contact in the event that the user fails to respond to the check in request or signals that they are in danger using an escalate feature of the invention. The system operates autonomously to notify pre-designated emergency contacts or emergency responders in the case in which a user has been rendered unable to respond. The user may identify specific individuals with whom they plan to meet and the invention may also track the user's geo-location. The invention may also monitor biometric data of the user.

title_en: A cpr assistance device and a method for determining patient chest compression depth
abstract_en: A Cardiopulmonary resuscitation assistance device is used by a Rescuer when administering Cardiopulmonary resuscitation to a patient. Using the rescuer vital signs, image subsection from a patient facing camera can be identified that comprise the rescuer's hands. Having correctly identified the image subsections comprising the rescuer's hands the chest compression depth and frequency can be derived from the patient facing camera by tracking the distance between the patient facing camera and the rescuer's hands.

title_en: Method and device for providing rescue information to rescuer
abstract_en: The present application is designed to provide a method and device for providing rescue information to a rescuer. The method comprises: a distress signaling device sends a distress call to a corresponding network device; the network device receives the distress call, determines at least one rescue user device based on the corresponding positioning basis information, and sends to at least one of the rescue user devices the position information of the distress signaling device and the position-based information of at least one wearable rescue device; the rescue user device provides distress prompt information about the distress call, and presents on a map interface the position-based information of the at least one wearable rescue device; and the rescue user device sends rescue response information about the distress call to the network device. The present application can reduce the burden of the rescuer and improve rescue efficiency.

title_en: Fire Command System utilizing Real-Time status and Indoor Position Tracking Information
title_ko: 소방대원의 실시간 상태 확인 및 실내 위치 트래킹 정보를 활용한 소방 지휘 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting command system utilizing a real-time status and indoor position tracking information of a firefighter. More specifically, disclosed is a firefighting command system which sets a location coordinate using a beacon to obtain the indoor location information of a firefighter using an acceleration, geomagnetic field, and barometric pressure sensors and obtains a more accurate location using a pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) method. In addition, the firefighting command system displays the location information on the screen of a mobile terminal to identify a movement path through a tracking system and measure, in real time, the status of the firefighter and information on the field by attaching a shock detection sensor and a temperature and humidity sensor to a firefighting suit and attaching a heart rate sensor attached to a fire fighting glove, thereby transmitting the status and information to the mobile terminal by using a long range (LoRa) communication module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방대원의 실시간 상태 확인 및 실내 위치 트래킹 정보를 활용한 소방 지휘 시스템에 관한 것으로서 더욱 상세하게는 비콘을 활용하여 위치 좌표를 설정한 뒤 가속도, 지자계, 기압 센서를 이용하여 소방대원의 실내 위치 정보를 확보하고 PDR(Pedestrian Dead Reckoning) 방식을 이용하여 보다 정확한 위치를 파악 할 수 있으며, 이러한 위치 정보를 모바일 단말기의 화면에 출력하여 트래킹 시스템을 도입해 이동 경로 파악과 충격 감지 센서, 온습도 센서를 화재 진압복에 부착하고 심박 센서를 소방 장갑에 부착하여 현장 정보와 소방대원의 상태를 실시간으로 측정해 LoRa(Long Range) 통신 모듈을 활용하여 모바일 단말기로 전송하는 소방 지휘 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Air breathing apparatus with safety alarm function
title_ko: 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치
abstract_ko: 호흡장치에 장착되어 화재진압(인명구조) 대원 또는 스킨스쿠버 다이버들의 생존 여부, 이상 여부 및 위치를 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 한 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치에 관한 것으로서, GPS 위성을 통해 위치 정보를 획득하는 GPS모듈; 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 호흡 감지 센서; 상기 호흡장치의 고압용기에 저장된 공기량 또는 산소량을 측정하는 잔량 감지부; 상기 호흡 감지 센서에서 감지한 호흡 감지 신호에 따라 사용자의 상태를 판별하고, 상기 잔량 감지부에서 감지한 공기 잔량 또는 산소 잔량에 따라 잔량 표시를 제어하며, 사용자의 상태 신호를 전송토록 제어하는 제어부; 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 압축 공기 또는 압축 산소의 압력을 조정하는 제1 및 제2 레귤레이터; 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 사용자의 상태 신호를 무선신호로 전송하는 무선 송신기를 포함하여, 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치를 구현한다.

title_en: Post-accident network probe and method of using the same
abstract_en: A post-accident network probe and a method of using such a probe are disclosed. The probe is configured to be deployed in a confined environment (e.g. an underground mine), typically after an accident has occurred, in order to establish a connection with the wireless network, or a portion thereof, located therein. The probe generally allows the rescuers to determine the position of potentially trapped miners and can allow the rescuers to have access to environment-related information collected by the network, to get vital signs information, and/or to communicate with the trapped miners. The probe can be deployed using different access methods such as bore holes (existing or new), ventilation shafts, preventive installations of probes, etc. Notably, since the probe establishes a connection with the network, the location of the probe does not have to be exactly where the miners are located as long as the miners are tracked by the network.

title_en: Emergency positioning searching device, method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency positioning searching device, a method and a system, wherein the emergency positioning searching device comprises: the ultra-wideband PDOA module is used for precise distance measurement and azimuth angle measurement; the MPU module is used for configuring the working mode of each module, managing communication and reading and writing operation and processing of data information; the wireless data transmission module is used for data interaction between the emergency positioning search and rescue device and the background server; the power supply module is used for supplying power to each module; the emergency fixed search device also comprises a display module for displaying the working state of the emergency fixed search device and the distance and direction information of a person seeking help or an object to be searched relative to the emergency fixed search device; the emergency positioning search and rescue searching device further comprises a key module used for manually sending a distress signal and switching the working modes of the emergency positioning search and rescue searching device. The system can realize interactive positioning between firefighters on site, know accurate position information of the person seeking help in real time, reduce rescue difficulty and improve rescue efficiency.

title_en: Portable lantern reactive to biological information
title_ko: 생체 정보 반응형 휴대용 조명등
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio-information reactive portable lighting lamp is provided to enable rescuers to selectively rescue an urgent victim by checking the health condition of victims. CONSTITUTION: A bio-information reactive portable lighting lamp(200) comprises a bio-information sensor module which includes a cardiac sensor(211), a body heat sensor(212), and a motion detection sensor(213). At least one among a heart rate, a body heat, and the movement distance of a victim is transmitted to a control center through a wireless communications module(206). A multi sensor module(201) comprises a smoke sensor, a gas sensor, a temperature sensor, an illuminance sensor, and a humidity sensor. The wireless communications module communicates with the control center through a wireless communications access pointer(207) or a holder(208).

title_en: Fire-fighting equipment for external intelligent fire rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses external fire intelligent rescue fire fighting equipment, which comprises a fire fighting truck body, wherein a rotating device is rotatably connected to the fire fighting truck body, a telescopic aerial ladder is arranged on the rotating device, one end of the telescopic aerial ladder, which is far away from the rotating device, is provided with a manned frame, a life detector, a rescue alarm system and a smoke removal system are arranged on the outer side of the manned frame, the life detector is electrically connected with the rescue alarm system, the life detector is used for monitoring the vital sign condition in the horizontal direction, and a pair of air bag slide ladders are arranged at the positions, close to the telescopic aerial ladder, of the manned frame; according to the external fire intelligent rescue fire fighting equipment, the aerial ladder is erected on the outer side of the residential building by the fire fighting truck, the life information is monitored on each floor, and after the life signs are detected, firefighters directly enter the affected floor to assist the personnel to escape, so that the rescue is quicker and more accurate, the physical strength of the firefighters cannot be wasted on climbing the building, and more physical strength is saved for rescue.

title_en: Rescue worker monitoring method, system, device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a device for monitoring rescuers and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving positioning information and vital sign information of rescuers sent by intercom equipment; determining the rescue state of the rescue worker according to the positioning information and the vital sign information; determining guidance information of the rescuers according to the rescue state; and sending the guidance information to the talkback equipment so as to output the guidance information to guide the rescue personnel to execute corresponding actions through the talkback equipment. The method of the invention determines the rescue state of the rescue personnel according to the positioning information and the vital sign information of the rescue personnel, acquires whether the rescue personnel continuously participate in the rescue task or not through the rescue state and evaluates whether the rescue personnel can obtain the rescue in time or not, determines the guidance information of the rescue personnel according to the rescue state, and sends the guidance information to the talkback equipment to guide the rescue personnel to execute actions, so that the rescue personnel can acquire the rescue state of the rescue personnel in time, and the safety of the rescue personnel is improved.

title_en: Critical health information profile and emergency communication system
abstract_en: A microprocessor-based emergency response communication system used to call and communicate with the 9-1-1 operator and also allows emergency responder's immediate access to a user's Critical Health Information Profile stored in the device at the point and location of crisis. The device is used to create individual Critical Health Information Profiles which is Health Level-7 compliant enabling it to seamlessly communicate with major hospital networks worldwide. This functional capability provides a system that can retrieve and transmit user-stored personal and health information by emergency responders at the point of care. The emergency responder can access the customer's Critical Health Information Profile database, review the data for pertinent information and then transmit that data to a designated receiving hospital or medical center. The device provides an electronic means of dialing and communicating directly with the 9-1-1 operator. A wireless remote transmitter unit can be activated from the wireless transmitter or the base unit to dial and connect with the 9-1-1 operator, broadcast a canned message with or without a personal-recorded message, and personally communicate with the 9-1-1 operator through a two-way speakerphone system. The device contains software enabling the user and medical personnel the ability to input, store, retrieve and analyze the user's vital sign data and other pertinent health information.

title_en: Bypass air supply valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a bypass air supply valve, which comprises an air supply valve, a breathing mask, an electronic display, an exhalation valve, a bypass switch and a sliding block linkage mechanism, wherein the air supply valve and the breathing mask are of an integrated structure, one end of the sliding block linkage mechanism is connected with the exhalation valve, the other end of the sliding block linkage mechanism is a jacking component, the jacking component controls the air supply valve switch, the bypass switch is positioned above the air supply valve, the bypass switch is positioned at the front side of the electronic display, and the bypass switch is in transmission connection with the sliding block linkage mechanism. The bypass air supply valve adds the bypass function on the premise of not changing the structures and technical parameters of the air supply valve and the exhalation valve in the original European style air supply valve, and improves the use safety performance of the bypass function. When wearing the breathing mask provided with the air supply valve, a firefighter can cut off the air supply of the air bottle and breathe natural air outside without taking off the breathing mask.

title_en: Personal air breathing device with safety alarm function
title_ko: 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 개인용 공기호흡기
abstract_ko: 공기호흡기에 장착되어 화재진압(인명구조)시 소방대원들의 생존 여부, 이상 여부 및 위치를 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 한 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 개인용 공기호흡기 및 이를 이용한 대원관리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 호흡 감지 센서, 고압용기에 저장된 공기량을 측정하는 공기 잔량 감지부, 상기 호흡 감지 센서에서 감지한 호흡 감지 신호에 따라 사용자의 상태를 판별하고, 상기 공기 잔량 감지부에서 감지한 공기 잔량에 따라 공기 잔량 표시를 제어하며, 사용자의 상태 신호를 전송토록 제어하는 제어부, 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 사용자의 상태 신호를 무선신호로 전송하는 무선 송신기를 포함하는 공기호흡기; 상기 공기호흡기의 무선 송신기에서 송출된 사용자의 상태신호를 수신하여 저장하고, 관리자의 요청에 따라 사용자의 상태를 화면에 표시해주는 대원관리장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire-fighting water discharge nozzle
abstract_en: To provide a fire-fighting water discharge nozzle allowing a firefighter to check an object to which water is discharged in a smoke-filled fire room.SOLUTION: A fire-fighting water discharge nozzle 10 includes a nozzle part 12, a water discharge body 14, and a double tubular valve 16 disposed at an inner space 22 of the nozzle part 12 and the water discharge body 14 and comprising an inner tube 26 and an outer tube 28. A rear part of the nozzle part 12 is screwed with a front part of the water discharge body 14, and the nozzle part 12 is rotated to change a water discharge form so as to discharge water. A head portion 16a of the valve part 16 includes a light emitter 32 connected to an external power supply 30 via a first hole 14a of the water discharge body 14 communicating with a hollow part 26a of the inner tube 26, and a gas jet port 42 for jetting a high-pressure gas 40 supplied from external air supply means 38 via a second hole 14b of the water discharge body 14 communicating with a hollow part 36 formed between the inner tube 26 and the outer tube 28. Even at a smoke-filled building fire of zero visibility, this configuration allows a firefighter to perform fire work, while checking an object to which water is discharged, from a water discharge position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Convenient and reliable fire-fighting self-rescuer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting articles, in particular to a convenient and reliable fire-fighting self-rescuer; comprises a gas cylinder assembly, a mask assembly, an air bag and a filtering system; the mask assembly is provided with a mask valve; the mask assembly is communicated with the outside through a mask valve, and the mask valve is connected with a gas supply quick switching device through a gas guide pipe; the quick gas supply switching device comprises a three-way valve body, a piston positioned in the valve body, an air bag gas guide channel valve, a return spring assembly and an air bag interface; the air bag interface is connected with the air bag; the cavity of the rapid air supply switching device is connected with the filtering system through a first one-way valve; the cavity is connected with the gas cylinder assembly through a quick connector; the invention realizes the quick switching of three breathing states, improves the quick switching efficiency of the fire-fighting self-rescuer, prolongs the service life and improves the practicability and effectiveness of the fire-fighting self-rescuer.

title_en: Individual soldier companion help calling method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a help calling method for individual soldier companions, which comprises the following steps: receiving track data sent by a plurality of terminals, recording the track data and displaying the relative positions of the terminals; receiving a distress signal sent by a first terminal in the plurality of terminals; and sending rescue signals and the track data of the first terminal to other terminals in the plurality of terminals, and comparing the track data of the other terminals with the track data of the first terminal to confirm the position of the first terminal. The invention also provides a single soldier companion distress device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention can provide commands when rescuers rescue the fellows in danger, thereby avoiding the rescuers from blindly rescuing and causing more loss.

title_en: Opioid overdose alert wearable device method and devices
abstract_en: The embodiments disclose a method including: monitoring vital signs of an opioid patient, providing chemical identifying and concentration detection of a drug the opioid patient is preparing to inject, analyzing the opioid patient's vital signs to determine an overdose condition regardless of the patient consciousness state, tracking the opioid patient's GPS location, transmitting automatically an overdose emergency alert; sending the automatic opioid overdose emergency alert to the closest first responders, and providing the opioid patient's ID, GPS location, vital signs, potential drug overdosed, and known drug use in the automatic opioid overdose emergency alert to the closest first responders.

title_en: Smart lifesaving alarm system
title_ko: 스마트 인명구조용 경보기 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart lifesaving alarm system. Firefighters who are to carry out firefighting work at a fire site wear smart lifesaving alarms with buckles on their firefighting suits. If there is no movement of the firefighter wearing the alarm for a preset time while entering the fire site and carrying out fire extinguishing work, a man-down alarm is output and an LED blinks. When a high temperature higher than a preset temperature is detected in the surroundings, a high-temperature alarm is output and the LED blinks. The time of entry to the fire site and the elapsed time of entry are displayed so that the time can be easily grasped. A GPS function is secured to recognize the location of a firefighter wearing the alarm. Wireless communication, such as Bluetooth communication, is connected to a transceiver of a field command department near a fire site such that the location and alarm status of each firefighter, the time of entry to the fire site and the elapsed time can be grasped from a terminal for field command. By sending a command to a smart lifesaving alarm through a command transceiver, a command can be displayed on a degree display window of the smart lifesaving alarm. The condition, location, and elapsed time of entry of firefighters who have lost consciousness or are at risk of high temperature at a fire site are easily identified by a command center near the fire site. The present invention is to ensure that firefighters who entered a fire site can keep the maximum entry maintenance time, thereby protecting the safety of firefighters.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 인명구조용 경보기를 화재현장에서 소화작업을 수행하려는 소방관들이 소방복에 버클을 이용하여 착용하고, 화재현장으로 진입하여 소화작업을 진행하는 도중에 기설정된 시간 동안 착용한 소방관의 움직임이 없으면 맨다운 경보음을 출력하며 LED가 점멸작동되고, 또는 기설정된 온도 이상의 고온이 주변에서 감지되면 고온 경보음을 출력하며 LED가 점멸작동되고, 화재현장의 진입시각과 진입경과시간이 표시되어 용이하게 시간을 파악할 수가 있으며, GPS 기능을 갖추어 착용한 소방관의 위치를 인식하고, 블루투스 통신 등 무선통신으로 화재현장 인근의 현장지휘부 송수신기와 연결되어 각 소방관의 위치 및 경보 상태, 화재현장 진입시각과 경과시간을 현장지휘용 단말기에서 파악할 수 있고, 지휘부 송수신기를 통해 스마트 인명구조용 경보기로 명령을 송신하여 스마트 인명구조용 경보기의 정도표시창에 명령을 표시할 수 있어서, 화재현장에서 의식을 잃거나 고온으로 위험에 처한 매몰된 소방관의 상태와 위치, 진입경과시간을 화재현장 인근의 지휘부에서 용이하게 파악하며 화재현장에 진입한 소방관들이 최대진입유지시간을 지킬 수 있도록 하여 소방관들의 안전을 보호하는 것이 가능한 스마트 인명구조용 경보기 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method and wearable electronic device for rescuing a person in distress
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for rescuing a person in distress, comprising equipping at least a first person with a first wearable electronic device (10a) and a second person with a second wearable electronic device(10b), referred hereafter as the person in distress and the rescuer respectively, each wearable device comprising a processing unit (12a), a memory (12b), a Global Navigation Satellite System-GNSS receiver (16), a Low Power Wide Area Network (LPWAN) transmitter/receiver (14), an antenna (15) adapted to emit and receive a signal through the LPWAN and to receive a signal from the GNSS, a user interface (20) for inputting a distress signal, and a display unit (26) for displaying the location of a person in distress, wherein the processing unit (12a) is configured to execute a software stored in the memory (12b) of the wearable electronic device to turn the electronic device from a standby mode either into a tracking mode for locating and finding a person in distress or into an SOS mode for sending SOS signals. The method further comprises the steps of: a. turning the first wearable device (10a) by the person in distress through its user interface (20) from a standby mode into an SOS mode; b. obtaining the GNSS coordinates of the first wearable electronic device (10a) worn by the person in distress; emitting from the first wearable electronic device (10a), through the LPWAN, one or more SOS signals at a given constant emission power until a first SOS signal is picked up by the second wearable electronic device (10b) worn by the rescuer, and d. processing, by the processing unit (12a) of the second wearable electronic device (10b), at several time intervals, SOS signals sent by the first wearable electronic device and current GNSS coordinates of the second wearable electronic device (10b) to provide guiding information on the display (26) of said second wearable electronic device (10b) as a function of the location of the person in distress and the rescuer as the rescuer moves towards the person in distress.

title_en: Emergency messaging from a locked mobile device
abstract_en: The disclosed system provides a facility to enable an emergency messaging session on a locked mobile device. In response to receiving a request on a locked mobile device to initiate an emergency messaging session, the system displays an interface that may enable a user of the mobile device to select a type of emergency and/or enter a customized message to be transmitted to an emergency services provider. The displayed interface additionally may include options to automatically or manually send specified types of information to an emergency responder, such as a physical location of the mobile device or medical, personal contact, or residence information of the user of the mobile device. While an emergency messaging session is in progress, the disclosed system may continually send updated information to the selected emergency provider, such as a location of the mobile device or biometric information associated with a user of the mobile device.

title_en: Emergency rescue lighting lamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue lighting lamps, in particular to an emergency rescue lighting lamp, which comprises a bearing mechanism and an air supply and dust exhaust mechanism arranged on the bearing mechanism. The elastic supporting piece which can be elastically stretched is connected between the outer frame and the lamp holder, after two groups of binding belts are tightly tied along the shoulders and the chest of a rescuer, the air and dust discharging mechanism, the lamp holder and the bulb which are fixedly borne by the clamp can be positioned right above the back of the rescuer, when the rescuer advances along the creeping direction in a pit, the bulb can illuminate in the advancing direction of the rescuer, and the dust which is raised in the advancing process of the rescuer can be directionally absorbed and filtered by the two dust collecting boxes and the filter core which are arranged on the two sides of the bin tube, and the external air pipe and the guide pipe are matched to continuously pressurize towards the inside of the plugging end, so that the air in the pit of the rescuer can be purified, the illumination of the bulb and the realization of the rescuer are not hindered, and the safe respiration of the rescuer can be not influenced.
assignees: JIANGSU AN BAO LAI PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent air respirator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligence air respirator, including the gas cylinder, face guard and backplate, the gas cylinder is fixed on the backplate, the gas cylinder valve is connected to the gas cylinder, relief pressure valve and pressure sensor are connected respectively through the trachea to the gas cylinder valve, pressure sensor connects the transmitter, the transmitter is installed satellite and WIFI orientation module and is equipped with digital display screen, the relief pressure valve passes through trachea and connects quick-operation joint, quick-operation joint inserts the face guard after connecting the air supply valve through the trachea, face guard upper portion is equipped with miniature camera head, the face guard lateral part is equipped with the sound transmission membrane, the inside receiver that is fixed with of face guard, the receiver is equipped with the LED. The utility model has the advantages that: the gas cylinder atmospheric pressure passes through the display of digital display screen, and the scene of being convenient for is clear to be watched and in time master, and the transmitter is with data wireless transmission to receiver, and the rescuer can know gas cylinder atmospheric pressure and tolerance in service behavior directly in the face guard, uses conversation, video defeated, satellite and WIFI location three simultaneously, helps commander liaison and safety rescue.
assignees: Shanxi lande fire fighting equipment co ltd

title_en: Life body feature detection and identification method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a life body characteristic detection and identification method for a rescue robot, which is used for solving the technical problem that rescue fails due to complex environment of the existing rescue robot. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing an O-shaped detection area by taking the position of a rescue robot as a starting point, and starting an obstacle avoidance system of the rescue robot; secondly, performing rescue scanning on the O-shaped detection area by using a carbon dioxide detector to obtain a target point set; then, performing target detection on the target point set by using an infrared detector, and determining a target point to be rescued; and finally, identifying a target point to be rescued by using the radar life detector in a third stage, determining the specific position of the rescuers, sending a distress signal by using a controller of the rescue robot, and timely informing rescue workers of rescuing. According to the invention, multiple detectors are combined, so that the identification precision is improved, the rescue time is shortened, and the rescue robot has the capability of efficiently and accurately detecting the vital signs of a human body.

title_en: Big Dipper emergency management and rescue terminal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the application of the Beidou satellite navigation location technology of satellite communication navigation field, particularly a kind of Big Dipper terminal that realizes emergency management and rescue.This terminal is System Implementation hi-Fix via satellite, utilizes Big Dipper generation short message function, sends an SOS and positional information.Terminal comprises five funtion parts altogether: satellite positioning module, Big Dipper generation communication module, control module, power module and antenna part.Antenna is connected with Big Dipper generation communication module with satellite positioning module, satellite positioning module is responsible for location, Big Dipper generation communication module is responsible for a distress signals and real-time positioning information sends to rescue center by big-dipper satellite, and rescue center carries out fixed-point rescue according to person for help's positional information.The utility model has the advantages that: the utility model can be launched distress signal and positional information via satellite in the situation that not having mobile phone signal to cover, and is convenient to notify rescuer to search and rescue fast.

title_en: Personal air breathing device with safety alarm function and worker management system
title_ko: 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 개인용 공기호흡기 및 이를 이용한 대원관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personal air respirator having a safe alarming function, which is mounted on an air respirator to enable a user to easily confirm survival, disorder, and position of fire fighters during fire fighting (life saving), and to a worker management system using the same. The worker management system comprises: an air respirator including a respiration sensor for sensing respiration of a user, an air residual amount sensing unit for measuring the air amount stored in a high pressure container, a control unit for determining a state of a user according to a respiration sensed signal sensed through the respiration sensor, controlling display of the air residual amount according to the air residual amount sensed through the air residual amount sensing unit, and controlling a user state signal to be transmitted, and a wireless transmitter for transmitting the user state signal as a wireless signal according to control of the control unit; and a worker management device which receives and stores the user state signal transmitted from the wireless transmitter of the air respirator and displays the state of the user on a screen according to a request of an administrator.
abstract_ko: 공기호흡기에 장착되어 화재진압(인명구조)시 소방대원들의 생존 여부, 이상 여부 및 위치를 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 한 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 개인용 공기호흡기 및 이를 이용한 대원관리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 호흡 감지 센서, 고압용기에 저장된 공기량을 측정하는 공기 잔량 감지부, 상기 호흡 감지 센서에서 감지한 호흡 감지 신호에 따라 사용자의 상태를 판별하고, 상기 공기 잔량 감지부에서 감지한 공기 잔량에 따라 공기 잔량 표시를 제어하며, 사용자의 상태 신호를 전송토록 제어하는 제어부, 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 사용자의 상태 신호를 무선신호로 전송하는 무선 송신기를 포함하는 공기호흡기; 상기 공기호흡기의 무선 송신기에서 송출된 사용자의 상태신호를 수신하여 저장하고, 관리자의 요청에 따라 사용자의 상태를 화면에 표시해주는 대원관리장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Apparatus for rescue and recovery of incapacitated persons
abstract_en: A rescue apparatus and method for the transport of injured persons from an area deemed immediately dangerous to life and health (IDLH), being a low-profile wheeled platform with a shaped aperture having the contour matching that of an air-pack. Immobilized fire fighters or others may be placed in a supine position atop the platform, their air packs entering into the contoured aperture; so that they may utilize the air supply while being evacuated. The wheels of the apparatus preferably straddle a fire hose during the transport using it as a guide for safe egress from the IDLH environment.

title_en: System and method for monitoring the position of firefighter
title_ko: 소방관 위치 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system to monitor the locations of firefighters and a method thereof. The system monitors the locations of firefighters by receiving signals transmitted from a location signal transmission device installed in the gears of the firefighters in one or more location signal receiving devices installed in a plurality of fire trucks, checks if the firefighters are in an emergency based on the biometric data of the firefighters sensed by the location signal transmission device installed in the gears, displays the emergency if any emergency of a firefighter is sensed, and notifies firefighters around of the emergency.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방관의 장비에 설치된 위치신호 발신장치에서 송신되는 신호를 다수의 소방차에 설치된 적어도 하나 이상의 위치신호 수신장치에서 수신하여 소방관 위치를 모니터링하고, 소방관 장비에 설치된 위치신호 발신장치에서 감지하는 소방관의 생체정보를 바탕으로 소방관이 응급상황에 처했는지를 확인하고, 응급상황에 처한 소방관을 감지하면 이를 표시하고, 인근 소방관에게 알리는 소방관 위치 모니터링 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV HANSEO ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION;WOO CHOONG CHAE;BAE DAE SOON

title_en: Band-type device for requesting rescue to transmit the location of missing or isolated first responders
title_ko: 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 전송하는 밴드형 구조요청장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a band-type rescue requesting device for transmitting a location of missing or isolated first responders which manually or automatically transmits the location of a missing or isolated field response worker for rescue when the field response worker goes missing or is isolated at a terrorist or disaster site. The band-type rescue requesting device for transmitting the location of a missing or isolated field response worker according to the present invention is characterized in that a main body (20) is formed in a band type such as a bracelet or anklet, and an emergency location transmitter (11), an ultrasonic transmitter (12), an infrared communication transmitter (13), an LED lighting device (14), a body temperature and pulse meter (15), a manual operation button (16), and a battery (17) are built into the main body (20).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 테러 또는 재난 현장에서 현장대응요원이 실종 또는 고립시, 구조를 위해 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 수동 또는 자동으로 전송하는 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 전송하는 밴드형 구조요청장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 전송하는 밴드형 구조요청장치는 본체(20)가 팔찌 또는 발찌와 같은 밴드 타입으로  형성되고, 비상위치발신기(11), 초음파 발신기(12), 적외선 통신 발신기(13), LED 조명장치(14), 체온 및 맥박 측정기(15), 수동조작버튼(16) 및 배터리(17)가 본체(20)에 내장형으로 배치되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV NAT INCHEON RES & BUSINESS FOUND

title_en: Fire-fighting security personnel carrying box
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carrying boxes and discloses a carrying box for fire fighters, which comprises a box body assembly; the box body assembly comprises a carrying box, an electronic prompt board and a plurality of supporting legs are arranged in the carrying box, the electronic prompt board and the supporting legs are rotatably connected to the bottom of the carrying box, and a sliding assembly is arranged at the bottom of the carrying box; the sliding assembly comprises sliding rails, a first plate body and a second plate body, wherein the sliding rails are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the bottom of the carrying box; according to the invention, the supporting legs have a better supporting effect on the carrying box by changing the positions of the supporting legs, the starting time and the frequent times of the air breathing apparatus used by rescue workers are displayed by using the electronic prompting board, so that the rescue workers can conveniently leave the scene, the carrying box is closed until the rescue is finished, and the supporting legs and the board body are reset, so that the carrying box is convenient to store and transfer, and the problems that the existing safety worker carrying box has a single function and cannot have a better auxiliary effect on rescue work are solved.

title_en: Functional firefighter uniform capable of rapidly cooling and emergency early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a functional firefighter uniform capable of quickly cooling and an emergency early warning method thereof, wherein the firefighter uniform is provided with a cooling bag, the cooling bag supplies air to the firefighter uniform and firefighter trousers through an air supply belt, so that the ventilation effect in a human body is enhanced, and the heat dissipation is improved; the comfort of the human body is improved in a stuffy environment, and the harm of the overheated operation environment to the life safety of firefighters is prevented. The emergency early warning method is characterized in that a firefighter grasps the environmental condition of the operation site in real time, has early warning effect on the firefighter, can timely and accurately respond according to the environmental condition, and realizes the emergency early warning of the firefighter; meanwhile, the central control end of the remote command is arranged, physiological parameters and position information of the firefighter are mastered and known in real time, current physical and emotional conditions of the firefighter can be reflected, heart rate and body temperature can be changed under extreme or emergency conditions, workers at the central control end can conveniently and timely know the conditions, corresponding actions can be rapidly executed, and support or rescue can be timely carried out.

title_en: Apparatus for mesuring training information in real time and monitoring system for training situation using the same
title_ko: 실시간 훈련정보 측정 장치 및 이를 이용한 훈련상황 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 의한 소방훈련에 참여하는 훈련대원들이 착용한 적어도 하나의 기기로부터 전송된 훈련정보들을 수신하는 제1 통신모듈; 상기 수신된 훈련정보들에 기반하여 상기 훈련대원들이 착용한 산소통의 공기소모량 정보, 훈련대원들의 위치 정보, 및 훈련대원들의 심박 정보 중 적어도 하나의 정보를 실시간으로 측정 및 분석하는 제1 프로세서; 및 상기 제1 프로세서와 연동하여 상기 실시간으로 측정 및 분석된 정보들이 저장되는 제1 데이터베이스를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire-fighting respiratory protection self-rescuer capable of effectively reducing dead weight
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting products, in particular to a fire-fighting respiratory protection self-rescuer capable of effectively reducing dead weight; comprises a gas cylinder assembly, a mask assembly and a filtering system; the mask assembly is connected with the air supply rapid switching device through an air duct; the air supply rapid switching device comprises a three-way valve body, an air guide channel and an elastic air bag, wherein the three-way valve body is positioned in the air cylinder; the three-way valve body is respectively connected with the air duct, the air bottle assembly and the air duct; the air guide channel is connected with the elastic air bag; the self-weight of the fire-fighting respiratory protection self-rescuer is further reduced, and the practicability and the effectiveness of the fire-fighting respiratory protection self-rescuer are improved.

title_en: Automatic alarm method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure proposes an automatic alarm method, apparatus, computer device, and storage medium, the method comprising: performing target detection on a current video frame of a monitoring area to obtain at least one target body; judging whether a tracking target body exists in at least one target body or not according to any tracking target body in the tracking set; if the tracking target body does not exist in the at least one target body, determining whether the tracking target body enters a fire scene area; if the tracking target body enters the fire scene area, determining whether the tracking target body is a first target body; if the tracking target body is a first target body, determining a first duration of the tracking target body entering the fire scene area; if the tracking target body is a first target body, determining a first total duration of entering the fire scene area for a plurality of times after the tracking target body starts from the air call replacement area; and if the first total duration is equal to or greater than the preset air-breathing air supply duration, sending first alarm information to the tracking target body. The method and the device can assist the fire fighter to accurately record the first total duration of the tracking target body entering the fire scene area and give an alarm in time.

title_en: Method and system of sensor-based smart unlocking of a firefighter air replenishment system
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and a system of sensor-based smart unlocking of a firefighter air replenishment system. A safety system of an occupiable structure includes a breathable-air supply system to facilitate delivery of breathable air from a source of compressed air, and a fill station in a fire-rated evacuation area of the occupiable structure to supply the breathable air to an emergency personnel. The safety system also includes a smart lock associated with the breathable-air supply system to automatically unlock one or more location(s) of the breathable-air supply system usable by the emergency personnel to access the breathable air during an emergency state of the occupiable structure, and a sensor associated with the breathable-air supply system to detect the emergency state of the occupiable structure.

title_en: System and method for in-structure delivery of air for filling of breathing apparatus
abstract_en: An in-structure air delivery system comprises a control panel and a plurality of air delivery lines. The control panel is located at a first location in the structure and has an air supply inlet. Each air delivery line extends from the control panel to a different location in the structure. Valves are configured to selectively control the flow of air through each of the air delivery lines. In a method of use, a high pressure air supply such as a portable compressor is connected to the inlet of the system. Air is selectively delivered to one or more of the delivery lines. A control unit is connected to the outlet of the delivery line. Air is supplied to the control unit. The control unit is used to regulate the flow of air to a component of breathing equipment, such as to a firefighter's breathing equipment air cylinder to be re-filled.

title_en: Intelligent cockpit system for fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control systems, in particular to a fire control operation intelligent cockpit system which comprises a perception analysis layer, a decision processing layer, a command execution layer and a reinforcement learning closed-loop framework of mixed rewarding shaping, wherein a video stream, audio communication and firefighter physiological data containing heart rate variability are integrated through a deep multi-mode fusion module to generate a global fire scene situation of physical constraint verification, a risk sensitive three-dimensional fire scene deduction module is used to generate a fire extinguishing strategy considering both efficiency and safety, an immersive augmented reality visual interface is used to realize accurate navigation in a complex environment and situation information superposition display containing risk levels through combining synchronous positioning and a mapping technology, and a Q learning algorithm continuous optimization strategy containing field knowledge intermediate process rewards is used to realize closed-loop optimization of 'perception-analysis-decision-execution-feedback', so that the overall efficiency of fire control rescue operation under a modern complex disaster scene is remarkably improved.

title_en: Personal monitoring and response system
abstract_en: A system is disclosed herein. The system includes a server, a software-application and a wearable-device. The system includes virtual groups to allows guardians or caretakers to identify/be alerted of any issues with a monitored subject. Events are triggered by various sensed parameters including heart rate, location, medication, etc. Notifications and alerts are sent through the software-application to the guardians and may be viewed by first responders via a First Response Portal. The system is useful for utilizing social grouping to enable family members or close friends to provide caregiver ability to a subject remotely.

title_en: Alarm notification system
abstract_en: A system and method providing for ascertaining the status of a user and escalating an alarm in the event the user is ascertained to be disposed in a dangerous condition. The of the invention attempts to contact the user at a predetermined check-in time, and notifies a pre-designated third-party which may be an emergency responder such as law enforcement or other emergency contact in the event that the user fails to respond to the check in request or signals that they are in danger using an escalate feature of the invention. The system operates autonomously to notify pre-designated emergency contacts or emergency responders in the case in which a user has been rendered unable to respond. The user may identify specific individuals with whom they plan to meet and the invention may also track the user's geo-location. The invention may also monitor biometric data of the user.

title_en: Device for locating person in emergency environment
abstract_en: A device for automatically emanating light rearwardly from a firefighter or miner or other person wearing a breathing apparatus. The device is attached to the breathing apparatus pressure regulator and in position to be next to the person's back when the breathing apparatus is donned. The device includes, in an electrical circuit, one or more light emitters, a battery, and a biased-open pressure switch for opening and closing the circuit thereby automatically turning electrical power on and off to the light emitters. A hose connects the pressure switch to the breathing apparatus to receive pressurized air from downstream of the breathing apparatus air tank shut-off valve for operating the switch to close the circuit to automatically activate the light emitters when the valve is opened. When the valve is closed, the pressure switch opens to automatically inactivate the light emitters.

title_en: High tower inside fire attack investigation disaster unit

title_en: Portable pneumatic heart machine with air compressor
title_ko: 에어콤프레셔가 구비된 이동식 공압하트머신
abstract_en: Disclosed is a portable pneumatic heart machine with an air compressor. The pneumatic heart machine comprises: a main tank (10) accommodating compressed air; a positive pressure type air respirator (20) for receiving air from the main tank (10), the positive pressure type air respirator (20) being connected to the main tank (10); a pneumatic working tool (30) for receiving compressed air, the pneumatic working tool (30) being connected to the main tank (10); and a pneumatic distributor (40) which is connected to the main tank (10), the positive pressure type air respirator (20) and the pneumatic working tool (30). The pneumatic heart machine further comprises: an auxiliary tank (110) for supplying compressed air into the main tank (10), the auxiliary tank (110) being connected to the main tank (10); an air compressor motor (120) for filling the auxiliary tank (110) with compressed air; a control unit (130) which is electrically connected to the air compressor motor (120); an on/off switch (140) which is electrically connected to the control unit (130); and a power supply (150) for supplying required power to the air compressor motor (120), the power supply (150) being electrically connected to the on/off switch (140). The present invention is capable of continuously supplying air required for respiration of a firefighter during rescue and firefighting at the scene of a fire and continuously supplying compressed air required by the pneumatic working tool. During the process of supplying air required for respiration of a firefighter to the positive pressure type air respirator, impurities are filtered by a filter device, thereby supplying clean air to the firefighter.

title_en: Bracelet for requesting rescue to indicate the location of missing or isolated first responders
title_ko: 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 알리기 위한 구조요청용 팔찌
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a bracelet for requesting rescue to notify a location of missing or isolated field response personnel, which can adjust a diameter of a main body according to a wrist of a wearer by adjusting a distance between ends using a socket member and a joint member. In the bracelet for requesting rescue to notify a location of missing or isolated field response personnel includes an emergency position sender (11), ultrasonic transmitter (12), infrared communication transmitter (13), LED lighting device (14), body temperature and pulse measuring instrument (15), manual operation button (16), and battery (17) are built into a main body (20).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 테러 및 재난 현장에서 현장대응요원이 실종 또는 고립시, 구조를 위해 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 수동 또는 자동으로 알리기 위한 구조요청용 팔찌에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 알리기 위한 구조요청용 팔찌는 본체(20)에 비상위치발신기(11), 초음파 발신기(12), 적외선 통신 발신기(13), LED 조명장치(14), 체온 및 맥박 측정기(15), 수동조작버튼(16) 및 배터리(17)가 내장형으로 배치되고,  
테러, 재난 현장에 투입된 경찰관, 소방관 등과 같은 현장대응요원이 현장 대응중에 실종 또는 고립되었을 때, 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원이 수동조작버튼(16)을 눌러, 비상위치발신기(11), 초음파 발신기(12), 적외선 통신 발신기(13) 및 LED 조명장치(14)를 동시에 수동으로 작동시키거나, 체온 및 맥박 측정기(15)가 본체(20)를 착용한 현장대응요원의 체온 및 맥박을 측정하여, 체온이 34℃ 이하로 떨어지게 되거나, 맥박이 분당 50회 이하로 떨어지면, 자동으로 본체(20)에 내장된 비상위치발신기(11), 초음파 발신기(12), 적외선 통신 발신기(13) 및 LED 조명장치(14)가 모두 자동으로 작동되고,  
합성수지 소재의 본체(20)가 "C" 형상으로 형성되고, 본체(20)의 제 1 단부(211)에 원통형의 소켓 부재(220)의 상단이 접합되고, 소켓 부재(220)의 내주면에 형성된 복수개의 요홈(221 ; 221a, 221b, 221c)이 형성되며, 본체(20)의 제 2 단부(212)에 "工" 형상으로 형성된 조인트 부재(230)의 하부 수평부(231)가 장착되고, 조인트 부재(230)의 상부 수평부(233)의 단부에 장착된 래치(245, 246)가 복수개의 요홈(221 ; 221a, 221b, 221c) 중 어느 하나에 끼워져, 제 1 단부(211)와 제 2 단부(212) 사이의 간격(S1)이 조절됨으로써, 착용자의 손목에 맞게 본체(20)의 직경(D1)이 조절되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV NAT INCHEON RES & BUSINESS FOUND

title_en: Critical health information profile and emergency communication system
abstract_en: A microprocessor-based emergency response communication system used to call and communicate with the 9-1-1 operator and also allows emergency responder's immediate access to a user's Critical Health Information Profile stored in the device at the point and location of crisis. The device is used to create individual Critical Health Information Profiles which is Health Level-7 compliant enabling it to seamlessly communicate with major hospital networks worldwide. This functional capability provides a system that can retrieve and transmit user-stored personal and health information by emergency responders at the point of care. The emergency responder can access the customer's Critical Health Information Profile database, review the data for pertinent information and then transmit that data to a designated receiving hospital or medical center. The device provides an electronic means of dialing and communicating directly with the 9-1-1 operator. A wireless remote transmitter unit can be activated from the wireless transmitter or the base unit to dial and connect with the 9-1-1 operator, broadcast a canned message with or without a personal- recorded message, and personally communicate with the 9-1-1 operator through a two-way speakerphone system. The device contains software enabling the user and medical personnel the ability to input, store, retrieve and analyze the user's vital sign data and other pertinent health information.

title_en: Method and system of sensor-based smart unlocking of a firefighter air replenishment system
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and a system of sensor-based smart unlocking of a firefighter air replenishment system. A safety system of an occupiable structure includes a breathable-air supply system to facilitate delivery of breathable air from a source of compressed air, and a fill station in a fire-rated evacuation area of the occupiable structure to supply the breathable air to an emergency personnel. The safety system also includes a smart lock associated with the breathable-air supply system to automatically unlock one or more location(s) of the breathable-air supply system usable by the emergency personnel to access the breathable air during an emergency state of the occupiable structure, and a sensor associated with the breathable-air supply system to detect the emergency state of the occupiable structure.

title_en: User device and urgent rescue apparatus and method using the same
title_ko: 사용자 단말기 및 이를 이용한 응급 구조 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A user terminal, an emergency rescue device thereof, and a method thereof are provided to offer overall emergency services from first aid to hospital transportation through a user terminal, thereby quickly performing emergency measures for a patient. CONSTITUTION: An input unit(202) inputs a command from a patient or a rescue worker. A transceiving unit(214) is interlocked with a hospital service device and an emergency service device. A control unit(204) executes an emergency mode application based on the command. The control unit provides hospital location information and emergency measure information at a predetermined distance from the current location. An emergency mode application unit(210) provides a service mode corresponding to the patient or the rescue worker.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사용자 단말기를 이용한 응급 구조 기술에 관한 것으로, 환자 또는 응급 환자를 구조하러 온 구조 대원이 사용자 단말기의 응급 모드 어플리케이션을 통해 환자 모드 또는 구조 모드를 선택하여 응급 처치 정보 수신, 환자의 신체 정보 측정, 주변의 병원 검색 및 예약, 교통편 확인 및 예약, 측정된 신체 정보를 병원 서비스 장치로 전송하는 등의 응급 서비스를 수행하여 응급 처치에 필요한 통합 서비스를 통합적으로 수행하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 사용자 단말기를 통해 환자의 응급 처치 및 병원으로 이송까지의 필요한 모든 기능을 제공함으로써, 환자에 대한 신속한 응급 조치를 가능하게 할 수 있으며, 병원에서는 구조대원과의 실시간 정보공유(예컨대, 환자 정보, 생체 신호 측정 정보, 응급실 예약 등)를 통해 환자가 이송되는 동안 실시간 응급 처치 준비를 신속하게 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Corridor alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a corridor alarm device, and relates to the technical field of rescue. The alarm comprises a distress device and an alarm, wherein the distress device is in signal connection with the alarm. The technology can be mutually supervised, and can help and timely inform neighbors knowing the accurate position and security personnel carrying the equipment after accidents occur, so that the rescue opportunity is greatly increased and the rescue time is shortened; the wireless or wired equipment is adopted for signal transmission, so that the concealed transmission distress signal can not irritate a pest and accurately send position information for rescue; rescue information is obtained rapidly, so that the safety is greatly improved; the working principle of the alarm is consistent with that of the distress device, and the alarm is used for switching signals output by the distress device and transmitting the signals to the equipment terminal so that a rescuer can know information of a victim and give an alarm and rescue in time.

title_en: Simple water purifying device and life jacket with same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simple water purifying device and a life jacket with the same. The simple water purifying device comprises a water bag, a water purifying unit and a water absorber, wherein the water purifying unit is installed at a water inlet of the water bag, a seawater desalination permeable membrane is adopted, the water absorber is connected to the water bag through a gas pipeline and communicated with the water bag, seawater enters the water bag through the water inlet under the action of suction force of the water absorber, and the water purifying unit can desalinate the seawater at the water inlet, so that the water entering the water bag is guaranteed to be desalinated, and the basic drinking requirement of related personnel on fresh water is met. The life jacket is provided with the simple water purifying device. In addition, the life jacket also comprises a positioner, a health bracelet, a life-saving whistle, an illuminating lamp and other parts, so that the functions of positioning and tracking, vital sign monitoring, on-site help calling and illumination of rescuers can be realized, and the requirements of marine rescuers are greatly met.
assignees: HUAXUNYUN TECH INVESTMENT HOLDING QINGDAO GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent first-aid alarm fire-fighting clothing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting equipment field, concretely relates to intelligence first aid warning fire-fighting dress. The intelligent emergency alarm fire-fighting clothing comprises a fire-fighting clothing body and a fire-fighting helmet, wherein the fire-fighting helmet comprises a helmet body, a circle of connecting part is arranged on the outer edge of the bottom end of the helmet body, and the fire-fighting helmet can be connected with the fire-fighting clothing body through the connecting part; the inner surface of the firefighter uniform body is provided with a sensing system and a singlechip; the sensing system comprises a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor and a heart rate sensor, the signal output ends of the temperature sensor, the humidity sensor and the heart rate sensor are respectively connected with the input end of the single chip microcomputer, and the heart rate sensor is arranged at the position, corresponding to the heart of a human body, of the front piece of the firefighter uniform body. The intelligent emergency alarm fire-fighting clothing can sense the environmental information of a fire-fighting site and the physiological health condition and position real-time information of a fireman in real time, and transmit the information to a fire truck command system to provide a reference basis for fire-fighting scheduling command.
assignees: WUXI HODO MENS WEAR CO LTD

title_en: Comfortable firefighter uniform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of firefighters, in particular to a firefighter uniform comfortable to wear, which comprises a firefighter uniform body, a high-definition camera integrated at the upper end of a helmet, a physiological monitoring bracelet, a GPS positioning module, a data processing unit arranged at the chest and the abdomen and a wireless transmission module, wherein the firefighter uniform body is provided with a first-class camera, a second-class camera and a third-class camera; the high-definition camera, the physiological monitoring bracelet and the GPS positioning module are respectively and electrically connected with the data processing unit; according to the invention, the heart rate, blood oxygen, vital capacity and blood pressure of the firefighter are detected in real time through the physiological monitoring bracelet, intelligent analysis is performed by combining the data processing unit, dynamic evaluation of the health state of the firefighter is provided for a command center, so that abnormal conditions are found in time, and the wireless transmission module is adopted to work cooperatively with the iBeacon local area network, so that stable data communication can be maintained under the severe fire scene environment, and the problem of data interruption caused by signal interference of the traditional firefighter uniform is effectively solved.

title_en: Comprehensive combat service guarantee wireless sensing terminal
abstract_en: The utility model provides a comprehensive combat service support wireless sensing terminal, which is provided with a fire-fighting equipment monitoring unit and a fire-fighting material monitoring unit for detecting the positions and the surplus of fire-fighting equipment and fire-fighting materials, and can solve the problems that the distribution of fire-fighting equipment has discreteness, higher failure rate and no detailed information on the fire-fighting equipment; the motion artifact in the heart rate signal is eliminated by adopting an adaptive filter in a firefighter monitoring unit, the adaptive filter is a nonlinear filter which continuously and automatically adjusts parameters according to the feedback of result information in the filtering process, and the frequency characteristic of a signal to be processed is not required to be known in advance, so the design difficulty of the filter is reduced, and the filtering precision of the filter is improved; in order to adapt to the adaptive filter, a three-axis acceleration sensor is adopted as an acquisition part to increase the comprehensiveness of the information of the motion noise reduction reference signal.

title_en: Portable self-supporting fire fighting equipment station
abstract_en: A portable fire fighter equipment station for use at a fire fighting scene is provided. The self-supporting frame comprising three support members pivotally connected to each other at one end, the self-supporting frame configurable into an in-use configuration with non-pivotally connected ends of the support members spaced apart to form a tripod and the self-supporting frame configurable into a transportation configuration with the three support members moved into close proximity. Each firefighter station is attached to one of the support members of the self-supporting frame and has a seating surface configurable into an in-use configuration to support a firefighter in a seated position, and a transportation configuration with the seating surface in close proximity to the self-supporting frame. A breathing apparatus holder is provided for securing an air bottle to the support member of the respective firefighter station.

title_en: Survival device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a survival device, and belongs to auxiliary life detection and trapped person position indication equipment. The survival device comprises a tank and inflatable bags arranged on the two sides of the tank, wherein a valve is arranged on the tank, and is used for blocking inflation inlets of the inflatable bags; a pulse sensor and a wireless transmitter are arranged on the valve; the pulse sensor is connected to the data input end of a first processor; the wireless transmitter is connected to the data output end of the first processor; wireless receivers and LED (light-emitting diode) indicator lamps are arranged on the inflatable bags; the wireless receivers are connected to the data input end of a second processor; the LED indicator lamps are connected to the data output end of the second processor. According to the survival device, not only can be the position of a trapped person indicated, but also vital signs of the trapped person can be monitored, so that a rescuer can rapidly find the trapped person, and can also determine rescue priority according to the vital signs of the trapped person.

title_en: Intelligent safety protection wearing equipment for firefighter emergency rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent safety protection wearing device for fireman emergency rescue, which comprises a fire fighting AR intelligent helmet and a multifunctional fireman tactical vest; the structural component of the fire-fighting AR intelligent helmet comprises an AR display mirror lifting key, a stepping motor, an AR display module, a Hall switch component and the like which are fixed on a helmet shell; the multifunctional fireman tactical vest comprises a flexible silica gel radiating tube, a constant temperature regulator, a physiological information detecting sheet, a radiating fan, a micro heat pump, an intelligent positioning device and a standby power supply; the design is that before entering an unknown disaster accident site, a fireman intelligently senses and judges the environmental temperature, environmental position information, site suffocation, explosion, poisoning accident risk, personnel search and rescue and other information of the disaster accident site, can monitor the psychological, physiological and other vital sign information of the fireman at the same time, and provides site real-time information and rescue command decision basis for rescue command of the accident site.

title_en: A lifesaving equipment for boats and ships have prompt facility
abstract_en: The invention relates to a life-saving device with a prompt function for a ship, which comprises a main body, two prompt mechanisms and two heating mechanisms, wherein each prompt mechanism comprises a connecting pipe, a fixed box, a driving assembly, a transmission assembly, a rotating assembly, a fluorescent lamp, a rotating plate and a ring, each heating mechanism comprises a nozzle, a fixed rod, an air cylinder, a piston, an air rod, a reciprocating assembly, a heating wire, an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe, and the life-saving device with the prompt function for the ship can enable the fluorescent lamp to emit flickering light through the prompt mechanisms, so that the positions of rescuers and rescuers are reminded conveniently, the practicability of the device is improved, hot air is sprayed to the rescuers through the nozzles through the heating mechanisms, the situation that the body temperature of the rescuers and the safety and health of the devices are threatened due to too low body temperature of.

title_en: Apparatus for processing signal related to cardiopulmonary resuscitation as possible Folding Ambulance couch
title_ko: 구급침상에 사용되는 흉부압박소생 통합처리 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) processing apparatus used in a first-aid stretcher interworking with emergency resuscitation equipment including an automatic CPR machine to provide CPR to a patient while the patient is being transported. The said present invention comprises: a biometric signal sensing unit sensing a biometric signal of the patient on the first-aid stretcher, and converting the biometric signal into a digital signal; a control unit providing control to collect the biometric digital signal of the patient transmitted from the biometric signal sensing unit, process the biometric digital signal, and transmits the biometric information of the patient obtained by processing the biometric digital signal to a registered emergency rescuer terminal or emergency treatment information processing device in real time; and a communication interface module transmitting the biometric information of the patient obtained by processing the signal to the registered emergency rescuer terminal or emergency treatment information processing device under the control of the control unit. The related art problem arising when CPR is not effectively provided while a patient is being transported using a first-aid stretcher can be solved; safety of an emergency rescuer in regards to high risk patient transportation among pre-hospital cares is guaranteed by interworking with an ergonomic, automatically driven first-aid stretcher; and the generation of occupational muscular skeletal diseases can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 환자 이송 중 심정지 환자 소생술을 제공할 수 있도록 기계식 흉부압박기를 포함한 구급 소생 장비와의 연동이 가능한 구급침상에 사용되는 흉부압박소생 통합처리 장치에 있어서, 상기 구급침상에 위치한 환자의 생체 신호를 감지하여 디지털 신호로 변환하는 생체신호 감지부, 상기 생체신호 감지부로부터 나온 환자의 생체 디지털 신호를 수집하여 신호처리하고, 상기 신호 처리하여 나온 환자의 생체 정보를 실시간으로 등록된 구급 요원 단말기 또는 응급 처리 정보처리장치로 전송되도록 제어하는 제어부 및, 상기 제어부의 제어하에 상기 신호 처리하여 나온 환자의 생체 정보를 상기 등록된 구급 요원 단말기 또는 응급 처리 정보처리장치로 전송하는 통신 인터페이스 모듈을 포함하여 이루어진 구급침상에 사용되는 흉부압박소생 통합처리 장치에 관한 것으로, 기존 구급 침상을 이용한 환자 이송 중에 효율적인 심정지 환자 소생술이 제공되지 않으므로 인해 발생하는 문제점을 해결할 수 있고, 인간공학적인 자동 구동형 구급침상과 연동하여 구급활동 중 작업위험도가 높은 환자 이송 업무에 대한 구급대원의 안전성을 보장하고 직업성 근골격계 질환 발생의 예방에 기여할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for preventing freezing of the valve for air respirator mask and the method for controlling thereof
title_ko: 공기호흡기 면체의 밸브 동결 방지장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공기호흡기 면체의 밸브 동결 방지장치 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 공기호흡기용 면체의 흡기구나 배기구에 히팅장치를 설치하여 흡기밸브나 배기밸브가 겨울철 외기에 의해 냉각 또는 동결되는 것을 방지하기 위한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 히팅부에 동작 전원을 공급하는 전원 공급부, 공기호흡기 면체의 노즈컵에 형성된 흡기구 및 배기구에 각각 설치되며 전원 공급부에서 제공되는 구동전류에 의해 동작하여 열을 발생시키는 다수 개의 히팅부, 사용자 조작에 의해 온/오프되어 전원 공급부에서 각 히팅부에 공급하는 전원을 단속하는 전원스위치, 노즈컵의 흡기구나 배기구의 일측 또는 그 주변에 설치되어 흡기구나 배기구 또는 그 주변온도를 측정하는 온도 감지부, 온도 감지부의 온도 감지신호 또는 전원스위치의 온/오프 조작 상태에 따라 전원 공급부에서 각 히팅부로 공급되는 전원을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여, 화재 현장에서 장시간 작업에 따른 소방대원의 교대 또는 기타 다른 업무를 수행하기 위해 공기호흡기 면체를 잠시 벗어 두어야 하는 경우에도 공기호흡기용 면체의 흡기밸브나 배기밸브가 냉각 또는 동결되지 않도록 하여 필요시 즉시 재착용하여 효율적인 작업을 수행할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: Apparatus for mesuring training information in real time and monitoring system for training situation using the same
title_ko: 실시간 훈련정보 측정 장치 및 이를 이용한 훈련상황 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: An apparatus for measuring training information in real time according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a first communication module which receives training information transmitted from at least one device worn by training members participating in fire drills; a first processor which measures and analyzes, in real time, at least one piece of information on air consumption of oxygen cylinders worn by the training members, location information of the training members, and information on a heart rate of the training members based on the received training information; and a first database in which the information measured and analyzed in real time is stored in conjunction with the first processor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 의한 소방훈련에 참여하는 훈련대원들이 착용한 적어도 하나의 기기로부터 전송된 훈련정보들을 수신하는 제1 통신모듈; 상기 수신된 훈련정보들에 기반하여 상기 훈련대원들이 착용한 산소통의 공기소모량 정보, 훈련대원들의 위치 정보, 및 훈련대원들의 심박 정보 중 적어도 하나의 정보를 실시간으로 측정 및 분석하는 제1 프로세서; 및 상기 제1 프로세서와 연동하여 상기 실시간으로 측정 및 분석된 정보들이 저장되는 제1 데이터베이스를 포함한다.
assignees: TAN SAN ELECTRONICS;UNIV HOSEO ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Firefighter positioning searching system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a firefighter positioning searching system and method and belongs to the technical field of fire control and rescue. The firefighter positioning searching system and method can monitor firefighters in a burning building, and automatically determine the positions of the firefighters after the firefighters keep motionless for a certain time. According to the technical scheme, the firefighter positioning searching system comprises a transmitting device used for transmitting signals, a fixed searching and a portable searching device, the fixed searching and the portable searching device receives the signals, the transmitting device comprises a first power source, a rest switch and an electromagnetic signal transmitter, the first power source, the rest switch and the electromagnetic signal transmitter are connected in sequence to form a main loop, the fixed searching device comprises a second power source, a first beam concentration flashlight, a plane electromagnetic searching detector and a vertical electromagnetic searching detector, the second power source, the first beam concentration flashlight, the plane electromagnetic searching detector and the vertical electromagnetic searching detector are all connected with a first processor, the portable searching device comprises a third power source, a second plane electromagnetic searching detector and a second beam concentration flashlight, and the third power source, the second plane electromagnetic searching detector and the second beam concentration flashlight are connected with a second processor. The firefighter positioning searching system and method are used for monitoring and rescuing firefighters on a fire fighting site.

title_en: A cpr assistance device and a method for determining patient chest compression depth
abstract_en: A Cardiopulmonary resuscitation assistance device is used by a Rescuer when administering Cardiopulmonary resuscitation to a patient. Using the rescuer vital signs, image subsection from a patient facing camera can be identified that comprise the rescuer's hands. Having correctly identified the image subsections comprising the rescuer's hands the chest compression depth and frequency can be derived from the patient facing camera by tracking the distance between the patient facing camera and the rescuer's hands.

title_en: Portable emergent air supply arrangement of fire control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile fire-fighting emergency air supply device, which is characterized by comprising a fuel engine, a fan box and an interface, a universal wheel chassis, a fire-resistant air supply pipeline and a fire-resistant air supply outlet; the fuel engine provides power and is connected with the fan box to drive the fan to rotate; the fan box is connected with a fireproof air supply pipeline through a fireproof soft joint and supplies air to a required place; the universal wheel chassis is positioned at the bottom of the fuel engine and the fan box, and the air supply device can be moved by the universal wheels. The utility model has the advantages that: the device is integrated with fuel engine, fan box and universal wheel chassis, can use when having no reliable power under conflagration or the emergency situation, and the universal wheel chassis can be with device quick travel, can send fresh air to the regional inside protection fire fighter safety of conflagration through fire-resistant supply-air duct and fire-resistant supply-air outlet also can send to the confined space of no fresh air and supply emergency rescue to use.

title_en: Anti-robbing self-rescuer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a robbery-proof self-rescuer. The problem that there is not SOS device on the current vehicle is mainly solved. The method is characterized in that: an LED electronic display screen (2), a controller (3), a module (4) and a memory (5) are fixed in the shell (1), a storage battery in the vehicle provides power, emergency help-seeking characters are stored in the memory (5), and a power switch (6) is arranged in a hidden position which is convenient to touch in the vehicle. The anti-robbery self-rescuer can send out a distress signal in case of emergency, and has the characteristics of simple structure, convenient use and uneasy detection by criminals.

title_en: A kind of motor vehicle running accident signaling system based on air bag triggering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of motor vehicle running accident signaling system based on air bag triggering, big dipper module including obtaining vehicle position information, the big dipper module is connected with single-chip microcomputer and positional information is conveyed into single-chip microcomputer, the single-chip microcomputer is connected with interacting display with display screen, the GSM communication modules for sending distress signals, trigger button, cancelling signal send button, setting button are also associated with the single-chip microcomputer, the trigger button opens circuit communication with air bag.Whether the utility model can be decided in its sole discretion when accident occurs for driver needs to cry for help, it can be sent an SOS the very first time when driver is injured overweight simultaneously, and determination of the rescuer to information such as the positions of the wounded is facilitated, the utility model is suitable to practical, easy to spread.

title_en: Firefighter safety management system
title_ko: 소방대원 안전관리 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방대원 안전관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 소방대원 안전관리 시스템은, 재난현장에 투입된 각 소방대원의 신체 일부에 착용되어 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 측정단말; 상기 생체신호 측정단말로부터 측정된 상기 생체신호에 기반하여, 상기 각 소방대원의 신체상태와 열스트레스 레벨을 모니터링하는 모니터링부; 및 모니터링된 상기 각 소방대원의 신체상태와 상기 열 스트레스 레벨을 기초로 상기 소방대원의 복귀, 상기 소방대원의 위치이동 및 상기 재난현장으로의 소방대원의 추가 투입 여부를 결정하는 안전관리부를 포함한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 재난현장에 투입된 소방대원들의 상태 및 위치를 실시간으로 모니터링하고 소방대원의 신체위험 또는 고립상황을 신속하게 감지할 수 있다.

title_en: System For Tracing Location Using RF
title_ko: 알에프를 이용한 위치 추적 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 RF를 이용한 위치 추적 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 사용자의 현재 위치에 대한 RF 신호와 이 현재 위치에 대한 고도 데이터, 사용자의 체온 및 맥박에 대한 생체 데이터를 송신 안테나를 통해 송출하는 RF 송신기; 상기 RF 송신기의 상기 송신 안테나로부터 수신받은 상기 RF 신호, 상기 고도 데이터 및 상기 생체 데이터를 연산 작업하는 RF 수신기; 및 상기 RF 수신기와 연동하여 이 RF 수신기에서 연산 작업이 이루어진 상기 RF 신호, 상기 고도 데이터 및 상기 생체 데이터를 실시간으로 확인하는 중앙 관리 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 RF를 이용한 위치 추적 시스템을 제공한다. 
     본 발명에 의하면, VIP 등의 중요 인물, 어린이, 위험한 공사현장의 작업자, 화재 현장이 소방대원 및 군인 등의 사용자들의 위치 파악을 RF 태그에 부여된 신호의 식별을 통해 현재 위치를 파악하는 위치 추적 시스템을 제공함으로써, 설치 비용을 절감하는 효과가 있다.
