title_en: Post-accident network probe and method of using the same
abstract_en: A post-accident network probe and a method of using such a probe are disclosed. The probe is configured to be deployed in a confined environment (e.g. an underground mine), typically after an accident has occurred, in order to establish a connection with the wireless network, or a portion thereof, located therein. The probe generally allows the rescuers to determine the position of potentially trapped miners and can allow the rescuers to have access to environment-related information collected by the network, to get vital signs information, and/or to communicate with the trapped miners. The probe can be deployed using different access methods such as bore holes (existing or new), ventilation shafts, preventive installations of probes, etc. Notably, since the probe establishes a connection with the network, the location of the probe does not have to be exactly where the miners are located as long as the miners are tracked by the network.
assignees: CROTEAU SERGE;CERVINKA ALEXANDRE;BUIST ALEXANDRE;LI WANG;MESSIER PIERRE-ÉTIENNE;LAMBERT JEAN-FRANÇOIS;PATTERSON GLENN DAVID;NEWTRAX HOLDINGS INC

title_en: Personal monitoring and response system
abstract_en: A system is disclosed herein. The system includes a server, a software-application and a wearable-device. The system includes virtual groups to allows guardians or caretakers to identify/be alerted of any issues with a monitored subject. Events are triggered by various sensed parameters including heart rate, location, medication, etc. Notifications and alerts are sent through the software-application to the guardians and may be viewed by first responders via a First Response Portal. The system is useful for utilizing social grouping to enable family members or close friends to provide caregiver ability to a subject remotely.

title_en: Intelligent firefighter safety information management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent firefighter safety information management system, which comprises a management platform, wherein the management platform comprises a login module, a data acquisition module, a safety module, an equipment interface module, a data processing module, a data storage module, a data backup module, an alarm module and a Bluetooth connection module, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring position information and vital sign data of firefighters and firefighting equipment, and the safety module is used for ensuring the safety of the acquired data. According to the invention, the position information and vital sign information of the firefighters are acquired through the positioning module and the monitoring module on the data acquisition module, meanwhile, the data safety module and the personnel safety module are utilized to acquire abnormal signals of the firefighters and the data storage module, the abnormal signals are transmitted to the alarm module, the data storage module and the vital sign abnormality of the firefighters are warned, and the omnibearing guarantee is provided for the safety of the firefighters.
assignees: JILIN HONGYING FIRE FIGHTING INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Air respirator with drinking water function
abstract_en: The invention provides an air respirator with a drinking water function, which comprises a gas bottle, a back frame, an air supply valve, a pressure reducer, a mask, an air pipe, a half mask, a drinking bottle, a drinking pipe, a mask pipe joint component and a water suction head, wherein the mask is internally provided with the half mask, the mask is provided with a first through hole for the mask pipe joint component to pass through, the half mask is provided with a second through hole for the water suction head to pass through, the mask pipe joint component is connected with the mask through a fastener after passing through the first through hole, the water suction head passes through the second through hole and is connected with one end of the mask pipe joint component, which is positioned in the mask, the back frame is provided with a water bottle fixing mechanism, the drinking bottle is connected with the back frame through the water bottle fixing mechanism, one end of the drinking pipe is connected with the drinking bottle, and the other end of the drinking pipe joint component is connected with one end of the mask pipe joint component, which is positioned outside the mask. According to the invention, the components such as the water bottle, the water pipe, the water suction head and the like are arranged on the back plate of the respirator, so that fire fighters can conveniently supplement water by the water suction head without taking off the mask, physical fitness is kept, and the fight force of the fire fighters is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUAN FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Band-type device for requesting rescue to transmit the location of missing or isolated first responders
title_ko: 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 전송하는 밴드형 구조요청장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 테러 또는 재난 현장에서 현장대응요원이 실종 또는 고립시, 구조를 위해 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 수동 또는 자동으로 전송하는 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 전송하는 밴드형 구조요청장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 실종 또는 고립된 현장대응요원의 위치를 전송하는 밴드형 구조요청장치는 본체(10)가 팔찌 또는 발찌와 같은 밴드 타입으로  형성되고, 비상위치발신기(11), 초음파 발신기(12), 적외선 통신 발신기(13), LED 조명장치(14), 체온 및 맥박 측정기(15), 수동조작버튼(16) 및 배터리(17)가 본체(10)에 내장형으로 배치되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Portable intelligent fire-fighting rescue terminal
abstract_en: A portable intelligent fire-fighting rescue terminal comprises a data acquisition device and an intelligent device based on an Android system. The data acquisition device comprises a microcontroller, a smog / toxic gas sensor, a temperature sensor, a heart rate sensor, an accelerometer, a ZigBee wireless transmission module, a bluetooth module, a sound and light alarm module, a one-key calling module and a power supply circuit. The microcontroller is directly connected to the smog / toxic gas sensor, the temperature sensor, the heart rate sensor, the accelerometer, the ZigBee wireless transmission module, the bluetooth module, the sound and light alarm module and the one-key calling module separately. The intelligent device is connected to the data acquisition device via the bluetooth module to set up communication. The terminal allows visiting an upper level server and visiting external networks via Internet. The terminal accurately achieves indoor positioning of firefighters, allows automatic networking and information exchange, and transmits field conditions of a fire, heart rates and motion status of firefighters and emergency alarm information to a monitoring center and commanding people to satisfy the needs of field rescue.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system and method based on iBeacons
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring system and method based on iBeacons, which comprises iBeacons equipment for detecting vital signs of firefighters; the information transmission equipment interacts with the iBeacons equipment through Bluetooth; and the information transfer equipment is wirelessly connected with a service platform for providing feedback information for the information transfer equipment. The in-process that the fire fighter carried out the fire control wearing fire-fighting apparatus, iBeacons equipment passes through sensing element and gathers the vital sign of fire fighter and contrast rather than the daily vital sign of memory cell storage, if appear unusually, then send unusual information to service platform through information transfer equipment, service platform stabilizes its health through the fire control position of dispatch fire fighter, if the fire fighter does not have the response feedback, service platform issues the rescue instruction to other fire fighters through information transfer equipment and iBeacons equipment. The invention can find the abnormal vital signs of the firemen in the fire fighting process in time and carry out rapid processing, thereby ensuring the safety of the firemen.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Multi-physiological-parameter monitoring field rescue waistband, method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-physiological parameter monitoring field rescue waistband, a method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the multi-physiological parameter monitoring field rescue waistband adopts solar energy to supply power, so that wearable equipment can not be limited by geographic positions and the electric quantity can be supplemented at any time; the intelligent waistband uses the Beidou module to send rescue positions, and can send physiological information such as heart rate and respiratory rate of a wearer, so that data support is provided for the real-time understanding of the near condition of the body of the rescued person by the rescuer, and the waistband body and the waistband head adopt a separated design, so that later replacement and maintenance are facilitated.
assignees: SUZHOU INST BIOMEDICAL ENG & TECH CAS

title_en: Triangle folding formula buoyant apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of triangle folding formula buoyant apparatus, comprise one first hinged successively connecting panel, one second connecting panel and one the 3rd connecting panel, be arranged on the shrouding at two ends, a breather pipe; The first described connecting panel is connected by movable snap with the 3rd described connecting panel.The advantage of triangle folding formula buoyant apparatus of the present utility model is: form triangular prism shaped sealed cavity by three blocks of plates and the soft rubber that is positioned at two ends, people wherein can be avoided not scatter and disappear too fast by solar exposure or body temperature, with the breather pipe of opening down layout, ensure that the person of meeting with misfortune can eupnea and water can not be entered by breather pipe; Breather pipe is also provided with hook, and be convenient to the telescopiform buoyant apparatus that rescuer salvages, volume after folding is minimum, and productive costs is lower, is conducive to user and configures in a large number.

title_en: Air sucking supply valve
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to fire-fighting equipment, relating to a positive pressure fire-fighting air breathing apparatus, which is applied to an air-breathing supply valve that provides fresh air for firefighters, wherein the lower end of a base seat of the air-breathing supply valve is communicated with an air-breathing facemask. A valve head arranged on the lower end of air supply spool is positioned on an opening which is mounted on the lower end of the intra-cavity of the air supply valve base, and a male cone is arranged in the valve head which is oriented to the opening. A briquetting is mounted on top of an upper end of the air supply spool. The compression spring comes into contact with a hood face of a control lever, one end of which is connected to the base seat via hinges and the other end is arranged on the lower part of an air-breathing valve block which seals the upper end of the intra-cavity of the air-breathing valve base seat. title_en: life jacket capable of generating distress signal
title_ko: 조난신호 발생이 가능한 구명조끼
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a life jacket capable of generating a distress signal by generating electricity through a thermoelectric module, comprising: a main body worn by a castaway; a notification means mounted on the main body; a thermoelectric module provided in the main body and generating power by the temperature difference between seawater and a human body; a signal transmission means for receiving power generated from the thermoelectric module and transmitting a distress signal; and a connection means for electrically connecting the thermoelectric module with the notification means and the signal transmission means. Thus, the life jacket capable of generating a distress signal can stably supply power in a distress situation by thermoelectric power generated by the temperature difference between seawater and the human body, and is provided with the notification means that extends long from the top of the life jacket so that a rescuer can easily check the location of the castaway from a distance.

title_en: Post-accident network probe and method of using the same
abstract_en: A post-accident network probe and a method of using the probe are disclosed. The probe is configured to be deployed in a confined environment (e.g. an underground mine), typically after an accident has occurred, in order to establish a connection with the wireless network, or a portion thereof, located therein. The probe generally allows the rescuers to determine the position of potentially trapped miners and can allow the rescuers to have access to environment-related information collected by the network, to get vital signs information, and/or to communicate with the trapped miners. The probe can be deployed using different access methods such as bore holes (existing or new), ventilation shafts, preventive installations of probes, etc.. Notably, since the probe establishes a connection with the network, the location of the probe does not have to be exactly where the miners are located as long as the miners are tracked by the network.
